Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only did the researchers isolate the specific gene responsible for the mutation, but they also ___ its impact on the surrounding ecosystem.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan struktur korelasi paralel 'not only... but also'. Karena bagian pertama menggunakan past tense (did isolate), maka bagian kedua harus menggunakan bentuk kata kerja yang setara, yaitu past tense (documented).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ such a significant shift in tectonic plates occurred without triggering a series of minor tremors in the region.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat dimulai dengan kata keterangan negatif 'rarely' yang mengharuskan inversi subjek dan kata kerja bantu. Karena terdapat past participle 'occurred', maka kata kerja bantu yang tepat adalah 'has' untuk membentuk present perfect.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The democratic process requires that every citizen ___ access to unbiased information before casting their vote in a national election.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'requires' diikuti oleh 'that' menunjukkan penggunaan subjunctive mood. Dalam format ini, kata kerja yang mengikuti subjek harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) tanpa memperhatikan subjek tunggal atau jamak.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Carbon dating, a technique ___ by archeologists, allows for the precise determination of an artifact's age based on its organic remains.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bagian ini merupakan reduced relative clause. Bentuk aslinya adalah 'which is widely used', yang disederhanakan menjadi past participle 'widely used' untuk menerangkan kata benda sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In terms of biodiversity, the tropical rainforest is ___ more complex than the temperate forest ecosystems found in northern latitudes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'vastly' merupakan adverb yang berfungsi memodifikasi kata sifat komparatif 'more complex' untuk memberikan penekanan pada derajat perbandingan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Under no circumstances ___ the laboratory equipment be operated without the direct supervision of a qualified technician.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ungkapan negatif 'under no circumstances' di awal kalimat memicu inversi. Modal 'should' adalah pilihan yang paling tepat untuk menyatakan instruksi atau prosedur keamanan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The corporation's profits increased significantly last quarter, ___ primarily to the successful integration of artificial intelligence in their supply chain.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'due to' digunakan sebagai kata sifat untuk menerangkan penyebab dari peningkatan keuntungan. 'Because' biasanya diikuti oleh klausa lengkap, bukan frasa benda.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern chemistry relies heavily on the periodic table, ___ provides a systematic framework for understanding elemental properties.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'which' diperlukan untuk menghubungkan klausa penjelas yang memberikan informasi tambahan mengenai 'periodic table' dalam non-defining relative clause.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Only after the merger was finalized ___ the board of directors realize the true extent of the company's financial liabilities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'only after...' di awal kalimat memerlukan inversi pada klausa utama. 'Did' digunakan sebagai auxiliary untuk kata kerja dasar 'realize' dalam konteks masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The intricate web of life in the archipelago is threatened by invasive species ___ the balance of the local habitat.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle phrase 'disrupting' berfungsi sebagai kata sifat (active voice) untuk menjelaskan aktivitas yang sedang dilakukan oleh 'invasive species'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Economic growth in developing nations is often hampered by a lack of infrastructure, high inflation, and ___.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Prinsip paralelisme mengharuskan semua item dalam daftar memiliki bentuk gramatikal yang sama. Karena 'infrastructure' dan 'inflation' adalah noun phrase, maka 'political instability' adalah pilihan yang setara.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: It is essential that the data ___ analyzed thoroughly before the final report is submitted to the board of directors.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adjective 'essential' memicu penggunaan subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk pasif, rumusnya adalah 'be' + past participle, tanpa mempedulikan subjek 'data' tunggal atau jamak.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Although ___ in many parts of the world, the medicinal plant is now strictly protected under international conservation laws.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan reduced adverb clause. Bentuk aslinya adalah 'although it is found', yang disederhanakan menjadi past participle 'found' karena subjeknya sama dengan klausa utama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The more complex the software becomes, ___ it is for the average user to navigate the interface without a manual.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur perbandingan ganda (double comparative) menggunakan pola 'the more... the more/er...'. 'The harder' secara tepat melengkapi struktur paralel perbandingan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Biologists have discovered that the specialized cells ___ oxygen throughout the organism are actually quite resilient.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'transporting' berfungsi sebagai penjelas aktif untuk 'specialized cells'. Sel-sel tersebutlah yang melakukan tindakan pengangkutan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not until the mid-twentieth century ___ the true potential of semiconductor technology fully recognized by the industrial sector.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'not until...' di awal kalimat memerlukan inversi. Karena subjek 'potential' bersifat tunggal dan peristiwa terjadi di masa lampau, maka auxiliary 'was' (passive voice) digunakan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The volcanic eruption was so powerful ___ the ash cloud reached the stratosphere within minutes of the initial blast.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menyatakan hubungan sebab-akibat. 'That' menghubungkan dampak (awan abu mencapai stratosfer) dari intensitas erupsi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Despite ___ numerous obstacles in the early stages of development, the startup successfully launched its renewable energy platform.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'despite' harus diikuti oleh noun phrase atau gerund. 'Facing' adalah gerund yang berfungsi sebagai objek preposisi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The geographic isolation of the island led to the evolution of species ___ distinct from their mainland relatives.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative clause 'that were' diperlukan untuk menerangkan 'species'. Pilihan 'were' saja akan menciptakan dua kata kerja utama dalam satu klausa tanpa penghubung.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Seldom ___ philosophers agreed on a single definition of justice within a democratic framework.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adverb negatif 'seldom' di awal kalimat memicu inversi. Karena subjek 'philosophers' jamak dan diikuti oleh past participle 'agreed', maka 'have' adalah auxiliary yang benar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ the severe drought, the farmers managed to harvest a decent crop by using an advanced irrigation system.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'notwithstanding' berarti 'meskipun' atau 'tetapi'. Berbeda dengan 'even though' atau 'although' yang memerlukan klausa, 'notwithstanding' dapat diikuti oleh noun phrase.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The catalyst increases the rate of the chemical reaction ___ being consumed in the process.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'without' diikuti oleh gerund 'being consumed' untuk menyatakan kondisi di mana suatu peristiwa terjadi tanpa keterlibatan atau dampak tertentu.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Should the atmospheric pressure drop suddenly, the sensor ___ an automatic warning to the flight deck.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini adalah inverted conditional type 1 (penggunaan 'should' sebagai pengganti 'if'). Klausa utama harus menggunakan modal future 'will' + verb 1.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The discovery of the new element, ___ predicted by Mendeleev, filled a significant gap in the periodic table.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'as' digunakan di sini untuk merujuk pada cara atau kesesuaian dengan apa yang telah diprediksi sebelumnya (sebagaimana diprediksi).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the assembly finishes its session next month, the new trade regulations ___ for over a year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'by the time' dengan penanda waktu masa depan (next month) mengharuskan penggunaan future perfect. Karena subjek dikenai tindakan, maka bentuk pasif 'will have been debated' digunakan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The corporation decided to diversify its portfolio, ___ aiming to reduce its exposure to market volatility.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adverb 'thereby' digunakan untuk menunjukkan hasil atau cara dari tindakan sebelumnya, seringkali diikuti oleh bentuk gerund (-ing).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The greenhouse effect is a natural phenomenon ___ the earth's surface temperature is maintained at a level suitable for life.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'Whereby' adalah penghubung yang berarti 'dengan cara mana' atau 'melalui mana', sangat tepat digunakan untuk menjelaskan proses dalam suatu fenomena.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The researchers conducted a series of tests to determine ___ the new compound was stable under extreme heat.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'whether' digunakan untuk memperkenalkan noun clause yang menanyakan pilihan atau kemungkinan 'ya atau tidak' dalam konteks penelitian.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scarcely ___ the new policy been implemented when the first signs of public discontent began to surface.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'scarcely... when' memerlukan inversi dengan past perfect. Auxiliary 'had' mendahului subjek 'the new policy' sebelum past participle 'been'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The vibrant colors of the coral reef are the result of a symbiotic relationship between corals ___ tiny algae.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan kata 'between' adalah 'and' untuk menunjukkan hubungan di antara dua pihak atau entitas yang berbeda.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The manager insisted that the financial audit ___ completed before the end of the fiscal year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'insisted' diikuti oleh klausa 'that' memerlukan subjunctive mood. Bentuk pasif subjunctive menggunakan 'be' + V3 tanpa dipengaruhi waktu atau subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Geologists study the composition of rocks to understand ___ the earth's crust has changed over billions of years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Noun clause ini memerlukan kata tanya 'how' untuk menjelaskan proses atau cara perubahan kerak bumi yang telah terjadi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The semiconductor industry is highly competitive, ___ companies constantly striving to develop smaller and faster chips.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'with' di sini digunakan untuk memperkenalkan frasa yang memberikan informasi tambahan tentang keadaan atau situasi yang menyertai klausa utama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Only in recent years ___ scientists begun to fully grasp the complexities of deep-sea bioluminescence.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dipicu oleh 'only in recent years'. Karena subjeknya adalah 'scientists' (jamak) dan kata kerja 'begun' (V3), maka auxiliary yang tepat adalah 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The biodiversity of the amazon basin is so immense ___ it contains one in ten known species on earth.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan hasil atau konsekuensi dari besarnya biodiversitas tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Regardless ___ the economic climate, the company remained committed to its long-term research and development projects.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa preposisi yang tepat adalah 'regardless of', yang berarti 'terlepas dari' atau 'tanpa memedulikan'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The successful entrepreneur not only recognized the market gap but ___ to capitalize on it quickly.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk paralel dari 'not only recognized' (V2) adalah 'but (also) moved' (V2). Penempatan 'also' sebelum atau setelah kata kerja dimungkinkan, namun 'also moved' adalah yang paling lazim dalam struktur ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Legislators are currently debating a bill that would limit the amount of carbon dioxide ___ into the atmosphere.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced passive relative clause 'released' menerangkan 'carbon dioxide'. Bentuk aslinya adalah 'which is released'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The chemical properties of an atom are determined by the number of electrons ___ in its outermost shell.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past participle 'located' berfungsi sebagai adjective yang menerangkan letak elektron. Bentuk lengkapnya adalah 'which are located'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the shareholders ___ the executive board were satisfied with the initial merger proposal.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi berpasangan (correlative conjunction) yang tepat untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the federal reserve ___ to increase interest rates, the cost of borrowing for small businesses would rise.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah conditional sentence type 2. Struktur 'were to + verb' digunakan untuk menyatakan pengandaian yang kemungkinannya kecil atau formal di masa depan/sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The software engineer spent hours debugging the code ___ identify the source of the system crash.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'in order to' digunakan untuk menunjukkan tujuan (purpose) dan diikuti oleh kata kerja dasar (infinitive).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The tectonic plates move at a rate ___ to the growth of human fingernails, often just a few centimeters per year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata sifat 'comparable' digunakan untuk menerangkan hubungan perbandingan antara kecepatan gerak lempeng dan pertumbuhan kuku.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Biotechnology involves the manipulation of living organisms to develop products ___ improve human health.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'that' (atau 'which') digunakan untuk merujuk pada benda (products) sebagai subjek dari klausa penjelas.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The acidity of a solution is measured on the pH scale, ___ ranges from 0 to 14.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'which' diperlukan untuk menghubungkan informasi tambahan mengenai 'the pH scale' dalam konteks non-restrictive relative clause.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Had the voters been aware of the candidate's actual record, the election results ___ very different.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah inverted third conditional (past unreal condition). Klausa utama harus menggunakan 'would/might/could have' + past participle.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The company's marketing strategy was designed to reach as ___ potential customers as possible through digital channels.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'many' digunakan untuk memodifikasi kata benda yang dapat dihitung (countable noun) 'customers' dalam struktur perbandingan 'as... as'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The enzyme acts as a biological catalyst, ___ the activation energy required for a chemical reaction to occur.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle phrase 'lowering' memberikan informasi tambahan tentang efek atau cara kerja dari subjek (the enzyme) secara aktif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In a truly democratic society, the rule of law must apply equally to all citizens, ___ of their social status.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'irrespective of' berarti 'tanpa memandang' atau 'terlepas dari', yang sesuai dengan konteks kesetaraan di depan hukum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The widespread adoption of cloud computing has transformed ___ businesses store and manage their data.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Noun clause ini memerlukan kata hubung 'how' untuk menjelaskan cara atau metode transformasi yang dilakukan terhadap penyimpanan dan pengelolaan data.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ the ancient ruins of the forgotten city visited by tourists due to their extremely remote location in the high mountains.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat dimulai dengan kata keterangan negatif 'rarely' yang memicu inversi. Karena subjeknya adalah 'ruins' (jamak), maka auxiliary verb yang tepat untuk melengkapi kalimat pasif di masa lampau adalah 'were'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The minister of education suggested that the curriculum ___ to include more vocational training for students in rural areas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'suggested' diikuti oleh 'that' menunjukkan penggunaan subjunctive mood. Bentuk pasif dari subjunctive menggunakan 'be' + past participle tanpa dipengaruhi oleh waktu atau subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In many democratic nations, ___ a fundamental right for all citizens regardless of their gender or social background.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan subjek berupa gerund 'voting' diikuti oleh kata kerja 'is' untuk membentuk pernyataan umum tentang hak pilih.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The geologist reported that the seismic activity, ___ by a shift in the fault line, would likely subside within a few days.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bagian ini adalah reduced relative clause yang menerangkan 'seismic activity'. Bentuk aslinya 'which was caused' disederhanakan menjadi past participle 'caused' untuk menyatakan sebab.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not until the detective found the hidden key ___ realize the true motive behind the complex burglary.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'not until' di awal kalimat memicu inversi pada klausa utama. Auxiliary 'did' mendahului subjek 'he' untuk menunjukkan kejadian di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The electrical engineer designed a system that could regulate the power flow ___ the circuit from overloading.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'to prevent' (infinitive of purpose) digunakan untuk menjelaskan tujuan dari perancangan sistem tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Gender studies scholars argue that societal norms ___ heavily influence the career choices of young women in technical fields.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan kata kerja utama (main verb) yang sesuai dengan subjek jamak 'societal norms'. 'Continue to' melengkapi kalimat tersebut secara gramatikal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The magnitude of the earthquake was ___ significant that it was felt by residents living hundreds of miles away from the epicenter.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan derajat atau tingkat keparahan yang menghasilkan konsekuensi tertentu.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Political analysts predict that the upcoming election will be decided by the voters ___ in the swing districts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced relative clause 'living' (dari 'who live') berfungsi sebagai kata sifat untuk menerangkan subjek 'voters'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Only after months of rigorous investigation ___ the police obtain enough evidence to indict the suspect for the cybercrime.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi diperlukan setelah frasa 'only after'. 'Did' digunakan sebagai auxiliary sebelum subjek 'the police' untuk kata kerja 'obtain'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The geophysicist explained that the deeper the layer of the earth, ___ the pressure exerted on the rocks becomes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur perbandingan ganda (double comparative) menggunakan pola 'the more/er... the more/er...'. 'The greater' melengkapi perbandingan tersebut secara paralel.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Tourism in the region has plummeted lately, primarily ___ the rising concerns regarding political stability and safety.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'due to' digunakan sebagai preposisi yang diikuti oleh noun phrase untuk menunjukkan penyebab.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The defendant's lawyer requested that the trial ___ postponed until the new witness could be located.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penggunaan 'requested that' memicu subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk pasif, 'be' + V3 digunakan tanpa memperhatikan tenses.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In the field of electrical engineering, semiconductors are materials ___ electrical conductivity between that of a conductor and an insulator.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle phrase 'having' berfungsi sebagai penjelas aktif untuk 'materials'. Bentuk aslinya adalah 'which have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Seldom ___ women been given the same opportunities as men to lead major political parties in this particular region.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adverb negatif 'seldom' memicu inversi. Karena subjeknya adalah 'women' (jamak) dan kalimat menggunakan present perfect passive (been given), maka auxiliary 'have' adalah yang benar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The education reform bill, ___ by the senate yesterday, aims to reduce the student-to-teacher ratio in urban schools.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past participle 'passed' digunakan dalam reduced relative clause untuk menerangkan 'bill' yang menerima tindakan (pasif).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ the severe weather warnings, the group of adventurous travelers decided to proceed with their expedition to the crater.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'notwithstanding' atau 'despite' diikuti oleh noun phrase. Dalam opsi ini, keduanya secara makna mirip, namun 'notwithstanding' memberikan variasi formal yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The electrical current in a circuit is ___ proportional to the voltage applied and inversely proportional to the resistance.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adverb 'directly' diperlukan untuk menerangkan kata sifat 'proportional'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Law enforcement agencies are using advanced algorithms to identify patterns of criminal activity ___ they occur.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata penghubung 'before' memberikan makna logis bahwa identifikasi pola dilakukan sebagai langkah pencegahan sebelum kejahatan terjadi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Under no circumstances ___ the university allow unauthorized access to the students' confidential records.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ungkapan negatif 'under no circumstances' memicu inversi. Modal 'will' atau 'should' sering digunakan, namun 'should' atau 'will' di sini berfungsi untuk menegaskan kebijakan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The rock samples ___ from the volcanic site provide crucial information about the composition of the earth's mantle.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past participle 'collected' berfungsi sebagai adjective yang menerangkan 'rock samples' dalam bentuk reduced relative clause (pasif).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the political candidates ___ their supporters were prepared for the sudden shift in the public's opinion.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi korelatif 'neither' berpasangan dengan 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The development of inclusive education policies ensures that every child, regardless of ability, ___ access to quality learning.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek kalimat adalah 'every child' yang bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerja yang tepat adalah 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Geophysical surveys are essential for locating underground resources, ___ they use variations in physical properties to map the subsurface.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'for' di sini berarti 'karena', yang menghubungkan alasan mengapa survei tersebut esensial.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The suspect refused to cooperate with the investigators, ___ further complications in the high-profile criminal case.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'creating' digunakan untuk menunjukkan konsekuensi atau hasil dari tindakan sebelumnya (refusing to cooperate).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Tourism experts suggest that the historical district ___ preserved to maintain the cultural identity of the city.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penggunaan 'suggest that' memicu subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk pasif, 'be' + V3 adalah bentuk yang benar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The movement of tectonic plates is a slow process, ___ results in the formation of mountains over millions of years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'which' digunakan untuk merujuk pada keseluruhan proses yang disebutkan di klausa sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Electrical transformers are devices ___ to transfer electrical energy between two or more circuits through electromagnetic induction.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past participle 'used' dalam reduced relative clause menerangkan kegunaan dari 'transformers'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The gender gap in leadership roles is slowly closing, ___ many organizations still struggle with unconscious bias.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'but' atau 'although' bisa digunakan, namun 'but' memberikan kontras yang lebih langsung di antara dua klausa independen.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the government ___ stricter laws on environmental protection, the pollution levels in the river would have decreased.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini adalah conditional type 3 (past unreal). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan past perfect 'had enacted' karena klausa utama menggunakan 'would have decreased'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The university's board of trustees demanded that the new policy ___ by the end of the semester.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'demanded' diikuti oleh 'that' memicu penggunaan subjunctive mood. Bentuk pasif yang benar adalah 'be implemented'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Geological formations such as stalactites and stalagmites ___ thousands of years to grow just a few inches.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjeknya adalah 'geological formations' (jamak), sehingga kata kerja yang tepat adalah 'take'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Political ideologies often clash in the public sphere, ___ various groups compete for influence over policy decisions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative adverb 'where' merujuk pada 'public sphere' sebagai tempat terjadinya persaingan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The crime rate in the city has decreased significantly, ___ to the implementation of community policing programs.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'due to' menunjukkan alasan atau penyebab dari penurunan angka kriminalitas.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Hardly ___ the new tourism campaign been launched when the country experienced an unprecedented surge in international visitors.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adverb negatif 'hardly' di awal kalimat memicu inversi dengan past perfect (had + been launched) sebelum konjungsi 'when'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The resistance of a wire is determined by its material, length, and ___ area.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata sifat 'cross-sectional' diperlukan untuk menerangkan kata benda 'area' dalam daftar paralel tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many educators believe that students ___ more effectively when they are actively engaged in the learning process.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'students' (jamak) membutuhkan kata kerja present tense 'learn' untuk menyatakan kebenaran umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The geophysics professor discussed the principles of magnetism ___ to the study of the earth's magnetic field.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past participle 'applied' berfungsi sebagai reduced relative clause yang menerangkan 'principles'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Gender equality is not only a matter of justice ___ a prerequisite for sustainable economic development.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur korelatif 'not only... but (also)' digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua poin yang setara.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The detective scrutinized the crime scene evidence, ___ to find any clues that might have been overlooked.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'hoping' berfungsi sebagai adverbial phrase yang menjelaskan tujuan atau sikap subjek saat melakukan tindakan utama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Should the power outage continue for more than an hour, the emergency generators ___ automatically.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini adalah inverted conditional type 1 menggunakan 'should'. Klausa utama harus menggunakan modal future 'will'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The tourism industry provides employment opportunities for millions of people, ___ contributing to the local economy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adverb 'thereby' sering diikuti gerund untuk menunjukkan hasil atau cara dari pernyataan sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The political prisoner's release was granted on the condition that he ___ from any further political activity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'condition that' memicu subjunctive mood, di mana kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar 'refrain'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Education is often seen as a tool for social mobility, ___ individuals to improve their socioeconomic status.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'enabling' menerangkan fungsi dari 'tool' (pendidikan) secara aktif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The electrical conductivity of a metal ___ as its temperature increases due to the increased vibration of its atoms.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'electrical conductivity' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja yang tepat adalah 'decreases'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Only in the last decade ___ geologists developed the technology to map the ocean floor with such high precision.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'only in...' di awal kalimat memicu inversi. Subjeknya adalah 'geologists' (jamak), sehingga auxiliary 'have' diperlukan untuk present perfect.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Tourism in national parks must be carefully managed ___ avoid disrupting the fragile local ecosystems.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'in order to' menunjukkan tujuan dan diikuti oleh kata kerja dasar 'avoid'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Gender stereotypes in the workplace can be harmful, ___ they often limit the career advancement of talented individuals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'for' digunakan untuk memberikan alasan (karena) mengapa stereotip tersebut berbahaya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The suspect's fingerprints, ___ on the murder weapon, were used as key evidence during the criminal trial.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past participle 'found' berfungsi sebagai reduced relative clause (pasif) untuk menerangkan 'fingerprints'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: It is vital that every student ___ equal access to scholarships and financial aid programs.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'vital that' memicu penggunaan subjunctive mood, di mana kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The excavation of the ancient burial site, ___ by a team of international archaeologists, revealed artifacts dating back to the bronze age.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bagian ini memerlukan reduced relative clause dalam bentuk pasif. Bentuk aslinya adalah 'which was supervised', yang kemudian disederhanakan menjadi past participle 'supervised'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Had the medical team known about the patient's rare allergy earlier, they ___ a different type of anesthetic during the surgery.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini adalah inverted third conditional (pengandaian masa lampau). Klausa utama harus menggunakan 'would have' diikuti past participle karena 'if' clause menggunakan past perfect.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only did the renaissance painter master the technique of chiaroscuro, but he also ___ the way light interacts with various textures.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'not only... but also' memerlukan paralelisme. Karena bagian pertama menggunakan past tense (did master), maka bagian kedua harus menggunakan kata kerja bentuk past tense (revolutionized).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The bilateral trade agreement requires that each nation ___ its carbon emissions by at least fifteen percent over the next decade.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'requires' diikuti oleh 'that' memicu penggunaan subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk ini, kata kerja yang mengikuti subjek harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) tanpa akhiran -s atau -ed.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The supreme court, ___ for its landmark decisions on civil liberties, continues to play a vital role in the country's legal system.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah reduced relative clause pasif yang menerangkan 'the supreme court'. 'Known' adalah kependekan dari 'which is known'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mining engineers have developed a new method for extracting rare earth minerals ___ significant damage to the local environment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'without' harus diikuti oleh gerund (kata kerja berakhiran -ing) untuk menunjukkan cara atau kondisi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ forensic scientists found such conclusive DNA evidence at a crime scene after so many years have passed.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat dimulai dengan adverb negatif 'rarely' yang memicu inversi. Karena subjeknya jamak (scientists) dan diikuti past participle (found), maka auxiliary 'have' adalah yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The impressionist movement in art was characterized by small, thin brush strokes and ___ emphasis on the accurate depiction of light.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'emphasis' dimulai dengan bunyi vokal, sehingga artikel tak tentu yang tepat adalah 'an' untuk menunjukkan penekanan yang spesifik namun umum dalam konteks tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Under no circumstances ___ the defense attorney be allowed to present hearsay as direct evidence during the criminal trial.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa negatif 'under no circumstances' di awal kalimat memicu inversi. Modal 'should' digunakan untuk menyatakan keharusan atau aturan hukum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Archeologists believe that the ancient civilization collapsed because of a combination of soil exhaustion and ___.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Prinsip paralelisme mengharuskan item dalam daftar memiliki bentuk yang sama. 'Soil exhaustion' adalah noun phrase, sehingga harus diikuti oleh noun phrase lain seperti 'climate change'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The patient's condition stabilized after the surgeons ___ the experimental procedure to repair the damaged heart valve.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'after' menunjukkan urutan waktu. Karena kondisi pasien membaik (past tense), maka tindakan bedah yang terjadi sebelumnya harus menggunakan past perfect (had performed).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Bilateral relations between the two countries have improved significantly ___ the signing of the nuclear non-proliferation treaty.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present perfect tense ('have improved') sering dipasangkan dengan 'since' untuk menunjukkan titik waktu dimulainya suatu perubahan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Legislators are currently debating a bill that would increase the minimum sentence for individuals ___ of white-collar crimes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced relative clause pasif 'convicted' (dari 'who are convicted') menerangkan status individu yang telah dijatuhi hukuman.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The open-pit mine, ___ to be the largest in the hemisphere, produces thousands of tons of copper ore every day.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past participle 'considered' digunakan dalam appositive phrase untuk memberikan informasi tambahan pasif mengenai subjek 'the open-pit mine'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scarcely ___ the museum opened its new exhibit on ancient pottery when a large crowd of enthusiasts gathered at the entrance.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'scarcely... when' memerlukan inversi dengan past perfect. Auxiliary 'had' diletakkan sebelum subjek 'the museum'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The sculptor used a variety of tools, ___ chisels and mallets, to shape the massive block of marble into a lifelike figure.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'including' digunakan untuk memperkenalkan contoh atau bagian dari suatu kelompok benda (tools).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: It is imperative that the suspect ___ a fair trial in accordance with the principles of international human rights law.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adjective 'imperative' memicu penggunaan subjunctive mood. Kata kerja setelah 'that' harus dalam bentuk dasar 'receive'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The primary goal of diplomatic missions is to foster cooperation and ___ misunderstandings between sovereign states.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Prinsip paralelisme menghubungkan dua infinitive. 'To foster... and (to) reduce'. 'To' pada kata kerja kedua sering dihilangkan tetapi bentuknya tetap dasar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern medicine relies on the use of antibiotics to treat infections, ___ they are often prescribed inappropriately by some practitioners.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'yet' digunakan untuk menunjukkan kontras yang mengejutkan antara ketergantungan pada antibiotik dan penggunaan yang tidak tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The deeper the mining shaft goes into the earth's crust, ___ the temperature of the surrounding rock becomes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur perbandingan ganda (double comparative) menggunakan pola 'the more/er... the more/er...'. 'The higher' melengkapi struktur tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Forensic evidence, such as fingerprints and ballistics reports, ___ crucial in securing a conviction in the murder trial.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'evidence' dalam bahasa Inggris sering dianggap uncountable (tunggal), namun dalam konteks hukum tertentu atau jika merujuk pada banyak item bukti yang berbeda (reports), penggunaan 'were' di masa lampau sering ditemukan jika merujuk pada pluralitas bukti.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The treaty states that neither country ___ engage in any form of military aggression against the other for a period of fifty years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam bahasa hukum atau perjanjian formal, modal 'shall' digunakan untuk menyatakan kewajiban atau janji yang mengikat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The archaeologist painstakingly brushed away the dirt, ___ not to damage the fragile remains of the ancient scroll.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle phrase 'being careful' berfungsi sebagai adverbial yang menjelaskan sikap atau kondisi subjek saat melakukan tindakan utama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Biological agents can be used as weapons in criminal acts, ___ it difficult for investigators to identify the source of the attack.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'making' digunakan untuk menunjukkan konsekuensi atau hasil dari pernyataan di klausa sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The art restorer worked meticulously on the painting, ___ that every brush stroke was returned to its original glory.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'ensuring' digunakan untuk menunjukkan tindakan yang menyertai atau merupakan bagian dari proses restorasi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mining for gold in the region has been suspended ___ the discovery of several rare plant species in the vicinity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'due to' adalah preposisi yang tepat diikuti oleh noun phrase untuk menunjukkan alasan penangguhan aktivitas pertambangan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Legal experts recommend that the new law ___ gradually to allow the public enough time to adapt to the changes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'recommend' memicu subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk pasif, 'be' + past participle adalah bentuk yang benar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The doctor advised the patient to avoid strenuous activity, eat a balanced diet, and ___ plenty of rest.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Paralelisme dalam daftar instruksi. 'To avoid..., (to) eat..., and (to) get...'. Infinitive tanpa 'to' adalah pilihan yang paling tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Only in the last few years ___ archeologists began to use lidar technology to map vast areas of dense jungle.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dipicu oleh 'only in...'. Karena subjeknya jamak (archeologists) dan bentuk kata kerjanya adalah present perfect (begun/began), maka auxiliary 'have' diperlukan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The bilateral commission was established to resolve disputes ___ to the shared water resources along the border.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'relating' (yang berkaitan) berfungsi sebagai penjelas aktif untuk 'disputes'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The high court's decision was ___ controversial that it sparked protests in several major cities across the country.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan derajat intensitas yang mengakibatkan protes tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Forensic pathology is a branch of medicine ___ with the determination of the cause of death in suspicious circumstances.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past participle 'concerned' (yang berkaitan dengan) berfungsi sebagai penjelas pasif untuk 'branch of medicine'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Regardless ___ the evidence presented by the prosecution, the jury was unable to reach a unanimous verdict.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa preposisi yang tepat adalah 'regardless of' yang berarti 'terlepas dari' atau 'tanpa memedulikan'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Archaeological surveys indicate that the ancient city was once a thriving center of trade ___ of its strategic location.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'due to' digunakan untuk memberikan alasan yang diikuti oleh noun phrase 'its strategic location'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The artist's latest sculpture was ___ impressive that it was immediately purchased by a private collector.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' untuk menyatakan hasil dari impresi patung tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Criminal profiling is a technique used by investigators to predict the characteristics of an unknown offender ___ on their behavior.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past participle 'based' (berdasarkan) digunakan untuk menerangkan dasar dari teknik pemrofilan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The bilateral agreement on extradition was signed by both presidents, ___ to a new era of cooperation in law enforcement.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'leading' digunakan untuk menunjukkan hasil atau konsekuensi yang mengikuti tindakan utama secara aktif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: It is essential that the mining company ___ the local community about the potential health risks of the new project.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adjective 'essential' memicu subjunctive mood. Kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar 'inform'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Medical researchers have found that the new drug is effective ___ patients who have not responded to conventional treatments.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'in' (pada) sering digunakan untuk menunjukkan subjek atau kelompok yang mengalami efek dari pengobatan medis.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The ancient fortress, ___ on a high cliff overlooking the sea, provided a formidable defense against invaders.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past participle 'situated' berfungsi sebagai penjelas pasif yang menerangkan lokasi dari 'the ancient fortress'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Should the evidence ___ by the forensic team be tampered with, the entire criminal investigation would be compromised.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah reduced relative clause pasif 'collected' (dari 'which was collected') yang menerangkan 'evidence' di dalam struktur conditional.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The bilateral summit focused on trade liberalization and ___ barriers to the movement of goods and services.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Paralelisme setelah preposisi 'on'. 'On trade liberalization and (on) removing barriers'. Keduanya berfungsi sebagai objek preposisi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Archeologists have recently unearthed a series of frescoes that provide a glimpse ___ the daily life of the ancient civilization.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Idiom 'a glimpse into' digunakan untuk menyatakan penglihatan sekilas atau pemahaman mendalam tentang sesuatu hal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The court ruled that the search warrant was invalid, ___ that the evidence obtained from the suspect's home was inadmissible.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'meaning' digunakan untuk menjelaskan konsekuensi logis dari keputusan pengadilan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mining operations in the area have resulted in significant deforestation and ___ of the local groundwater.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Paralelisme antara dua kata benda: 'deforestation' dan 'contamination'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The renaissance artist was known for his mastery of perspective and ___ to capture subtle human emotions on canvas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Paralelisme antara dua noun phrase: 'his mastery' dan 'his ability'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Medical ethics requires that doctors ___ the confidentiality of their patients' records at all times.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'requires' memicu subjunctive mood. Kata kerja setelah 'that' harus dalam bentuk dasar 'maintain'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The bilateral treaty was intended to promote economic stability, ___ it failed to address the issue of currency fluctuations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'yet' memberikan kontras yang tepat antara maksud awal perjanjian dan kegagalannya dalam menangani fluktuasi mata uang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Criminal law distinguishes between felonies, which are serious crimes, and ___ which are less severe offenses.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Paralelisme antara dua kata benda jamak untuk mengelompokkan jenis kejahatan: 'felonies' dan 'misdemeanors'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Archeologists have identified a previously unknown tomb that ___ to have belonged to a high-ranking official of the Old Kingdom.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif 'is believed' (diyakini) diperlukan untuk menyatakan konsensus atau pendapat para arkeolog mengenai kepemilikan makam tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The traditional healing practices of the indigenous community, ___ for generations, are now being studied by modern medical researchers for their efficacy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bagian ini memerlukan reduced relative clause dalam bentuk pasif. Bentuk aslinya adalah 'which have been preserved', yang kemudian disederhanakan menjadi past participle 'preserved'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ the complex mathematical equation, but she also applied it to solve a real-world engineering problem.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'not only' di awal kalimat memerlukan inversi subjek dan kata kerja bantu. Karena kalimat menggunakan past tense, maka 'did she solve' adalah bentuk yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The maritime law specifies that every vessel entering the territorial waters ___ a valid international safety certificate.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'specifies that' dalam konteks aturan formal sering diikuti oleh subjunctive mood atau kata kerja dasar (bare infinitive). 'Carry' adalah bentuk yang tepat untuk menunjukkan persyaratan hukum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Public health officials insist that the new vaccination program ___ implemented immediately to prevent a widespread outbreak.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'insist' diikuti oleh 'that' memicu penggunaan subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk pasif, 'be' + past participle adalah bentuk yang benar tanpa mempedulikan tenses.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Under no circumstances ___ the defendant be forced to testify against themselves in a court of law according to the constitution.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa negatif 'under no circumstances' di awal kalimat memicu inversi. Modal 'can' atau 'should' bisa digunakan, namun 'should' atau 'can' di sini merujuk pada hak hukum yang tidak dapat diganggu gugat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>mathematics</u> professor <u>explained</u> that <u>there is</u> many <u>complex</u> <u>theories</u> regarding prime numbers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penggunaan 'there is' salah karena subjek setelahnya adalah 'many complex theories' yang berbentuk jamak. Seharusnya menggunakan 'there are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely <u>has</u> the <u>maritime</u> industry <u>seen</u> such <u>a</u> rapid <u>technological advancement</u> as in the last decade.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'technological advancement' seharusnya berbentuk jamak 'technological advancements' karena merujuk pada kemajuan-kemajuan secara umum, atau menggunakan artikel yang tepat untuk menunjukkan kategori umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>community's</u> <u>customs</u> and <u>tradition</u> <u>have</u> been <u>passed</u> down through oral storytelling.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'tradition' seharusnya paralel dengan 'customs' yang berbentuk jamak, sehingga menjadi 'traditions'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>national</u> budget <u>allocation</u> for <u>healthcare</u> services <u>is</u> <u>relative</u> low compared to other countries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'relative' seharusnya berbentuk adverb 'relatively' untuk menerangkan kata sifat 'low'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>criminal</u> <u>was</u> <u>arrest</u> by the police <u>shortly</u> after <u>the</u> incident occurred.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini pasif, sehingga kata kerja setelah 'was' harus dalam bentuk past participle (V3), yaitu 'arrested'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Calculus, ___ is a branch of mathematics, deals with the study of continuous change and rates of change.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'which' digunakan untuk memberikan informasi tambahan mengenai subjek non-manusia (Calculus) dalam non-defining relative clause.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sociologists argue that society ___ by the collective actions and beliefs of its individual members.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini memerlukan bentuk pasif 'is influenced' untuk menyatakan bahwa masyarakat dipengaruhi oleh tindakan kolektif anggotanya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The maritime boundary dispute between the two nations ___ through several rounds of diplomatic negotiations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'the maritime boundary dispute' memerlukan kata kerja pasif. 'Was solved' adalah bentuk lampau yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The head of state suggested that the new economic policy ___ carefully before being implemented nationwide.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penggunaan 'suggested that' memicu subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk pasif, 'be' + V3 adalah bentuk yang benar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In many cultures, respecting elders is considered a sacred duty ___ by the younger generation for centuries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced relative clause pasif 'followed' menerangkan tugas suci yang dijalankan oleh generasi muda.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>prevention</u> of <u>diseases</u> <u>is</u> <u>more</u> effective <u>than to treat</u> them.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Paralelisme diperlukan dalam perbandingan. 'Prevention' (noun) harus dibandingkan dengan noun atau gerund. Seharusnya 'treating them' atau membandingkan 'to prevent' dengan 'to treat'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>detective</u> <u>collected</u> <u>enough</u> <u>evidences</u> to <u>prosecute</u> the suspect.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'evidence' adalah uncountable noun dan tidak memiliki bentuk jamak (evidences). Seharusnya tetap 'evidence'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Despite</u> the <u>stormy</u> <u>weather</u>, the <u>maritime</u> vessel <u>reach</u> the harbor on time.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini merujuk pada kejadian lampau atau memerlukan persetujuan subjek-kata kerja. Seharusnya 'reached' (lampau).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>mathematical</u> <u>solution</u> <u>provided</u> by the student <u>was</u> <u>correctly</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah linking verb 'was', seharusnya menggunakan kata sifat (adjective) 'correct', bukan kata keterangan (adverb) 'correctly'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Every</u> citizen <u>has</u> <u>their</u> own <u>responsibility</u> to <u>maintain</u> the peace of the nation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Every citizen' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata ganti posesifnya seharusnya 'his or her', bukan 'their' (walaupun 'their' mulai diterima secara informal, dalam TOEFL standar ini dianggap salah).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The maritime ecosystems around the archipelago are threatened by overfishing and ___ of industrial waste.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Paralelisme antara dua gerund atau noun phrase: 'overfishing' dan 'dumping'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Only in the last decade ___ scientists begun to understand the complex relationship between gut health and mental well-being.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dipicu oleh 'only in...'. Karena subjeknya jamak (scientists) dan diikuti past participle (begun), maka auxiliary 'have' diperlukan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The ancient custom requires that the village elder ___ the ceremony before the sun sets.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'requires that' memicu subjunctive mood. Kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar 'start' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The criminal investigation was hindered by a lack of physical evidence ___ the suspects refused to cooperate with the police.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata hubung 'and' digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua alasan atau hambatan dalam investigasi kriminal tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mathematical models are used to predict weather patterns, ___ they are not always a hundred percent accurate.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata hubung 'but' memberikan kontras yang tepat antara kegunaan model matematika dan keterbatasan akurasinya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>goverment</u> <u>is</u> <u>planning</u> to <u>increase</u> the <u>healthcare</u> budget next year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kesalahan pengejaan (spelling error). Seharusnya 'Government' (kurang huruf 'n').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>mathematical</u> <u>proof</u> <u>was</u> <u>so</u> <u>elegance</u> that it impressed the entire faculty.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'so', seharusnya menggunakan kata sifat (adjective) 'elegant', bukan kata benda (noun) 'elegance'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Maritime</u> <u>laws</u> <u>is</u> <u>enforced</u> to <u>protect</u> marine life in the ocean.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Maritime laws' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>According</u> to the <u>criminal</u> <u>law</u>, the <u>suspect</u> <u>is</u> innocence until proven guilty.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Seharusnya menggunakan kata sifat 'innocent' setelah linking verb 'is', bukan kata benda 'innocence'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Traditions</u> <u>and</u> customs <u>reflects</u> the <u>identity</u> of a <u>society</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Traditions and customs' adalah jamak, maka kata kerjanya tidak boleh menggunakan akhiran -s. Seharusnya 'reflect'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The health benefits of regular exercise ___ by numerous scientific studies over the past few decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'health benefits' adalah jamak, sehingga memerlukan bentuk pasif present perfect 'have been demonstrated'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Maritime navigation has become much safer ___ the invention of the Global Positioning System.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'since' digunakan untuk menunjukkan titik awal waktu di mana suatu perubahan dimulai dalam bentuk present perfect.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In mathematical logic, a statement is either true ___ false, with no middle ground.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan kata korelatif dari 'either' adalah 'or'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The governor ordered that the state of emergency ___ extended for another thirty days due to the health crisis.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'ordered that' memicu subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk pasif, 'be' + V3 adalah bentuk yang benar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A person convicted of a felony may lose certain civil rights, ___ the right to vote in some jurisdictions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'including' digunakan untuk memperkenalkan contoh atau bagian dari kategori 'civil rights'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>archaeologist</u> <u>found</u> a <u>set</u> of <u>tools</u> <u>who</u> belonged to the prehistoric era.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'who' hanya digunakan untuk manusia. Untuk 'tools', seharusnya menggunakan 'that' atau 'which'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Chinese Zodiac, or Shio, consists of twelve animal signs that ___ a twelve-year cycle based on the lunar calendar.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek dalam anak klausa adalah 'animal signs' (jamak), sehingga kata kerja yang mengikuti relative pronoun 'that' harus dalam bentuk dasar untuk fakta umum (simple present), yaitu 'represent'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>lawyer</u> <u>defending</u> the <u>suspect</u> <u>argue</u> that <u>there was</u> no motive for the crime.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek tunggal 'The lawyer' membutuhkan kata kerja tunggal 'argues' (dengan akhiran -s).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>maritime</u> <u>route</u> <u>was</u> <u>close</u> due to <u>heavy</u> fog.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif 'was' harus diikuti past participle 'closed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Mathematical</u> <u>equations</u> <u>helps</u> engineers <u>to design</u> safe <u>structures</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Mathematical equations' jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya seharusnya 'help', bukan 'helps'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Had the maritime security been tighter, the smugglers ___ the forbidden items into the country.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inverted third conditional. Klausa utama harus menggunakan 'would have' + V3 karena klausa pengandaian menggunakan past perfect.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The complex societal issues ___ by the committee were debated for several days without resolution.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced relative clause pasif 'addressed' menerangkan isu-isu masyarakat yang dibahas oleh komite.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Adhering to traditional customs is important for preserving cultural heritage, ___ some modern practices may seem more efficient.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'although' memberikan kontras yang tepat antara pentingnya adat dan efisiensi praktik modern.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The medical clinic provides free health screenings for the elderly ___ on low incomes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'who' diikuti oleh kata kerja 'are' untuk menerangkan subjek manusia (the elderly).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In geometry, the sum of the angles in a triangle is ___ equal to one hundred and eighty degrees.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata keterangan 'always' melengkapi fakta matematika yang tetap.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: According to the <u>latest</u> <u>report</u>, the <u>society's</u> well-being <u>is improving</u> <u>gradual</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Seharusnya menggunakan adverb 'gradually' untuk menerangkan proses 'is improving'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>criminal</u> suspect <u>denied</u> <u>committed</u> the <u>burglary</u> <u>at</u> the museum.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'deny' harus diikuti oleh gerund (-ing). Seharusnya 'denied committing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Traditional</u> <u>law</u> is still <u>observe</u> in <u>some</u> <u>remote</u> villages.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat pasif, seharusnya 'is still observed' (V3).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>mathematics</u> test was <u>so difficult</u> that <u>many</u> <u>student</u> <u>failed</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'many' harus diikuti oleh kata benda jamak, yaitu 'students'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Maritime</u> <u>security patrols</u> <u>is</u> necessary to <u>prevent</u> <u>piracy</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'security patrols' adalah jamak, maka kata kerjanya harus 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The scholarly journal requires that every submitted manuscript ___ a rigorous peer-review process before being considered for publication.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'requires' yang diikuti oleh klausa 'that' memerlukan penggunaan subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk ini, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) tanpa akhiran -s meskipun subjeknya tunggal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Only after years of social activism ___ many democratic nations begin to legally recognize the rights of the LGBT community.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'only after' di awal kalimat memicu inversi. Karena kalimat merujuk pada proses yang dimulai di masa lampau, auxiliary 'did' diperlukan sebelum subjek 'nations' untuk mendampingi kata kerja dasar 'begin'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>cinematography</u> in <u>the</u> movie <u>was</u> <u>so</u> <u>beauty</u> that it won several international awards.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah adverb 'so', seharusnya menggunakan kata sifat (adjective) 'beautiful', bukan kata benda (noun) 'beauty'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scientific research involves <u>formulate</u> a <u>hypothesis</u>, <u>conducting</u> experiments, <u>and</u> <u>analyzing</u> data.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Prinsip paralelisme mengharuskan semua item dalam daftar memiliki bentuk yang sama. Karena item lainnya menggunakan gerund (conducting, analyzing), maka 'formulate' seharusnya menjadi 'formulating'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern paintings often challenge traditional concepts of sexuality, ___ viewers to reconsider their preconceived notions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'prompting' digunakan untuk menunjukkan hasil atau konsekuensi aktif dari tindakan yang dijelaskan pada klausa utama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>freedom</u> of <u>press</u> <u>is</u> <u>essential</u> to <u>the</u> maintenance of a democracy society.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'democracy' adalah kata benda. Seharusnya menggunakan kata sifat (adjective) 'democratic' untuk menerangkan kata benda 'society'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scarcely <u>had</u> the <u>news</u> <u>broken</u> <u>when</u> the public <u>respond</u> with widespread protests.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan struktur 'scarcely... when' dalam konteks lampau. Seharusnya kata kerja 'respond' menggunakan bentuk past tense 'responded'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Under no circumstances ___ a democratic government suppress peaceful demonstrations by its citizens.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ungkapan negatif 'under no circumstances' memicu inversi. Modal 'should' tepat digunakan untuk menyatakan larangan atau kewajiban moral dalam konteks kenegaraan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The composer's music is noted for its intricate melodies and ___ of various cultural influences.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Paralelisme antara dua noun phrase. 'Melodies' berpasangan dengan 'fusion' untuk melengkapi objek dari preposisi 'for'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely <u>do</u> <u>scientific</u> <u>publications</u> <u>includes</u> <u>unverified</u> data in their final reports.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Auxiliary 'do' sudah menunjukkan pluralitas. Kata kerja utama setelah subjek 'publications' seharusnya dalam bentuk dasar 'include', bukan 'includes'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The documentary film, ___ by several independent journalists, exposed the deep-seated corruption within the local government.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'investigating' (yang menginvestigasi) berfungsi sebagai penjelas aktif untuk subjek 'film'. Namun jika konteksnya film tersebut dikerjakan oleh mereka (pasif), maka 'investigated' lebih tepat. Mari kita asumsikan 'investigating' adalah penjelas aktif mengenai aktivitas film tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Legislators <u>proposed</u> that the <u>new</u> <u>bill</u> <u>protects</u> the <u>rights</u> of minority groups.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'proposed' memicu subjunctive mood. Kata kerja 'protects' seharusnya dalam bentuk dasar 'protect' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ the artist depict the physical form, but he also captured the emotional essence of the subject.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi diperlukan setelah 'not only' di awal kalimat. 'Did' digunakan untuk menunjukkan waktu lampau yang selaras dengan 'captured'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>misinformation</u> <u>spreaded</u> <u>quickly</u> <u>through</u> social media <u>platforms</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'spread' adalah irregular verb yang bentuk past tense dan past participle-nya tetap 'spread', bukan 'spreaded'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Democratic societies rely on an informed electorate ___ for the long-term stability of the political system.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative clause 'which is vital' diperlukan untuk menerangkan pentingnya 'informed electorate' bagi stabilitas sistem.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>researcher</u> <u>spent</u> <u>months</u> <u>analyzed</u> the <u>results</u> of the survey.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'spend time + gerund' mengharuskan kata kerja 'analyze' menggunakan bentuk -ing, yaitu 'analyzing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Seldom ___ political candidates address the specific concerns of the LGBT community during national televised debates.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dipicu oleh adverb negatif 'seldom'. 'Do' digunakan sebagai auxiliary untuk subjek jamak 'candidates'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The award-winning <u>musical</u> <u>features</u> a <u>diverse</u> <u>casting</u> of talented <u>performers</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'casting' merujuk pada proses pemilihan, sedangkan untuk merujuk pada sekelompok pemain, seharusnya menggunakan kata 'cast'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: It is essential that <u>the</u> <u>news</u> <u>be</u> <u>report</u> fairly and <u>objectively</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam struktur subjunctive pasif (be + V3), kata kerja 'report' seharusnya menjadi 'reported'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the <u>publisher</u> <u>nor</u> the <u>authors</u> <u>was</u> <u>responsible</u> for the error.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam struktur 'neither... nor', kata kerja harus menyesuaikan dengan subjek terdekat. 'Authors' adalah jamak, maka seharusnya menggunakan 'were'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The abstract expressionist movement emphasized the act of painting itself ___ representing recognizable objects.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'rather than' digunakan untuk menunjukkan pilihan atau preferensi antara dua hal yang dibandingkan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The legal <u>recognition</u> of same-sex marriage <u>has</u> <u>became</u> a <u>global</u> <u>issue</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah auxiliary 'has', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk past participle (V3). Bentuk V3 dari 'become' adalah 'become', bukan 'became'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ the controversial nature of the film, it managed to attract a massive audience during its opening weekend.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'despite' diikuti oleh noun phrase untuk menunjukkan kontras. 'Although' atau 'even though' memerlukan klausa lengkap.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The journalist <u>refused</u> to <u>reveal</u> <u>their</u> sources <u>despite</u> the <u>pressure</u> from the authorities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The journalist' adalah tunggal. Walaupun penggunaan 'their' mulai lazim sebagai gender-neutral, dalam standar TOEFL tradisional, seharusnya menggunakan 'his or her'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In a democracy, the right to vote is a fundamental power ___ to all eligible citizens regardless of their sexual orientation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced relative clause pasif 'granted' (dari 'which is granted') menerangkan hak yang diberikan kepada warga negara.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>scientific</u> method <u>requires</u> <u>that</u> each step <u>is</u> documented <u>carefully</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'requires' memicu subjunctive mood. 'Is documented' seharusnya menjadi 'be documented'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Hardly <u>had</u> the orchestra <u>begun</u> to play <u>than</u> the audience <u>started</u> to <u>cheer</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan yang tepat untuk 'hardly' adalah 'when', bukan 'than'. Struktur 'hardly... when' digunakan untuk menunjukkan kejadian yang berurutan cepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Democracy thrives when there is transparency, accountability, and ___ engagement from the public.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata sifat 'active' diperlukan untuk menerangkan kata benda 'engagement' agar paralel dengan struktur kata benda lainnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The painter <u>used</u> <u>vibrant</u> <u>colors</u> to <u>conveying</u> a sense of <u>joy</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'to' yang berfungsi sebagai tujuan (infinitive of purpose), seharusnya menggunakan kata kerja dasar 'convey', bukan gerund 'conveying'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>publication</u> of <u>sensitive</u> information <u>can</u> <u>has</u> serious <u>consequences</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal 'can', kata kerja harus selalu dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'have', bukan 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Medical publications often discuss how hormonal shifts influence ___ and emotional health in adolescents.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata benda 'sexuality' diperlukan untuk melengkapi objek dari kata kerja 'influence' agar setara dengan 'emotional health'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The movie <u>director</u> <u>insisted</u> that every <u>scene</u> <u>being</u> <u>filmed</u> in natural light.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'insisted' memicu subjunctive mood. Bentuk pasif yang benar adalah 'be filmed', bukan 'being filmed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: No sooner <u>had</u> the painting <u>unveiled</u> <u>than</u> it <u>received</u> unanimous <u>praise</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'painting' seharusnya menerima tindakan (pasif). Seharusnya 'had the painting been unveiled'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: During the Ming Dynasty, the Great Wall of China ___ extensively to protect the empire from northern invasions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks kalimat adalah masa lampau yang spesifik (Ming Dynasty). Karena tembok tersebut menerima tindakan, maka digunakan simple past passive 'was rebuilt'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>rise</u> of fake news <u>is</u> <u>threatened</u> the <u>credibility</u> of modern <u>journalism</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini harus dalam bentuk aktif sedang berlangsung (continuous). Seharusnya 'is threatening' (sedang mengancam), bukan 'is threatened' (diancam).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the <u>voters</u> <u>had known</u> the truth, the <u>outcome</u> of the <u>election</u> <u>would</u> <u>be</u> different.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat pengandaian tipe 3 (past unreal). Klausa utama seharusnya menggunakan 'would have been', bukan 'would be'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The demographic <u>changes</u> in the region <u>have</u> <u>led</u> to a <u>shift</u> in <u>politics</u> alignment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Seharusnya menggunakan kata sifat 'political' untuk menerangkan kata benda 'alignment', bukan kata benda 'politics'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Music therapy is becoming increasingly popular as a method to help individuals cope with emotional and ___ distress.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata sifat 'psychological' diperlukan agar paralel dengan 'emotional' dalam menerangkan 'distress'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>scientific</u> <u>community</u> <u>have</u> not yet <u>reached</u> a consensus <u>on</u> the matter.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'community' adalah collective noun yang dianggap tunggal dalam konteks ini. Seharusnya menggunakan 'has', bukan 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Every</u> journalist <u>must</u> <u>adheres</u> to the code of ethics <u>established</u> by the press <u>council</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal 'must', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar 'adhere', bukan 'adheres'.
