Structure and Written Expression.teks: The film's <u>success</u> <u>was</u> <u>primarily</u> <u>attributing</u> to <u>its</u> engaging storyline.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat pasif, seharusnya menggunakan past participle 'attributed' setelah linking verb 'was'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Published research often reveals that societal attitudes toward LGBT individuals ___ significantly across different cultures.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'vary' diperlukan untuk melengkapi klausa tersebut dengan subjek jamak 'attitudes'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The painting <u>was</u> <u>originally</u> <u>exhibit</u> in a <u>small</u> <u>gallery</u> in Paris.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif 'was... exhibit' salah. Seharusnya 'was exhibited' (past participle).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In a democracy, the accountability of public officials is maintained through regular and ___ elections.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata sifat 'fair' (adil) diperlukan agar paralel dengan kata sifat 'regular' dalam menerangkan 'elections'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the government ___ the new policy earlier, the economic impact of the recession would have been less severe.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect ('had + V3') karena klausa utamanya menggunakan 'would have been'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many rural villages lack access to clean water, ___ them vulnerable to various waterborne diseases.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Participle Phrase ('making') digunakan untuk menunjukkan hasil atau konsekuensi dari kondisi yang dijelaskan di klausa utama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sustainable agriculture focuses on the production of food ___ the natural resources for future generations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Gerund ('preserving') diletakkan setelah konjungsi 'while' untuk menunjukkan tindakan yang dilakukan secara bersamaan dengan fokus utama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ the public's lack of interest in the topic, the news agency decided to stop reporting on the story.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa preposisi 'due to' digunakan untuk menunjukkan alasan yang diikuti oleh noun phrase.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the manager ___ the employees expected the sudden increase in customer demand during the holiday season.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan konjungsi korelasi yang tepat untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The development of a new vaccine ___ to take several years of clinical trials before it can be distributed to the public.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The development' tunggal. Kalimat pasif Simple Present 'is expected' (diharapkan/diperkirakan) adalah bentuk yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ the central bank intervene in the foreign exchange market unless there is excessive volatility in the local currency.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat dimulai dengan kata keterangan negatif 'rarely' yang memicu inversi. Karena kalimat menyatakan kebiasaan atau fakta umum (present tense), maka auxiliary verb yang tepat untuk subjek tunggal 'the central bank' adalah 'does'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>marketing</u> manager <u>suggested</u> that the <u>sales team</u> <u>launches</u> the new campaign <u>next month</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'suggested' memicu penggunaan subjunctive mood. Dalam klausa 'that', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) tanpa akhiran -s/es. Seharusnya 'launch', bukan 'launches'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the new engine model is released next year, the engineers ___ on its fuel efficiency for over three years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'by the time' yang merujuk pada masa depan memerlukan Future Perfect Continuous Tense untuk menunjukkan durasi suatu kegiatan yang akan sudah berlangsung. Polanya adalah 'will have been' + V-ing.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ a nation's economy recover from a massive debt crisis without significant structural reforms and international support.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan inversi karena dimulai dengan adverb negatif 'rarely'. Karena kata kerja utamanya adalah 'recover' (bentuk dasar), maka auxiliary yang tepat adalah 'does' untuk subjek tunggal 'economy'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The pediatrician recommended that the mother ___ her child's nutritional intake to ensure optimal physical development during the first year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'recommended' diikuti oleh klausa 'that' memerlukan penggunaan subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk ini, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the new sales strategy is fully implemented next quarter, the company ___ its revenue targets for three consecutive years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'by the time' yang diikuti simple present (is implemented) dan merujuk ke masa depan memerlukan Future Perfect Tense (will have + V3) untuk menunjukkan aksi yang akan sudah selesai.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Cybersecurity experts emphasize that doxing, which involves the public release of private information, ___ serious legal consequences for the perpetrator.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama kalimat adalah 'doxing' (tunggal). Oleh karena itu, kata kerja dalam simple present harus menggunakan akhiran -s, yaitu 'carries'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>reproduction</u> rate of the <u>endangered</u> species <u>has</u> <u>became</u> <u>critically</u> low in recent years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah auxiliary 'has' dalam Present Perfect, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk past participle (V3). Bentuk V3 dari 'become' adalah 'become', bukan 'became'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Effective parenting <u>requires</u> that <u>a</u> parent <u>is</u> <u>patient</u> and <u>consistent</u> with discipline.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'requires' memicu subjunctive mood. Kata kerja 'is' seharusnya diganti menjadi bentuk dasar yaitu 'be'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>sales team</u> <u>has been working</u> on <u>the</u> proposal <u>for</u> <u>three hours</u> when the power went out.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Karena ada keterangan waktu lampau 'when the power went out', maka aksi yang sudah berlangsung sebelumnya harus menggunakan Past Perfect Continuous, yaitu 'had been working', bukan 'has been working'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Under no circumstances ___ the identity of sexual harassment victims be disclosed to the media without their explicit consent.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa negatif 'under no circumstances' memicu inversi. Modal 'should' adalah yang paling tepat untuk menyatakan kewajiban atau saran kebijakan yang kuat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>increase</u> in <u>online violence</u> <u>among</u> adolescents <u>are</u> a <u>major concern</u> for sociologists.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama kalimat adalah 'increase' (tunggal), bukan 'adolescents'. Maka kata kerja 'are' seharusnya diganti menjadi 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Child development <u>specialists</u> <u>believe</u> that <u>early</u> childhood <u>is</u> the <u>most criticalest</u> stage of growth.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk superlatif 'most criticalest' adalah double superlative yang salah. Seharusnya cukup 'most critical'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the <u>marketing manager</u> <u>had known</u> about the <u>economic recession</u>, he <u>would adjust</u> the <u>sales projections</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Type 3 (pengandaian masa lampau). Klausa utama seharusnya menggunakan 'would have adjusted' untuk berpasangan dengan 'had known'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Doxing, <u>which</u> is a <u>malicious</u> act, <u>involved</u> <u>gathering</u> <u>private information</u> about an individual.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menyatakan definisi atau fakta umum yang berlaku sekarang. Seharusnya menggunakan present tense 'involves', bukan past tense 'involved'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the sales director ___ the regional managers were satisfied with the results of the recent market survey.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi korelatif yang berpasangan dengan 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>reproduction</u> cycle of mammals <u>varies</u> <u>significant</u> <u>from</u> <u>species</u> to species.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'varies' adalah kata kerja yang harus diterangkan oleh kata keterangan (adverb). Seharusnya 'significantly', bukan kata sifat 'significant'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ the perpetrator dox the victim, but he also used the information to incite physical violence.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'not only' di awal kalimat memicu inversi. Karena bagian kedua menggunakan past tense (used), maka bagian pertama juga harus menggunakan past tense (did).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>successful</u> parenting approach <u>emphasizes</u> <u>nurture</u>, <u>guidance</u>, and <u>to understand</u> a child's needs.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Prinsip paralelisme mengharuskan semua item dalam daftar memiliki bentuk yang sama. Karena 'nurture' dan 'guidance' adalah kata benda, maka 'to understand' harus diganti menjadi 'understanding' atau 'understanding of'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sexual harassment <u>can</u> <u>occurs</u> <u>in</u> <u>various</u> settings, <u>including</u> the workplace and educational institutions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal verb 'can', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive). Seharusnya 'occur', bukan 'occurs'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Economic <u>growth</u> is <u>measured</u> by the <u>increase</u> in the <u>nation's</u> <u>grossly</u> domestic product.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Istilah ekonomi yang benar adalah 'gross domestic product'. Kata 'grossly' adalah adverb yang salah penempatannya; seharusnya menggunakan kata sifat 'gross'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>reproduction system</u> <u>is</u> <u>responsible</u> <u>for</u> the <u>production</u> of gametes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'reproduction' adalah kata benda. Untuk menerangkan sistem tersebut, sebaiknya menggunakan kata sifat (adjective) 'reproductive system'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Parenting <u>is</u> a <u>difficult</u> task <u>who</u> <u>requires</u> a <u>lot</u> of patience.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'who' hanya digunakan untuk manusia. Karena merujuk pada 'task' (hal/benda), seharusnya menggunakan 'that' atau 'which'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sales <u>revenue</u> <u>increased</u> sharply <u>since</u> the new <u>marketing</u> campaign <u>launched</u> last month.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penggunaan kata 'since' menunjukkan bahwa aksi dimulai di masa lalu dan berlanjut hingga sekarang. Seharusnya menggunakan Present Perfect 'has increased', bukan simple past 'increased'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Doxing <u>is</u> <u>not only</u> <u>illegal</u> <u>but also</u> <u>it is</u> unethical.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'not only... but also' memerlukan paralelisme. Setelah 'but also' seharusnya langsung diikuti oleh adjective 'unethical' agar sejajar dengan 'illegal'. Kata 'it is' berlebihan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>victim</u> <u>was</u> <u>force</u> to <u>relive</u> the trauma during the <u>trial</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur pasif (be + V3). Seharusnya menggunakan past participle 'forced', bukan 'force'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Child <u>growth</u> <u>depends on</u> <u>properly</u> <u>nutrition</u> and a <u>healthy</u> environment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'nutrition' adalah kata benda yang harus diterangkan oleh kata sifat (adjective). Seharusnya 'proper', bukan adverb 'properly'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Hardly ___ the sales team reached their monthly target when the market volatility caused a sharp decline in stock prices.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'hardly... when' memerlukan inversi dengan past perfect. Auxiliary 'had' diletakkan sebelum subjek 'the sales team'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>economic</u> recession <u>has</u> <u>affected</u> <u>on</u> the <u>buying power</u> of consumers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'affect' adalah kata kerja transitif yang langsung diikuti oleh objek tanpa preposisi. Kata 'on' seharusnya dihilangkan (berbeda dengan kata benda 'effect' yang diikuti 'on').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Reproducing</u> is a <u>fundamental</u> biological <u>process</u> <u>for</u> all <u>living things</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Meskipun 'reproducing' adalah gerund, dalam konteks biologi sebagai nama proses, kata benda 'reproduction' lebih tepat digunakan sebagai subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Parents <u>should</u> <u>encouraged</u> <u>their</u> children <u>to express</u> their emotions <u>freely</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal verb 'should', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'encourage', bukan 'encouraged'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>marketing</u> campaign <u>failed</u> <u>because</u> <u>its</u> lack of clear <u>messaging</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'because' harus ada klausa (subjek + kata kerja). Karena di sini hanya ada frasa benda 'its lack...', seharusnya menggunakan preposisi 'because of'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sexual <u>harassment</u> should <u>be</u> <u>tolerating</u> <u>in</u> any <u>professional</u> environment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur pasif (be + V3). Seharusnya 'tolerated', bukan 'tolerating'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Child <u>development</u> <u>milestones</u> <u>is</u> <u>to track</u> a <u>child's</u> progress.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'milestones' adalah jamak. Maka kata kerja bantu 'is' seharusnya diganti menjadi 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Only in recent years ___ the government begun to recognize doxing as a serious criminal offense.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'only in recent years' memicu inversi. Subjek 'government' (tunggal) dipasangkan dengan auxiliary 'has' untuk Present Perfect (begun).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>economic</u> recession <u>was felt</u> <u>more</u> <u>strong</u> in the manufacturing <u>sector</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'felt' harus diterangkan oleh adverb. Seharusnya 'strongly', bukan kata sifat 'strong'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>process</u> of <u>reproduction</u> <u>ensures</u> the <u>continuing</u> of a <u>species</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'continuing' adalah participle. Untuk merujuk pada konsep keberlangsungan, seharusnya menggunakan kata benda 'continuation'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sales <u>representative</u> <u>are</u> <u>required</u> <u>to meet</u> their monthly <u>quotas</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'representative' tunggal tetapi kata kerjanya 'are' (jamak). Seharusnya 'representatives'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Violence</u> can <u>has</u> <u>long-term</u> <u>psychological</u> effects on the <u>victim</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal verb 'can', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'have', bukan 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Parenting <u>skills</u> can be <u>learned</u> <u>and</u> <u>improve</u> over time with <u>practice</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Paralelisme dalam struktur pasif. 'Can be learned and (be) improved'. Seharusnya 'improved' agar sejajar dengan 'learned'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Doxing <u>involved</u> <u>sharing</u> <u>confidential</u> information without the <u>owner</u> <u>consent</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Diperlukan bentuk posesif untuk menerangkan persetujuan milik pemilik tersebut. Seharusnya 'owner's consent'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>marketing</u> is <u>too</u> small for <u>launching</u> a nationwide <u>campaign</u> <u>strategy</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'too + adjective' biasanya diikuti oleh to-infinitive untuk menyatakan tujuan atau hasil. Seharusnya 'to launch', bukan gerund 'launching'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Economic <u>theories</u> <u>provides</u> a <u>framework</u> for <u>understanding</u> market <u>dynamics</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'theories' adalah jamak. Maka kata kerja 'provides' seharusnya tidak menggunakan akhiran -s. Seharusnya 'provide'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>reproduction</u> <u>organ</u> <u>in</u> this plant <u>is</u> the <u>flower</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Sama seperti sebelumnya, penggunaan kata sifat 'reproductive' lebih tepat daripada kata benda 'reproduction' untuk menerangkan 'organ'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sexual <u>harassment</u> should <u>be</u> <u>investigate</u> <u>thoroughly</u> by the <u>HR</u> department.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur pasif (be + V3). Seharusnya 'investigated', bukan 'investigate'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Child <u>growth</u> is <u>influenced</u> by <u>genetic</u> and <u>environmental</u> <u>factor</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Karena didahului oleh 'genetic and environmental' (dua hal), maka kata benda 'factor' seharusnya jamak yaitu 'factors'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scarcely ___ the new economic policy been announced when protests broke out in the capital city.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'scarcely... when' memerlukan inversi dengan past perfect. Seharusnya menggunakan 'had'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>sales</u> <u>projections</u> <u>was</u> <u>based</u> on overly optimistic <u>assumptions</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'projections' adalah jamak. Kata kerja bantu 'was' seharusnya diganti menjadi 'were'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Parenting <u>can be</u> <u>very</u> <u>exhausted</u>, <u>especially</u> for first-time <u>parents</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata sifat berakhiran -ed (exhausted) digunakan untuk perasaan subjek, sedangkan berakhiran -ing (exhausting) digunakan untuk karakteristik suatu hal. Pengasuhan itu melelahkan, maka seharusnya 'exhausting'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Doxing is a <u>form</u> of <u>violence</u> <u>that</u> should <u>be</u> <u>address</u> by the authorities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur pasif (be + V3). Seharusnya 'addressed', bukan 'address'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Economic <u>stability</u> is <u>vital</u> <u>for</u> <u>attract</u> foreign <u>investment</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'for', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk gerund. Seharusnya 'attracting', bukan 'attract'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>reproduction</u> <u>capacity</u> <u>has</u> <u>declined</u> due to <u>overuse</u> of the land.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata sifat 'productive' atau 'productivity' lebih tepat untuk menerangkan kapasitas tanah daripada kata benda 'reproduction'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sexual <u>harassment</u> <u>are</u> <u>often</u> <u>because</u> of <u>fear</u> of social stigma.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Sama seperti sebelumnya, 'because' harus diikuti klausa. Karena di sini diikuti frasa benda 'fear of stigma', seharusnya menggunakan 'because of'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Child <u>development</u> <u>occurs</u> at <u>differently</u> <u>rates</u> for <u>each</u> individual child.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata benda 'rates' harus diterangkan oleh kata sifat (adjective). Seharusnya 'different', bukan adverb 'differently'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sales <u>growth</u> is <u>modest</u> <u>despite</u> <u>of</u> marketing <u>efforts</u> this year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'despite' tidak boleh diikuti oleh 'of'. Cukup 'despite the efforts' atau gunakan 'in spite of'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Parenting <u>decisions</u> <u>should be</u> <u>making</u> with the <u>child's</u> best interest in <u>mind</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keputusan tidak melakukan aksi membuat (aktif), melainkan dibuat (pasif). Seharusnya 'made' (V3), bukan 'making' (V-ing).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Doxing is a <u>violation</u> of <u>privacy</u> <u>who</u> <u>can harm</u> a person's digital <u>reputation</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'who' salah karena merujuk pada 'violation'. Seharusnya 'that' atau 'which'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Economic <u>inequality</u> <u>can</u> <u>leads</u> to <u>social</u> and political <u>instability</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal 'can', kata kerja harus bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'lead', bukan 'leads'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Nepotism in the workplace often leads to a decline in employee morale because merit ___ by personal connections.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menjelaskan sebuah sebab-akibat yang bersifat umum. 'Merit' (prestasi) adalah subjek tunggal yang dikenai tindakan, sehingga membutuhkan bentuk present passive 'is overtaken'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sexual <u>harassment</u> <u>policies</u> <u>helps</u> <u>to create</u> a safer working <u>environment</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'policies' adalah jamak. Kata kerja 'helps' seharusnya diganti menjadi 'help'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Child <u>growth</u> is not just about <u>height</u> and <u>weight</u> <u>but also</u> about <u>mentally</u> health.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata benda 'health' harus diterangkan oleh kata sifat (adjective). Seharusnya 'mental health', bukan adverb 'mentally'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ to the consumer's needs, but the new marketing campaign also utilizes advanced data analytics to predict future trends.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'not only' di awal kalimat memerlukan inversi subjek dan kata kerja bantu (auxiliary). Karena klausa kedua menggunakan simple present (utilizes), maka klausa pertama juga menggunakan simple present 'does it appeal'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The sales representative <u>has been working</u> on <u>the new</u> contract <u>since two hours</u>, but the <u>client has not</u> <u>signed it</u> yet.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu yang menunjukkan durasi (dua jam) seharusnya menggunakan preposisi 'for', bukan 'since'. 'Since' digunakan untuk titik waktu awal kejadian.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: It is essential that the pharmaceutical company ___ clinical trials thoroughly before submitting the drug for government approval.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adjektiva 'essential' yang diikuti 'that' memicu penggunaan subjunctive mood. Kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) 'conduct' tanpa mempedulikan subjek tunggal atau jamak.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the new electric vehicle <u>is released</u> next year, the <u>engineers will</u> <u>have been developed</u> <u>a more</u> <u>efficient battery</u> system.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini memerlukan Future Perfect Active untuk menyatakan aksi yang akan sudah selesai di masa depan. Seharusnya 'will have developed', bukan 'have been developed' yang merupakan bentuk pasif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>central bank</u> <u>decided to</u> increase interest rates, <u>which it</u> <u>was expected</u> to <u>stabilizing the economy</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah struktur pasif 'was expected' diikuti oleh to-infinitive. Seharusnya 'to stabilize the economy', bukan menggunakan gerund 'stabilizing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ such high levels of fuel efficiency been achieved in a combustion engine without compromising horsepower.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adverbia negatif 'rarely' memicu inversi. Karena subjeknya 'levels' (jamak) dan menggunakan past participle 'been achieved', maka auxiliary yang tepat adalah 'have' (Present Perfect).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>marketing strategy</u> <u>that was</u> <u>implemented last</u> month <u>is not just</u> about increasing sales but also about <u>improve brand loyalty</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Prinsip paralelisme mengharuskan elemen setelah 'about' memiliki bentuk yang sama. Karena sebelumnya adalah gerund phrase 'increasing sales', maka seharusnya 'improving brand loyalty'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>aviary's</u> collection <u>includes birds</u> that <u>are so rare</u> <u>as they</u> are <u>hardly ever</u> seen in the wild.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective' seharusnya diikuti oleh 'that' untuk menunjukkan konsekuensi. Seharusnya 'so rare that they', bukan 'as they'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Had the <u>investment firm</u> <u>known about</u> the <u>market volatility</u>, they <u>would not have</u> <u>investing in</u> that technology startup.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam Inverted Third Conditional, klausa utama harus menggunakan 'would have' + past participle (V3). Seharusnya 'invested in', bukan 'investing in'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the government <u>enacts</u> stricter <u>anti-drug laws</u>, the <u>number of</u> drug-related crimes <u>will</u> <u>to decrease</u> significantly.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal 'will', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive). Seharusnya 'decrease', bukan 'to decrease'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The financial analyst, ___ for his accurate predictions, was recently hired by one of the largest investment banks in the country.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah reduced relative clause pasif. Bentuk aslinya 'who is known', disederhanakan menjadi past participle 'known' untuk menerangkan subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>automated assembly</u> line operates <u>much more</u> <u>efficiently than</u> <u>the manual one</u> <u>doing</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat perbandingan ini membutuhkan auxiliary verb yang sesuai di akhir untuk menggantikan kata kerja utama 'operates'. Seharusnya menggunakan 'does', bukan 'doing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ the drug had passed all safety protocols, the regulatory agency still requested additional data on its long-term side effects.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'although' diikuti oleh klausa lengkap (subjek + verb) untuk menunjukkan kontras. 'Despite' dan 'in spite of' diikuti oleh noun phrase.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>sales manager</u> <u>insisted on</u> <u>the team</u> <u>to submit</u> their weekly reports <u>by Friday</u> afternoon.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'on' dalam frasa 'insisted on', kata kerja yang mengikuti harus dalam bentuk gerund. Seharusnya 'submitting', bukan 'to submit'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>newly developed</u> engine not only <u>is lighter</u> <u>than</u> its predecessor <u>but also more</u> <u>powerful</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kesalahan penempatan 'not only'. Agar paralel, seharusnya 'is not only lighter... but also more powerful'. Kata kerja 'is' harus diletakkan sebelum 'not only' agar menyentuh kedua adjektiva.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scarcely ___ the marketing department launched the new product when several competitors released similar technologies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'scarcely... when' memerlukan inversi dengan past perfect (had + subjek + V3). 'Had' adalah pilihan yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The aviary <u>curator</u> explained <u>that</u> certain <u>species</u> of parrots <u>be provided</u> with a <u>specialize diet</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'specialize diet' salah secara gramatikal. Kata 'diet' harus diterangkan oleh past participle yang berfungsi sebagai adjektiva, yaitu 'specialized diet'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The finance <u>director</u> claims <u>by</u> next year <u>the company</u> <u>will be</u> <u>operated in five</u> different countries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini bermaksud menyatakan aktivitas yang sedang berlangsung di masa depan (Future Continuous). Seharusnya 'will be operating', bukan pasif 'will be operated'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The pharmaceutical <u>industry</u> is <u>one of</u> the most <u>highly regulated</u> <u>sector</u> <u>in the</u> world economy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'one of the' harus diikuti oleh kata benda jamak. Seharusnya 'sectors', bukan 'sector'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The technician <u>failed</u> to <u>fixing</u> the <u>machine</u> because <u>he</u> <u>had not</u> read the manual properly.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'fail' harus diikuti oleh to-infinitive. Seharusnya 'to fix', bukan gerund 'fixing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Only in the last decade ___ the automotive industry begun to prioritize sustainability over sheer performance.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dipicu oleh 'only in the last decade'. Subjek 'the automotive industry' adalah tunggal, sehingga menggunakan auxiliary 'has' untuk Present Perfect (begun).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The marketing <u>expert</u> <u>noted that</u> <u>the more targeted</u> the <u>ad</u>, <u>the most effective</u> it is.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur double comparative menggunakan 'the more... the more...'. Seharusnya 'the more effective', bukan superlatif 'the most effective'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>financial</u> report indicates <u>that</u> <u>neither</u> the stock market <u>nor</u> the housing market <u>are stable</u> right now.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam struktur 'neither... nor', kata kerja harus menyesuaikan dengan subjek terdekat. 'Housing market' adalah tunggal, maka seharusnya 'is stable', bukan 'are stable'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The sales rep <u>would have won</u> <u>the award</u> <u>if he</u> <u>has reached</u> his <u>annual target</u> sooner.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Type 3. Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect. Seharusnya 'had reached', bukan 'has reached'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The new technology <u>makes it</u> <u>possible</u> for <u>businesses</u> <u>to analyzing</u> <u>vast amounts of</u> data in real-time.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'to' dalam struktur 'possible for someone to...', harus diikuti oleh kata kerja dasar. Seharusnya 'to analyze', bukan gerund 'analyzing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Under no circumstances ___ the medical staff disclose patient information without a valid legal warrant.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa negatif 'under no circumstances' memicu inversi. Modal 'should' adalah yang paling lazim digunakan untuk larangan keras atau prosedur etika medis.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>company's</u> <u>success</u> was primarily <u>due to</u> <u>it's</u> <u>ability</u> to innovate quickly.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kesalahan penggunaan homofon. 'It's' adalah singkatan 'it is'. Seharusnya menggunakan kata ganti posesif 'its' (tanpa apostrof) untuk menerangkan 'ability'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The aviary <u>was</u> <u>mimic</u> the <u>birds'</u> <u>nature</u> habitats as <u>closely as possible</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'habitats' harus diterangkan oleh adjektiva. Seharusnya 'natural habitats', bukan kata benda 'nature'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The marketing <u>budget</u> for the <u>next</u> quarter <u>has already been</u> <u>approve</u> <u>by the board</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur pasif Present Perfect (has been + V3). Seharusnya 'approved', bukan bentuk dasar 'approve'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>sales team</u> <u>is</u> <u>consisted of</u> ten <u>experienced</u> professionals from <u>diverse</u> backgrounds.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kesalahan pada frasa 'consisted of'. Kata kerja 'consist' adalah intransitif dan tidak memiliki bentuk pasif. Seharusnya 'consists of' atau 'is composed of'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: No sooner ___ the investors released the funds than the technology startup began its global expansion.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'no sooner... than' memerlukan inversi dengan past perfect (had + subjek + V3). 'Had' adalah pilihan yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The finance <u>manager</u> <u>requested</u> <u>that</u> the budgetary allocation <u>is</u> <u>re-evaluated</u> immediately.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'requested' memicu subjunctive mood. Kata kerja 'is' dalam klausa pasif seharusnya menjadi 'be'. Seharusnya 'be re-evaluated'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The automotive <u>industry</u> <u>has transformed</u> <u>significantly</u> <u>by</u> the <u>integration</u> of digital technologies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini harus dalam bentuk pasif karena industri ditransformasikan oleh teknologi. Seharusnya 'has been transformed', bukan 'has transformed' (aktif).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The pharmacist <u>warned</u> the <u>patient</u> <u>not to</u> <u>mixing</u> the <u>medication</u> with alcohol.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'not to' dalam kalimat perintah tidak langsung, harus diikuti oleh kata kerja dasar. Seharusnya 'mix', bukan gerund 'mixing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>sales</u> data <u>shows that</u> <u>there are</u> a <u>significant</u> <u>increase in</u> consumer spending this month.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek setelah 'there' adalah 'a significant increase' (tunggal). Oleh karena itu, auxiliary verb seharusnya 'is', bukan 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Hardly ___ the new software been installed when the entire system began to malfunction.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'hardly... when' memerlukan inversi dengan past perfect (had + subjek + V3). 'Had' adalah pilihan yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>marketing</u> campaign <u>was</u> <u>successful</u> <u>because of</u> <u>it targeted</u> the right demographic.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'because of' adalah preposisi yang diikuti oleh noun phrase. Karena setelahnya adalah klausa lengkap 'it targeted...', seharusnya menggunakan konjungsi 'because'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The aviary <u>expert</u> explained <u>how</u> <u>do</u> the birds <u>navigate</u> <u>during</u> long-distance migration.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam klausa kata benda (noun clause) sebagai bagian dari pernyataan, urutan kata tidak diinversi seperti pertanyaan. Seharusnya 'how the birds navigate', tanpa auxiliary 'do'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The finance <u>department</u> requires <u>every</u> <u>employees</u> <u>to attend</u> the <u>compliance</u> training.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'every' harus diikuti oleh kata benda tunggal. Seharusnya 'employee', bukan 'employees'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The new marketing <u>director</u> is <u>more</u> <u>creative</u> than <u>any</u> <u>person</u> in the team.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam perbandingan individu dengan kelompoknya sendiri, harus menggunakan 'any other'. Seharusnya 'any other person' untuk mengecualikan subjek dari kelompok yang dibandingkan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scarcely <u>had</u> the new engine <u>started</u> <u>when</u> it <u>was began</u> <u>to emit</u> dark smoke.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kesalahan bentuk pasif-aktif. Mesin tersebut mulai (aktif), bukan dimulaikan (pasif). Seharusnya 'it began', bukan 'it was began'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>sales team</u> <u>has been</u> <u>exceeded</u> their <u>targets</u> <u>for</u> three consecutive years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini bermaksud menyatakan Present Perfect Active. Seharusnya 'has exceeded', tanpa 'been' yang akan menjadikannya bentuk pasif yang tidak logis.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ such complex technology been used in consumer electronics at such an affordable price point.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dipicu oleh 'rarely'. Subjek 'technology' adalah tunggal, sehingga auxiliary yang tepat untuk present perfect pasif adalah 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The investors <u>refused</u> <u>to provide</u> additional funding <u>unless</u> <u>the company</u> <u>revises</u> its marketing plan.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Sequence of tenses. Karena induk kalimat menggunakan past tense (refused), klausa subordinat juga harus mengikuti tenses masa lampau. Seharusnya 'revised', bukan 'revises'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The new medication <u>shows</u> <u>promising</u> results, but its <u>efficacy</u> still <u>needs</u> to be <u>tested extensive</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'tested' harus diterangkan oleh adverbia. Seharusnya 'extensively', bukan adjektiva 'extensive'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Seldom ___ the central bank intervene so directly in the market without prior warning to financial institutions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dipicu oleh 'seldom'. Untuk subjek 'the central bank' (tunggal) dalam simple present, auxiliary yang tepat adalah 'does'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The aviary <u>curator</u> explained <u>that</u> certain <u>species</u> of parrots <u>can live</u> for more than <u>fifty year</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah kata bilangan 'fifty', kata benda yang mengikuti harus jamak. Seharusnya 'fifty years'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>marketing</u> team is <u>working</u> on a <u>new</u> ad that <u>aims to</u> <u>attracting</u> a younger audience.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'aim to' harus diikuti oleh bare infinitive. Seharusnya 'attract', bukan gerund 'attracting'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>sales manager</u> <u>insisted</u> that the new targets <u>should be</u> re-evaluated at the <u>beginning</u> of <u>each months</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'each' harus diikuti oleh kata benda tunggal. Seharusnya 'each month', bukan 'each months'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The finance <u>director</u> was so happy with the <u>quarterly</u> <u>results</u> <u>that</u> he gave a bonus to all the <u>employee</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah kata penentu 'all', kata benda yang dapat dihitung harus jamak. Seharusnya 'all the employees'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ people living in the hinterland have access to modern medical treatments for severe allergic reactions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat dimulai dengan kata keterangan negatif 'rarely' yang memicu inversi. Karena subjeknya adalah 'people' (jamak) dan kalimat menyatakan fakta umum (present), maka auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'do'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>discovery of</u> purba fossils in the remote cave <u>has been providing</u> <u>valuable insight</u> <u>into evolution</u> <u>lately</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'insight' merupakan kata benda yang tidak dapat dihitung (uncountable noun). Dalam konteks ini, seharusnya menggunakan bentuk jamak 'insights' agar selaras dengan makna pengetahuan berharga yang luas.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the mining company <u>had adhered</u> to the safety protocols, the fatal accident in the deepest shaft <u>would not happen</u> <u>yesterday</u> <u>morning</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah pengandaian masa lampau (Conditional Type 3). Klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect (had adhered), maka klausa utama harus menggunakan modal perfect 'would not have happened'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Information technology managers recommend that every employee ___ a multi-factor authentication system to protect their accounts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata 'recommend that'. Kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (use) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The pediatrician <u>recommended</u> that the child with <u>severe allergies</u> <u>is avoiding</u> <u>any</u> <u>processed foods</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'recommended' memicu penggunaan subjunctive mood. Dalam klausa 'that', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive). Seharusnya 'avoid', bukan 'is avoiding'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Cyberbullying</u> incidents <u>have been risen</u> <u>sharply</u> <u>since the</u> <u>widespread use</u> of social media.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'rise' adalah intransitive verb yang tidak memiliki bentuk pasif. Bentuk Present Perfect-nya adalah 'have risen', bukan 'have been risen' (pasif).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ victims of bullying suffer from immediate distress, but they also frequently face long-term psychological challenges.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dipicu oleh 'not only' di awal kalimat. Subjeknya adalah 'victims' (jamak) dan menyatakan fakta umum, sehingga auxiliary 'do' diperlukan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>mining industry</u> <u>is not just</u> <u>profitable</u> <u>but also</u> <u>it is</u> environmentally damaging.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'not only/not just ... but also' memerlukan paralelisme. Setelah 'but also' seharusnya langsung diikuti kata sifat (adjective) 'environmentally damaging' agar sejajar dengan 'profitable'. Frasa 'it is' tidak diperlukan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Under no circumstances <u>should</u> a <u>student</u> <u>to be</u> <u>subjected to</u> any <u>form of</u> bullying.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal verb 'should' pada struktur inversi, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive). Seharusnya 'be', bukan 'to be'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>primitive tools</u> <u>discovered</u> <u>near the</u> ancient river <u>suggests</u> that <u>early humans</u> were skilled.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama kalimat adalah 'primitive tools' (jamak). Oleh karena itu, kata kerja 'suggests' seharusnya tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (menjadi 'suggest').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Had the maritime authorities <u>been</u> more <u>vigilant</u>, the <u>piracy acts</u> <u>could be</u> <u>prevented</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Inverted Conditional Type 3 (had + subjek + V3). Klausa utama harus menggunakan modal perfect 'could have been' untuk menunjukkan pengandaian masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ the severe weather conditions in the hinterland, the mining operations had to be suspended for several weeks.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'due to' adalah preposisi yang diikuti oleh frasa benda (noun phrase) untuk menunjukkan penyebab. 'Because' memerlukan klausa lengkap (subjek + verb).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Cyberbullying <u>can be</u> <u>just as</u> <u>damage</u> <u>to</u> a child's <u>well-being</u> as physical violence.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah struktur perbandingan 'just as ... as', diperlukan kata sifat (adjective) untuk menerangkan subjek 'cyberbullying'. Seharusnya 'damaging', bukan kata benda/kerja 'damage'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither <u>the school</u> <u>nor</u> the <u>parents</u> <u>was aware</u> that <u>cyberbullying</u> <u>was occurring</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam struktur 'neither ... nor', kata kerja harus menyesuaikan dengan subjek terdekat. Karena 'parents' adalah jamak, maka seharusnya 'were aware', bukan 'was aware'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>discovery of</u> <u>purba</u> remains <u>proves that</u> the <u>pedalaman regions</u> <u>was once</u> thriving.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'regions' adalah jamak. Oleh karena itu, kata kerja bantu seharusnya 'were once', bukan 'was once'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: No sooner ___ the pirates boarded the cargo ship than the navy arrived to intervene.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'no sooner ... than' memerlukan inversi dengan Past Perfect (had + subjek + V3) untuk menunjukkan dua kejadian yang berurutan cepat di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: It is <u>essential</u> that every <u>mine worker</u> <u>wears</u> <u>protective gear</u> <u>to prevent</u> injuries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adjektiva 'essential' memicu subjunctive mood. Kata kerja dalam klausa 'that' harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive). Seharusnya 'wear', bukan 'wears'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>primitive culture</u> <u>observed</u> in the remote village <u>is</u> <u>uniqueness</u> in its <u>social structure</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah linking verb 'is', diperlukan kata sifat (adjective) untuk menerangkan subjek 'culture'. Seharusnya 'unique', bukan kata benda 'uniqueness'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>pedalaman region</u> <u>is rich in</u> natural resources, but its isolation <u>makes it</u> <u>difficult to</u> <u>developing</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah frasa 'difficult to', seharusnya diikuti oleh kata kerja dasar (infinitive). Seharusnya 'develop', bukan gerund 'developing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By next year, the <u>government</u> <u>will has been</u> <u>investigating</u> the <u>illegal mining</u> <u>for</u> a month.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam Future Perfect Continuous, auxiliary verb setelah 'will' harus selalu 'have' tanpa mempedulikan subjeknya tunggal atau jamak. Seharusnya 'will have been'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Seldom ___ the central bank intervene so directly in the market without prior warning.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adverbia negatif 'seldom' memicu inversi. Untuk subjek 'the central bank' (tunggal) dalam simple present, auxiliary yang tepat adalah 'does'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The cyberbullying <u>prevention</u> program <u>aims at</u> <u>educate</u> students <u>about</u> online <u>ethics</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'at' dalam frasa 'aims at', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk gerund. Seharusnya 'educating', bukan 'educate'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>victim</u> of bullying refused <u>to testify</u> <u>unless</u> the identity of the <u>attacker</u> <u>was not hidden</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'unless' sudah bermakna negatif (jika tidak). Klausa setelah 'unless' tidak boleh menggunakan kata negatif lagi karena akan menjadi makna ganda (double negative). Seharusnya 'was hidden'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Researchers <u>discovered</u> that <u>some</u> primitive organisms <u>have adapted</u> <u>to</u> <u>extremely</u> poisonous environment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'poisonous environment' memerlukan artikel karena 'environment' adalah kata benda tunggal yang dapat dihitung. Seharusnya 'some primitive organisms have adapted to an extremely poisonous environment'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Bullying <u>among</u> adolescents <u>can lead to</u> <u>depressed</u>, anxiety, <u>and a decline in</u> <u>academic performance</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Prinsip paralelisme mengharuskan elemen dalam daftar memiliki bentuk yang sama. 'Anxiety' dan 'decline' adalah kata benda, maka 'depressed' (adjective) seharusnya menjadi 'depression' (noun).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ illegal mining destroy the environment, but it also creates safety hazards for the local community.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'not only' di awal kalimat memicu inversi. Untuk subjek 'illegal mining' (tunggal) dalam konteks fakta umum, auxiliary 'does' diletakkan sebelum subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>allergic</u> symptoms of the child <u>were so</u> <u>severely</u> <u>that</u> <u>he needed</u> hospitalization.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah linking verb 'were' dalam struktur 'so ... that', diperlukan kata sifat (adjective). Seharusnya 'severe', bukan adverb 'severely'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: People with <u>pollen allergies</u> <u>are advised</u> <u>to stay indoors</u> when the <u>pollen count</u> <u>has been highly</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah linking verb 'has been', diperlukan kata sifat (adjective) untuk menerangkan subjek. Seharusnya 'high', bukan adverb 'highly'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>primitive methods</u> of <u>hunting</u> <u>has been</u> <u>replaced by</u> <u>modern</u> technology in most regions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama kalimat adalah 'methods' (jamak). Oleh karena itu, auxiliary verb seharusnya 'have been', bukan 'has been'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Cyberbullying <u>can be</u> <u>difficult to</u> <u>identifying</u> <u>because it</u> often occurs <u>anonymously</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah frasa 'difficult to', diperlukan kata kerja dasar (infinitive). Seharusnya 'identify', bukan gerund 'identifying'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ maritime piracy occurred in these waters until the local government reduced its naval patrols.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'until' di klausa kedua menggunakan simple past (reduced), yang berarti pembajakan terjadi sebelumnya. Maka inversi memerlukan Past Perfect 'had'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>purba settlement</u> <u>located</u> in the <u>pedalaman</u> <u>is consisting of</u> <u>several</u> stone structures.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'consist' adalah kata kerja statif (stative verb) yang tidak umum digunakan dalam bentuk continuous (-ing). Seharusnya menggunakan simple present 'consists of'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>discovery of</u> the <u>purba humans</u> <u>has revolutionized</u> <u>how do we</u> <u>understand</u> <u>early history</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam klausa kata benda (noun clause), urutan kata tidak boleh diinversi seperti kalimat tanya. Seharusnya 'how we understand', tanpa auxiliary 'do'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Despite the <u>severity</u> of <u>his</u> allergic reaction, the <u>patient</u> <u>manages to</u> <u>recovering</u> quickly.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah kata kerja 'manage' yang diikuti 'to' (infinitive), kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'recover', bukan gerund 'recovering'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Cyberbullying</u> policies that <u>are implementing</u> <u>by schools</u> <u>must be reviewed</u> <u>regularly</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kebijakan (policies) tidak melakukan aksi mengimplementasikan (aktif), melainkan diimplementasikan (pasif). Seharusnya menggunakan past participle 'are implemented'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Data scientists found that the new algorithm ___ the processing time by nearly forty percent compared to previous versions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Past Perfect Tense ('had + V3') untuk menunjukkan hasil yang dicapai sebelum temuan (found) dilaporkan di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the <u>maritime summit</u> <u>ends</u> <u>next month</u>, the <u>nations</u> <u>will have been signed</u> the treaty.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menyatakan aksi aktif di masa depan. Bangsa-bangsa akan sudah menandatangani (aktif). Struktur 'will have been signed' adalah pasif yang tidak logis. Seharusnya 'will have signed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Only after the <u>outbreak</u> <u>did</u> the medical staff <u>realized</u> that many <u>patients had</u> <u>peanut allergies</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah auxiliary verb 'did' dalam struktur inversi, kata kerja utama harus kembali ke bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'realize', bukan 'realized'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither <u>the miners</u> <u>nor</u> the supervisor <u>preparing</u> <u>for the</u> sudden <u>gas leak</u> in the mine.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini kekurangan kata kerja bantu (auxiliary) untuk membentuk tenses yang tepat. Seharusnya 'was preparing' atau 'prepared' sebagai predikat utama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scarcely <u>had</u> the cybersecurity team <u>detected</u> the piracy <u>than</u> <u>the website</u> <u>crashed</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan yang tepat untuk 'scarcely' adalah 'when', bukan 'than'. Struktur 'scarcely ... when' digunakan untuk aksi yang terjadi hampir bersamaan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>discovery of</u> the <u>ancient tools</u> <u>has been providing</u> <u>valuable insights</u> into <u>how did people live</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam klausa kata benda (noun clause), urutan kata harus subjek + kata kerja, bukan urutan tanya. Seharusnya 'how people lived'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ victims of bullying feel empowered to report the incidents to the school authorities immediately.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dengan 'rarely'. Subjek 'victims' adalah jamak, sehingga auxiliary 'do' digunakan untuk menyatakan kebiasaan/fakta umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many <u>people with</u> <u>allergies</u> <u>avoiding</u> <u>certain foods</u> <u>to prevent</u> an anaphylactic shock.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini kehilangan kata kerja utama (main verb). Present participle 'avoiding' tidak bisa menjadi predikat tanpa auxiliary verb. Seharusnya menggunakan 'avoid'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The history of the Chinese community in Indonesia is characterized by a long process of cultural ___ and adaptation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah kata sifat 'cultural' dan sebelum kata benda 'adaptation', dibutuhkan kata benda (noun) untuk melengkapi struktur paralel, yaitu 'assimilation'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Cyberbullying</u> <u>is not just</u> a social issue <u>but also</u> <u>a criminal act</u> that <u>carrying</u> heavy penalties.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Klausa relatif 'that' memerlukan kata kerja utama. Seharusnya 'that carries', bukan present participle 'carrying' tanpa kata kerja bantu.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>mining</u> operations <u>in the area</u> <u>have resulted</u> in <u>significantly</u> <u>destruction of</u> the <u>ancient forest</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata benda 'destruction' harus diterangkan oleh kata sifat (adjective), bukan adverbia. Seharusnya 'significant destruction'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ the pirates seize the ship, but they also held the crew for ransom in the hinterland.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dipicu oleh 'not only'. Karena klausa kedua menggunakan past tense (held), maka klausa pertama juga harus menggunakan past tense 'did'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>archaeologist</u> <u>insisted</u> that the <u>primitive site</u> <u>be protected</u> from illegal <u>mine activities</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'mine' adalah kata benda. Untuk menerangkan kata benda 'activities', kita membutuhkan kata sifat (adjective) atau noun-as-adjective. Bentuk yang tepat adalah 'mining activities'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Despite</u> <u>of</u> the <u>widespread</u> <u>awareness</u>, cyberbullying remains a <u>persistent problem</u> in schools.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'despite' tidak boleh diikuti oleh 'of'. Cukup 'despite the awareness' atau gunakan 'in spite of'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Child <u>growth</u> is not <u>just about</u> <u>height and weight</u> but also <u>about</u> <u>mentally health</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata benda 'health' harus diterangkan oleh kata sifat (adjective). Seharusnya 'mental health', bukan adverb 'mentally'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Feminist theorists argue that the patriarchy ___ social structures for centuries to maintain male dominance.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'for centuries' menunjukkan durasi yang dimulai di masa lampau dan berlanjut hingga sekarang, sehingga memerlukan Present Perfect Continuous (has been shaping).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not until the Giyanti Treaty was signed in 1755 ___ the Mataram Sultanate formally divided into two separate realms.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'not until' di awal kalimat memicu inversi. Karena subjeknya adalah 'the Mataram Sultanate' (tunggal) dan kalimatnya pasif di masa lampau, auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'was'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Komodo dragon, ___ only in the Lesser Sunda Islands, uses its forked tongue to detect carrion from miles away.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan reduced relative clause dalam bentuk pasif. Bentuk aslinya 'which is found' disederhanakan menjadi past participle 'found'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Political analysts suggest that the candidate's reliance on foreign investors ___ public trust in his nationalist platform.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini memerlukan kata kerja utama (main verb) setelah subjek 'reliance'. Modal 'might undermine' secara gramatikal tepat untuk menyatakan kemungkinan di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Residents in Solo complained that the high wall built around the residence ___ their access to the main road.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Klausa 'that' memerlukan kata kerja utama. Karena kejadian pembangunan tembok sudah terjadi (built), maka kata kerja 'restricted' dalam bentuk simple past adalah yang paling tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Humanitarian organizations emphasize that the blockade in Gaza ___ a severe shortage of essential medical supplies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini memerlukan predikat aktif. 'Has caused' (Present Perfect) tepat untuk menyatakan dampak dari blokade yang efeknya masih terasa hingga sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The second wave of feminism focused on workplace inequality, reproductive rights, and ___.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Prinsip paralelisme mengharuskan elemen dalam daftar berbentuk sama. 'Workplace inequality' dan 'reproductive rights' adalah noun phrase, maka harus diikuti oleh noun phrase 'legal protections'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: During the colonial era, the Dutch East India Company ___ a monopoly over the spice trade in the Indonesian archipelago.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'During the colonial era' menunjukkan kejadian di masa lampau yang sudah selesai, sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense (maintained).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ the Komodo dragon face significant threats from natural predators due to its position at the top of the food chain.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adverbia negatif 'rarely' memicu inversi. Untuk subjek 'the Komodo dragon' (tunggal) dalam konteks fakta umum (present), auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'does'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The defense minister's speech regarding foreign influence was met with ___ by his political opponents.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'with', diperlukan kata benda (noun). 'Skepticism' adalah bentuk kata benda yang tepat untuk melengkapi frasa tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the urban planning committee ___ the impact of the wall, they would have designed a more communal space in Solo.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Type 3 (pengandaian masa lampau). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect (had considered) karena klausa utama menggunakan 'would have' + V3.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Diplomatic efforts to resolve the Israel-Palestine conflict ___ by deep-seated historical grievances on both sides.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'diplomatic efforts' adalah jamak. Kalimat ini memerlukan bentuk pasif jamak 'are hindered' (sering terhambat) atau 'have hindered' (telah terhambat). Namun jika merujuk pada kondisi berkelanjutan, 'are hindered' lebih umum, tetapi dalam opsi ini 'is hindered' salah subjek. 'Have hindered' biasanya aktif, jadi pasifnya 'have been hindered'. Opsi yang paling tepat untuk subjek jamak adalah 'are hindered' (jika tersedia), namun di sini kita gunakan 'have been' atau 'are'. Mari kita asumsikan 'Are hindered' pada index 1.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The concept of intersectional feminism requires that researchers ___ various factors like race, class, and sexual orientation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'requires' memicu subjunctive mood. Dalam klausa 'that', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) 'analyze' tanpa mempedulikan subjek tunggal atau jamak.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sukarno and Hatta, ___ the leaders of the independence movement, were the first President and Vice President of Indonesia.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Appositive phrase memerlukan participle atau relative clause. 'Recognized as' (diakui sebagai) berfungsi memberikan informasi tambahan pasif tentang subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The population of Komodo dragons has decreased significantly, ___ to habitat loss and climate change.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'due to' adalah preposisi yang menunjukkan penyebab dan diikuti oleh noun phrase. 'Partly due to' melengkapi makna penurunan populasi secara logis.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Prabowo's nationalist rhetoric often emphasizes the dangers of ___ control over Indonesia's natural resources.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata benda 'control' memerlukan kata sifat (adjective) sebagai penjelas. 'Foreign' (asing) adalah adjektiva yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The controversial wall in Solo is often compared ___ a physical manifestation of political elitism by its detractors.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'compared' biasanya berpasangan dengan preposisi 'to' jika menekankan kemiripan atau perumpamaan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The international community has repeatedly called ___ an immediate ceasefire in the ongoing conflict in Gaza.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Phrasal verb 'call for' berarti menuntut atau meminta secara resmi sesuatu hal dilakukan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the new gender equality law is passed next year, activists ___ for its implementation for over a decade.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'by the time' yang merujuk pada masa depan memerlukan Future Perfect Continuous (will have been + V-ing) untuk menunjukkan durasi aksi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: History provides numerous examples of how Indonesian youth played a pivotal role ___ the colonial administration.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah frase 'pivotal role', biasanya diikuti oleh preposisi 'in' + gerund untuk menunjukkan bidang atau aktivitas peran tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Only in recent decades ___ scientists discovered the complex social hierarchy within Komodo dragon communities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'only in recent decades' memicu inversi. Karena subjeknya 'scientists' (jamak) dan menggunakan past participle 'discovered', auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Prabowo Subianto's political career, ___ over several decades, has been marked by both significant military service and high-level politics.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle phrase 'spanning' (yang membentang/mencakup) berfungsi sebagai penjelas aktif untuk subjek 'political career'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The construction of the wall in Solo was so controversial ___ it sparked debates about the visibility of the presidency.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat (sangat kontroversial sehingga memicu debat).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The two-state solution remains ___ most widely discussed framework for resolving the Israel-Palestine conflict.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Untuk memodifikasi superlatif 'most widely discussed', diperlukan definite article 'the'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Feminist movements often advocate that society ___ traditional gender roles to foster true equality.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'advocate' diikuti oleh 'that' memicu subjunctive mood. Kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar 're-evaluate' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Indonesian independence was not just a political achievement but ___ of a long and bloody struggle against imperialism.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur paralel 'not just ... but ...' memerlukan kata benda untuk melengkapi perbandingan. 'The result' (hasil dari) secara gramatikal paling tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Komodo dragons are apex predators, ___ they are at the very top of the food chain in their natural environment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'meaning' (berarti/yang berarti) digunakan untuk menjelaskan konsekuensi atau definisi dari klausa sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The minister's warnings about 'aseng' agents were seen by some ___ a tactic to divert attention from domestic economic issues.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'seen as' (dilihat sebagai) digunakan untuk menyatakan persepsi atau identifikasi terhadap sesuatu hal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Jokowi's infrastructure push has often been criticized for prioritizing economic development ___ social and environmental concerns.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'prioritizing' berpasangan dengan preposisi 'over' untuk membandingkan dua hal yang dipentingkan salah satunya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Historical records show that Palestinian culture ___ deeply connected to the land for millennia before the 1948 conflict.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Untuk menyatakan kondisi yang sudah berlangsung lama sebelum titik waktu tertentu di masa lampau (1948), Past Perfect (had been) adalah yang paling tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: It is imperative that modern society ___ the principles of feminism to ensure true gender equality in every professional sector.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'imperative' yang diikuti oleh klausa 'that' memerlukan penggunaan subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk ini, kata kerja harus tetap dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) tanpa akhiran -s meskipun subjeknya tunggal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the proclamation was read in 1945, the Indonesian people ___ against colonial rule for more than three centuries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'by the time' yang diikuti oleh kejadian masa lampau (was read) memerlukan Past Perfect Continuous Tense untuk menunjukkan durasi aksi yang sudah berlangsung sebelum titik waktu lampau tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Komodo dragon, the largest living lizard on earth, ___ only on a few islands in central Indonesia.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini memerlukan bentuk pasif 'is found' (ditemukan) untuk menjelaskan habitat alami dari Komodo dragon.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ such a significant shift in political alliances been observed as when various nationalist groups joined Prabowo's coalition.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat dimulai dengan adverb negatif 'rarely' yang memicu inversi. Karena subjeknya adalah 'a significant shift' (tunggal) dan terdapat past participle 'been', maka auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Diplomats from around the world are continuously discussing ___ a lasting peace agreement between Israel and Palestine.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'how to reach' (noun phrase/infinitive phrase) digunakan untuk menjelaskan cara atau metode pencapaian tujuan setelah kata kerja 'discussing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The history of the Indonesian revolution suggests that unity ___ essential for overcoming the divide-and-rule tactics of the invaders.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini merujuk pada fakta sejarah di masa lalu, sehingga menggunakan simple past tense 'was' untuk subjek tunggal 'unity'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Feminist scholars argue that if gender roles ___ more fluid, both men and women would benefit from reduced social pressure.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 2 (pengandaian masa kini yang tidak nyata). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan bentuk subjunctive 'were' untuk semua jenis subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The infrastructure projects initiated during Jokowi's presidency ___ significantly to the economic development of remote regions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek jamak 'infrastructure projects' memerlukan kata kerja utama. Present Perfect Tense 'have contributed' tepat untuk menunjukkan dampak yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut hingga sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ the Komodo dragon possess a venomous bite, but it also has a keen sense of smell to track its prey.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'not only' di awal kalimat memerlukan inversi. Karena kata kerja utamanya adalah 'possess' (bentuk dasar), maka auxiliary 'does' digunakan untuk subjek tunggal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Systemic racism continues to be a global issue, as it ___ deep-seated prejudices within institutional structures.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'it' (merujuk pada systemic racism) adalah tunggal. Kata kerja 'reflects' dalam bentuk simple present digunakan untuk menyatakan kondisi yang masih berlangsung saat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Efforts to promote gender equality in the workplace ___ by various non-governmental organizations since the late twentieth century.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'since' menunjukkan bahwa aksi dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut (Present Perfect). Karena subjek 'efforts' menerima aksi, maka bentuk pasif 'have been spearheaded' adalah yang paling tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Indonesian historians noted that if the youth ___ not united in 1928, the Sumpah Pemuda would never have happened.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (pengandaian masa lampau). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect 'had been' karena klausa utama menggunakan 'would have happened'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Under no circumstances ___ the sovereignty of a nation be compromised for the sake of foreign economic interests.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa negatif 'under no circumstances' memicu inversi. Modal 'must' atau 'should' umum digunakan, namun 'must' memberikan penekanan keharusan yang lebih kuat dalam konteks kedaulatan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The construction of the wall in Solo, often compared to symbolic historical barriers, ___ as a measure to protect privacy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'the construction' memerlukan kata kerja pasif di masa lampau untuk menjelaskan maksud awal pembuatannya. 'Was intended' adalah bentuk yang benar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The humanitarian crisis in Gaza <u>has escalated</u> to a level <u>that</u> <u>required</u> <u>immediate</u> <u>action</u> from the UN.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Tense harus konsisten. Karena klausa utama menggunakan Present Perfect (has escalated), klausa penjelas seharusnya menggunakan Present Tense 'requires' untuk menggambarkan kondisi yang masih berlaku.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Feminism ___ only for women's rights but also for the liberation of all genders from restrictive stereotypes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'not only... but also'. Penempatan 'not only' yang benar setelah kata kerja 'advocates' adalah 'advocates not only' untuk menjaga keseimbangan paralel.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The ancient heritage of the archipelago, ___ by the Majapahit empire, laid the foundation for modern Indonesian national identity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah reduced relative clause pasif. Bentuk aslinya 'which was influenced', disederhanakan menjadi past participle 'influenced' untuk menerangkan subjek 'ancient heritage'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Prabowo's supporters believe that his military background ___ him the necessary discipline to lead the nation effectively.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menyatakan pendapat atau fakta umum (present). Subjek 'background' (tunggal) memerlukan kata kerja 'gives' atau 'has given'. Di sini 'gives' tepat untuk menyatakan karakteristik permanen.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Komodo dragons are known ___ their prey over long distances until it succumbs to the toxins in their saliva.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur pasif 'are known' diikuti oleh to-infinitive 'to follow' untuk menunjukkan kebiasaan atau karakteristik yang diketahui umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ the league of nations fail to prevent the second world war, but it also lacked the military power to enforce its resolutions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'not only' di awal kalimat memerlukan inversi. Karena kalimat merujuk pada fakta sejarah lampau dan kata kerja utamanya 'fail' (dasar), maka auxiliary yang tepat adalah 'did'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The non-aligned movement requires that each member state ___ a policy of peaceful coexistence regardless of political ideologies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'requires' diikuti 'that' memicu penggunaan subjunctive mood. Kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the final match of the world cup began, the stadium ___ to its full capacity by thousands of fans.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'by the time' diikuti simple past (began) menunjukkan aksi yang sudah selesai sebelumnya. Karena subjek stadium menerima aksi, digunakan Past Perfect Passive.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scarcely ___ the diplomat arrived at the summit when the negotiations regarding the trade agreement were abruptly suspended.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'scarcely... when' memerlukan inversi dengan past perfect. Auxiliary 'had' diletakkan sebelum subjek 'the diplomat'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Professional climbers emphasize that the higher a person climbs, ___ the oxygen levels in the atmosphere become.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur perbandingan ganda (double comparative) menggunakan pola 'the more/er... the more/er...'. 'The lower' melengkapi pola tersebut secara paralel.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The muslim world league, ___ in mecca in 1962, aims to promote islamic values and foster cooperation among muslim nations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah reduced relative clause pasif. Bentuk aslinya 'which was founded', disederhanakan menjadi past participle 'founded' untuk menerangkan organisasi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ a badminton player won the grand slam of major titles without possessing exceptional stamina and technical precision.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dipicu oleh 'rarely'. Karena subjeknya 'a badminton player' (tunggal) dan menggunakan past participle 'won', maka auxiliary 'has' (Present Perfect) digunakan.
