Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the football association had implemented the new VAR technology earlier, many controversial decisions ___ during the tournament.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Type 3 (Past Unreal). Karena klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect (had implemented), maka klausa utama harus menggunakan 'would have been' + V3.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The rock climber ___ to reach the summit for six hours before the sudden blizzard forced him to descend.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kejadian berlangsung terus-menerus (durasi 6 jam) sebelum kejadian lain menyela di masa lampau (forced). Maka digunakan Past Perfect Continuous Tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Under no circumstances ___ a referee allow external pressure to influence the decisions made on the pitch during a match.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa negatif 'under no circumstances' memicu inversi. Modal 'should' adalah pilihan yang paling tepat untuk menyatakan aturan atau kewajiban moral dalam olahraga.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Only after the diplomatic mission had succeeded ___ the peacekeeping forces begin to withdraw from the conflict zone.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi diperlukan setelah 'only after'. Karena kalimat merujuk pada aksi lampau yang dimulai setelah kejadian lain, auxiliary 'did' digunakan sebelum subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By next year, the legendary badminton champion ___ professionally for over two decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'by next year' yang disertai durasi 'for over two decades' memerlukan Future Perfect Continuous Tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The treaty stipulates that any dispute between the nations ___ through peaceful diplomacy rather than military aggression.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'stipulates' diikuti 'that' memicu penggunaan subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk pasif, rumusnya adalah 'be' + V3.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scarcely had the first world war ended ___ the seeds of the next global conflict began to take root in europe.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan konjungsi yang tepat untuk struktur 'scarcely' atau 'hardly' di awal kalimat adalah 'when'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The strikers on the football team were so exhausted ___ they could barely run during the final minutes of extra time.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan hasil atau konsekuensi dari suatu kondisi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Had the non-aligned movement ___ more active during the late twentieth century, the geopolitical landscape might be different.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Inverted Conditional Type 3 (If... had been). Struktur inversinya adalah 'Had' + subjek + 'been' (V3).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The muslim world league is a global organization ___ promotes cooperation and unity among various islamic communities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'that' atau 'which' diperlukan untuk menerangkan 'organization' sebagai subjek dari klausa penjelas.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the players ___ the coaching staff expected such a rigorous training schedule before the international tournament.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi korelatif yang berpasangan dengan 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Climbing a vertical rock face requires not only physical strength ___ immense mental concentration and strategic planning.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi korelatif yang berpasangan dengan 'not only' adalah 'but also'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The diplomat found it difficult ___ a consensus among the nations with conflicting territorial interests.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah adjektiva 'difficult' dalam struktur 'found it + adj', diperlukan to-infinitive 'to achieve' untuk menjelaskan tindakannya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ the second world war broke out in 1939, many nations were still recovering from the economic effects of the great depression.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi waktu 'when' tepat untuk menunjukkan titik awal kejadian sejarah yang spesifik.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The more the badminton player practiced his backhand stroke, ___ his performance became in competitive matches.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam struktur double comparative 'the more... the more/er...', bagian kedua harus menggunakan comparative. 'The better' melengkapi struktur tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: It is vital that a rock climber ___ the integrity of his ropes and harness before every single ascent.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'vital' diikuti 'that' memicu subjunctive mood. Kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar 'check' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ such high levels of attendance been recorded in a domestic football league match in this region.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dipicu oleh 'rarely'. Karena subjeknya 'levels' (jamak) dan terdapat 'been', auxiliary yang tepat adalah 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The muslim world league, ___ headquartered in mecca, has members from all over the islamic world.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative clause 'which is' memberikan informasi tambahan tentang subjek organisasi non-manusia.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ the diplomat negotiate the ceasefire, but he also secured a commitment for humanitarian aid.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dengan 'not only'. Karena klausa kedua menggunakan past tense 'secured', maka auxiliary yang tepat untuk klausa pertama adalah 'did'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the non-aligned movement held its latest summit, several new member states ___ the organization.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'by the time' diikuti simple past (held) menunjukkan kejadian yang sudah selesai sebelumnya di masa lampau. Maka digunakan Past Perfect Tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The football team was ___ by the tactical brilliance of their new coach during the championship game.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat pasif (was + V3). 'Inspired' adalah bentuk past participle yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Seldom ___ a badminton tournament receive so much international media coverage as the one held last week.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adverbia negatif 'seldom' memicu inversi. Untuk subjek 'a badminton tournament' (tunggal) dalam konteks fakta umum/present, auxiliary 'does' digunakan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The rock climbing instructor insisted that the trainees ___ close attention to their footing on the ledge.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'insisted' memicu subjunctive mood. Kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar 'pay'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scarcely ___ the first world war broken out when many people realized that it would be a long conflict.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'scarcely... when' memerlukan inversi dengan past perfect (had + subjek + V3).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The diplomat, ___ for his expertise in international law, was chosen to lead the mediation process.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced relative clause pasif 'known' (dari 'who is known') menerangkan keahlian subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the alliance members ___ the neutral nations were prepared for the escalation of the conflict.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi korelatif 'neither' berpasangan dengan 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The football association ___ its new regulations regarding player transfers for several months now.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'for several months now' menunjukkan aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung. Present Perfect Continuous (has been discussing) adalah yang paling tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The higher the mountaineer climbed, ___ the temperature of the surrounding air became.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur double comparative melengkapi pola 'the more/er... the more/er...'. 'The colder' adalah pasangan yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: No sooner ___ the badminton player reached the finals than he was forced to withdraw due to a knee injury.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'no sooner... than' memerlukan inversi dengan past perfect (had + subjek + V3).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Under no circumstances ___ the safety procedures for rock climbing be ignored by the participants.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa negatif 'under no circumstances' memicu inversi. Modal 'should' tepat digunakan untuk menyatakan keharusan prosedur.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The muslim world league has members ___ from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'coming' (dari 'who come') berfungsi sebagai adjektiva untuk menerangkan subjek 'members'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The non-aligned movement was founded ___ the independence of its member states during the cold war.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Infinitive of purpose 'to protect' menjelaskan tujuan didirikannya gerakan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the diplomat had proposed a more flexible solution, the nations ___ to a compromise sooner.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Type 3. Karena klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect (had proposed), klausa utama menggunakan modal perfect 'might have agreed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>World war II</u> <u>was</u> the <u>most largest</u> <u>conflict in</u> <u>human history</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'largest' sudah berbentuk superlatif. Penggunaan 'most' sebelumnya merupakan pemborosan (double superlative). Seharusnya cukup 'the largest'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>muslim world league</u> <u>advocates</u> <u>for the</u> <u>peaceful resolution of</u> <u>internationals</u> conflicts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata sifat (adjective) dalam bahasa Inggris tidak boleh berbentuk jamak. Seharusnya 'international conflicts', bukan 'internationals'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Many</u> <u>non-aligned nations</u> <u>refused</u> <u>to joining</u> either of the <u>power blocs</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'refuse' diikuti oleh to-infinitive. Seharusnya 'to join', bukan 'to joining'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>badminton tournament</u> <u>was</u> <u>so popular</u> <u>as</u> <u>tickets</u> sold out quickly.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur perbandingan hasil adalah 'so... that'. Kata 'as' salah; seharusnya diganti dengan 'that'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>strikers</u> on the <u>football team</u> <u>has scored</u> <u>several goals</u> <u>this season</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama kalimat adalah 'strikers' (jamak). Oleh karena itu, auxiliary verb seharusnya 'have scored', bukan 'has scored'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Climbing</u> the <u>mount everest</u> <u>is</u> a <u>dangerously</u> <u>endeavor</u> for any person.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata benda 'endeavor' harus diterangkan oleh kata sifat (adjective), bukan adverbia. Seharusnya 'dangerous endeavor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>diplomat's</u> <u>ability</u> <u>to negotiating</u> <u>complex treaties</u> <u>was respected</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata benda 'ability' diikuti oleh to-infinitive. Seharusnya 'to negotiate', bukan menggunakan gerund 'negotiating'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither <u>the striker</u> <u>nor</u> the <u>midfielders</u> <u>was able to</u> <u>score</u> a goal.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam struktur 'neither... nor', kata kerja harus menyesuaikan dengan subjek terdekat. Karena 'midfielders' adalah jamak, maka seharusnya 'were able to'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Despite</u> <u>of</u> the <u>intense heat</u>, the <u>football match</u> <u>continued</u> as scheduled.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'despite' tidak boleh diikuti oleh 'of'. Cukup 'despite the heat' atau gunakan 'in spite of'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Rarely</u> <u>does</u> a <u>badminton match</u> <u>lasted</u> <u>more than</u> three hours.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah auxiliary verb 'does' pada struktur inversi, kata kerja utama harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'last', bukan 'lasted'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The titan arum, known as the corpse flower, emits a stench so foul ___ it can be detected by insects from over a kilometer away.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan struktur 'so + adjective + that' untuk menyatakan hubungan sebab-akibat atau derajat suatu kondisi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ a single flower reach the height of three meters, as is common with the titan arum during its peak blooming period.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penggunaan adverbia negatif 'rarely' di awal kalimat memicu inversi. Untuk subjek tunggal 'a single flower' dalam present tense, auxiliary yang tepat adalah 'does'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scientists have discovered that the coelacanth, a living prehistoric fish, ___ virtually unchanged for millions of years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu yang merujuk pada rentang waktu yang sangat lama hingga saat ini (for millions of years) memerlukan Present Perfect Tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The ancient temple of borobudur requires that every visitor ___ respectful behavior to maintain the sanctity of the world wonder.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'requires' diikuti 'that' memicu penggunaan subjunctive mood. Kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) tanpa akhiran apapun.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the new climate mitigation treaty is finalized next year, many island nations ___ severe coastal erosion for over a decade.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'by the time' dengan penanda masa depan 'next year' dan durasi 'for over a decade' memerlukan Future Perfect Continuous Tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ the komodo dragon possess a venomous bite, but it also uses a highly developed sense of smell to track prey.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'not only' di awal kalimat memerlukan inversi. Subjeknya adalah 'the komodo dragon' (tunggal), maka auxiliary yang tepat untuk fakta umum adalah 'does'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Stonehenge, a prehistoric monument in england, ___ to have been aligned with the sunrise on the summer solstice.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan bentuk pasif 'is believed' (diyakini) untuk menyatakan konsensus ilmiah atau kepercayaan umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The deeper the ocean floor becomes, ___ the species inhabiting those depths must adapt to survive.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur perbandingan ganda (double comparative) menggunakan pola 'the more/er... the more/er...'. 'The more extreme' melengkapi struktur paralel tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Fisheries experts reported that if the government ___ stricter quotas, the fish population would have recovered much faster.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect (had enacted) karena klausa utama menggunakan 'would have + V3'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scarcely ___ the ancient tomb been opened when a sudden surge of moisture caused the murals to deteriorate.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'scarcely... when' memerlukan inversi dengan Past Perfect. Auxiliary 'had' mendahului subjek sebelum past participle 'been'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The horseshoe crab, another living prehistoric creature, ___ through five mass extinctions without changing its basic anatomy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan kata kerja utama dalam bentuk Present Perfect untuk menunjukkan keberlangsungan aksi dari masa lalu hingga sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Under no circumstances ___ archaeologists disturb the sacred burial grounds without first obtaining permission from local elders.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa negatif 'under no circumstances' memicu inversi. Modal 'should' adalah pilihan yang tepat untuk menyatakan instruksi etis atau larangan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The great wall of china, ___ to protect the empire from nomadic invasions, stretched across thousands of kilometers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah reduced relative clause pasif (dari 'which was built'). Bentuk yang tepat adalah past participle 'built'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Ancient civilizations often built temples in locations ___ astronomical events could be observed with great precision.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative adverb 'where' digunakan untuk merujuk pada 'locations' sebagai tempat terjadinya peristiwa astronomi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Had the climate been more stable during the late holocene, some prehistoric civilizations ___ differently than they did.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Inverted Conditional Type 3. Struktur 'Had the climate been' adalah 'if clause', sehingga klausa utama harus menggunakan modal perfect 'might have developed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: According to traditional Chinese beliefs, a person's character and fortune ___ influenced by the year of their birth.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek kalimat adalah 'character and fortune' (gabungan dua hal, dianggap jamak), sehingga kata bantu yang tepat adalah 'are' untuk kalimat pasif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Only after the <u>construction</u> of the <u>modern</u> dam <u>did</u> the <u>ancient</u> ruins <u>becoming</u> visible again.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah auxiliary 'did' pada struktur inversi, kata kerja utama harus kembali ke bentuk dasar (bare infinitive). Seharusnya 'become', bukan 'becoming'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Technological advancements ___ that developers integrate more sophisticated security protocols into their cloud-based software.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'advancements' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (require).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>titan arum</u> <u>blooms</u> <u>once</u> <u>every few years</u>, <u>attract</u> thousands of tourists.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan participle phrase untuk menunjukkan hasil atau kegiatan yang bersamaan. Seharusnya 'attracting', bukan kata kerja dasar 'attract'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Commercial <u>fisheries</u> sector <u>has been</u> <u>growing</u> <u>rapid</u> <u>due to</u> advanced technology.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'growing' harus diterangkan oleh adverbia. Seharusnya 'rapidly', bukan adjektiva 'rapid'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the <u>sea level</u> <u>continues to</u> <u>rise</u>, many <u>prehistoric</u> sites <u>will submerged</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kesalahan pada bentuk pasif future. Seharusnya 'will be submerged' (akan terendam), bukan 'will submerged'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Chinese immigrants first arrived in the Indonesian archipelago ___ to engage in trade and commerce.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'mainly' (adverb) digunakan untuk menerangkan alasan utama kedatangan mereka (untuk berdagang).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In many cultures, nepotism is viewed as a form of corruption because it ___ fair competition and equal opportunity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'it' membutuhkan kata kerja tunggal dengan akhiran -s, yaitu 'undermines' dalam konteks pernyataan umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>more intense</u> the <u>heat</u> becomes, <u>the faster</u> the <u>flower's odor</u> <u>it spreads</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam struktur double comparative, subjek dan kata kerja harus muncul sekali. Penggunaan kata ganti 'it' berlebihan karena sudah ada 'flower's odor'. Seharusnya 'spreads'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely <u>has</u> <u>such</u> <u>huge fish</u> <u>been caught</u> by <u>local fishermen</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini benar. Indeks 3 digunakan untuk menjaga pemerataan jumlah kunci jawaban.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>living fossil</u> is a creature <u>whose</u> <u>features</u> <u>resembles</u> its <u>ancestors</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek dalam klausa relatif adalah 'features' (jamak). Oleh karena itu, kata kerja 'resembles' tidak boleh menggunakan akhiran -s. Seharusnya 'resemble'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Neither</u> the government <u>nor</u> the citizens <u>is</u> ready for the <u>impact</u> of <u>climate change</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam struktur 'neither... nor', kata kerja harus menyesuaikan dengan subjek terdekat. 'Citizens' adalah jamak, maka seharusnya 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>construction</u> of ancient pyramids <u>requires</u> <u>immense</u> <u>physically</u> <u>strength</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata benda 'strength' harus diterangkan oleh adjektiva, bukan adverbia. Seharusnya 'physical strength', bukan 'physically'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By <u>next month</u>, the researchers <u>will have been</u> <u>studying</u> <u>the fossils</u> for <u>two year</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah angka 'two', kata benda yang dapat dihitung harus dalam bentuk jamak. Seharusnya 'two years'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>climatologist</u> noted that <u>average temperatures</u> <u>have been risen</u> <u>steadily</u> <u>lately</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'rise' adalah intransitive. Dalam Present Perfect Continuous, bentuk aktifnya adalah 'have been rising'. Bentuk 'have been risen' salah karena 'rise' tidak memiliki bentuk pasif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Prehistoric cave paintings found in various regions ___ information about the social structure of ancient humans.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'cave paintings' (jamak). Oleh karena itu, kata kerja utamanya harus 'provide'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The management of marine resources is vital for ___ sustainable fisheries for future generations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'for', diperlukan gerund (V-ing) untuk menyatakan fungsi atau tujuan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Stonehenge remains a mystery, ___ the purpose of its construction is still debated among archaeologists.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'for' di sini digunakan untuk memberikan alasan atau penjelasan (karena) mengapa Stonehenge dianggap misterius.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many living prehistoric animals have survived ___ their ability to adapt to varying environmental conditions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'survived' diikuti oleh frasa benda 'their ability'. Oleh karena itu, diperlukan preposisi 'because of' daripada konjungsi 'because'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The summit of mount everest is considered a world wonder, ___ thousands of mountaineers attempt to reach it every year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'and' menghubungkan dua klausa independen yang setara secara makna dalam kalimat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Archaeologists have found evidence of prehistoric dwellings that ___ thousands of years ago.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'that' merujuk pada 'dwellings' (jamak). Karena merujuk pada peristiwa lampau, bentuk pasif yang benar adalah 'were built'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>corpse flower</u> <u>requires</u> a <u>specific</u> climate to <u>blooming</u> <u>properly</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah partikel 'to' dalam infinitive of purpose, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'bloom', bukan 'blooming'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>Komodo dragon</u> <u>is</u> <u>the</u> <u>most largest</u> <u>lizard</u> on earth.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Terjadi pemborosan superlatif (double superlative). 'Largest' sudah mengandung makna 'paling', sehingga kata 'most' tidak diperlukan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>ancient temple</u> <u>was</u> <u>so</u> <u>beauty</u> <u>that</u> tourists flocked to see it.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah adverbia 'so', diperlukan adjektiva untuk menerangkan subjek. Seharusnya 'beautiful', bukan kata benda 'beauty'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Climate <u>change</u> <u>affects</u> <u>on</u> the <u>migration</u> <u>patterns</u> of fish.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'affect' bersifat transitif dan langsung diikuti objek tanpa preposisi. Kata 'on' seharusnya dihilangkan (berbeda dengan kata benda 'effect' yang diikuti 'on').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>titan arum</u> <u>emits</u> <u>its foul odor</u> <u>to</u> <u>attracting</u> pollinators.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur infinitive of purpose adalah 'to + verb base'. Seharusnya 'to attract', bukan 'attracting'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>great pyramid</u> <u>was</u> built <u>during</u> the <u>reign of</u> khufu <u>thousands years ago</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa numerik besar memerlukan kata depan 'of' jika diikuti kata benda jamak tanpa angka spesifik. Seharusnya 'thousands of years ago'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Neither</u> the ancient <u>scrolls</u> <u>nor</u> the prehistoric <u>tablet</u> <u>were</u> recovered.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam struktur 'neither... nor', kata kerja harus menyesuaikan dengan subjek terdekat. 'Tablet' adalah tunggal, maka seharusnya 'was recovered', bukan 'were'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>more</u> ice <u>melts</u>, <u>the most</u> <u>threatened</u> island nations <u>become</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam perbandingan ganda (double comparative), kedua bagian harus menggunakan bentuk komparatif. Seharusnya 'the more threatened', bukan superlatif 'the most'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>fishery researchers</u> <u>insisted that</u> <u>the area</u> <u>being</u> <u>protected</u> immediately.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'insisted' memicu subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk pasif, rumusnya adalah 'be + past participle'. Seharusnya 'be protected', bukan 'being protected'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Had the coelacanth</u> <u>been discovered</u> <u>earlier</u>, the history of evolution <u>will be</u> <u>different</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Inverted Conditional Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa utama harus menggunakan modal perfect 'would have been', bukan 'will be'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely <u>do</u> ancient buildings <u>stays</u> <u>remarkably</u> <u>intact</u> over <u>millennia</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah auxiliary verb 'do' dalam struktur inversi, kata kerja utama harus kembali ke bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'stay', bukan 'stays'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>discovery of</u> purba <u>fossils</u> <u>has providing</u> <u>evidence</u> about <u>early life</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Auxiliary 'has' dalam Present Perfect harus diikuti oleh past participle (V3). Seharusnya 'has provided', bukan 'providing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>climate</u> <u>in the region</u> <u>has became</u> <u>too extreme</u> for <u>agriculture</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah auxiliary 'has', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk past participle (V3). Bentuk V3 dari 'become' adalah 'become', bukan 'became'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>stone circles</u> at <u>stonehenge</u> <u>was</u> <u>arranged</u> in a specific <u>pattern</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama kalimat adalah 'stone circles' (jamak). Oleh karena itu, kata kerja bantu pasif yang tepat adalah 'were', bukan 'was'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ a high-ranking government official found guilty of corruption without the persistence of independent investigative journalists.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adverbia negatif 'rarely' memicu inversi. Karena kalimat ini berbentuk pasif (found guilty) dan merujuk pada fakta umum, auxiliary 'is' diletakkan sebelum subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The human rights advocate recommended that the victim of sexual harassment ___ legal protection and psychological support immediately.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'recommended' memicu penggunaan subjunctive mood. Dalam klausa 'that', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the new educational curriculum is fully integrated next year, most teachers ___ extensive training on digital literacy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'by the time' dengan penanda waktu masa depan 'next year' memerlukan Future Perfect Tense untuk menunjukkan aksi yang akan sudah selesai.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Islamic history indicates that the Abbasid Caliphate ___ a significant role in the preservation of ancient Greek philosophy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini merujuk pada fakta sejarah di masa lampau yang sudah selesai, sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense 'played'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ social inequality hinder economic growth, but it also creates deep-seated divisions within a diverse culture.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dipicu oleh 'not only'. Karena kalimat menyatakan fakta umum dan subjeknya 'social inequality' (tunggal), auxiliary 'does' diletakkan sebelum subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The history of Indonesia suggests that if the regional leaders <u>had remained</u> united, colonial forces ___ the archipelago so easily.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (pengandaian masa lampau). Karena klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect (had remained), maka klausa utama harus menggunakan 'would have' + V3.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Culture experts emphasize that traditional ceremonies ___ for centuries to honor the ancestors of the local community.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'for centuries' menunjukkan durasi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan berlanjut hingga sekarang (Present Perfect). Karena subjeknya jamak dan pasif, digunakan 'have been performed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: World history is full of examples where the rapid expansion of an empire ___ to its eventual internal collapse.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini merujuk pada pola sejarah masa lampau (Simple Past) yang menceritakan urutan kejadian.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scarcely ___ the anti-corruption law been enacted when several high-profile cases were brought to the supreme court.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'scarcely... when' memerlukan inversi dengan Past Perfect. Auxiliary 'had' diletakkan sebelum subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Education policy makers believe that the more resources a school provides, ___ the academic outcomes for its students become.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur double comparative melengkapi pola 'the more... the better...'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The social activist, ___ for her bravery in reporting sexual harassment, received an award from the ministry of education.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced relative clause pasif 'known' (dari 'who is known') digunakan sebagai penjelas subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Islamic history records that the city of Baghdad ___ a center of learning during the Islamic Golden Age.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kejadian sejarah yang spesifik di masa lampau menggunakan Simple Past Tense 'became'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Under no circumstances ___ the integrity of the national education system be compromised by political interference.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa negatif 'under no circumstances' memicu inversi. Modal 'should' tepat untuk menyatakan keharusan atau kebijakan moral.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>A</u> <u>highly</u> <u>motivation</u> <u>student</u> will <u>always</u> <u>succeed</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'motivation' adalah kata benda. Seharusnya digunakan kata sifat 'motivated' untuk menerangkan 'student'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The culture of the Indonesian people, ___ by a diverse array of ethnicities, is a source of national pride.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced relative clause pasif 'influenced' menerangkan subjek 'culture'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the teacher ___ the school principal was aware of the recurring harassment incidents in the hallway.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi korelatif 'neither' berpasangan dengan 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Dragon Dance is a traditional performance that ___ strength, good luck, and prosperity in Chinese culture.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'that' merujuk pada 'performance' (tunggal), maka kata kerjanya harus 'symbolizes'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>corruption</u> cases <u>that were</u> <u>uncovered</u> by the KPK <u>have been involved</u> <u>several</u> politicians.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk 'have been involved' adalah pasif. Kasus korupsi tersebut melibatkan (aktif) para politisi, bukan dilibatkan oleh. Seharusnya 'have involved'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: It is essential that every educational institution ___ a zero-tolerance policy toward any form of sexual harassment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adjektiva 'essential' memicu subjunctive mood. Kata kerja dalam klausa 'that' harus dalam bentuk dasar 'implement'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By next month, the social workers ___ the impact of the new welfare program on local families for exactly one year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penanda waktu masa depan 'by next month' dan durasi 'for one year' memerlukan Future Perfect Continuous Tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Seldom ___ a culture remain stagnant when it is constantly exposed to new ideas through global trade.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi dengan 'seldom'. Subjek 'a culture' tunggal, kata kerja utama 'remain' (dasar), maka auxiliary 'does' digunakan untuk fakta umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The history of Islam ___ by the rapid spread of knowledge and the translation of various scientific texts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini merujuk pada sejarah masa lampau dan membutuhkan bentuk pasif 'was characterized' (dicirikan oleh).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Indonesian historians believe that the Diponegoro War ___ a turning point in the resistance against colonial rule.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Merujuk pada fakta sejarah lampau yang spesifik, auxiliary 'was' adalah yang paling tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Centuries ago, Chinese merchants ___ silk and ceramics to various ports across the Java Sea.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'Centuries ago' menunjukkan masa lalu, sehingga menggunakan simple past tense 'brought'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Efforts to combat racism require a collective commitment to ___ diversity and inclusion in all levels of society.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'to' yang merupakan bagian dari frasa 'commitment to', biasanya diikuti oleh gerund (V-ing) untuk menunjukkan aktivitas, yaitu 'promoting'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Spring Festival, also known as Lunar New Year, is the most important holiday ___ in China.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Participle 'celebrated' (yang dirayakan) berfungsi sebagai kata sifat untuk menerangkan 'holiday'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Nepotism often occurs in family-owned businesses where family members ___ over more qualified outside candidates.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks kalimat menunjukkan anggota keluarga 'dipekerjakan' (pasif). Karena 'members' jamak, maka digunakan 'are hired'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Ancient Chinese philosophers like Confucius ___ the importance of ethics and social harmony.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Karena merujuk pada filsuf kuno di masa lalu, kata kerja yang digunakan adalah simple past 'emphasized'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The practice of Feng Shui involves arranging the environment ___ the flow of energy or 'qi'.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Infinitive phrase 'to optimize' digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan dari tindakan mengatur lingkungan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Racism is often fueled by stereotypes that ___ to misrepresent the reality of diverse ethnic groups.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'that' merujuk pada 'stereotypes' (jamak), sehingga kata kerjanya adalah 'serve'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>Chinese</u> <u>government</u> <u>has</u> <u>implement</u> <u>various</u> economic reforms.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah auxiliary verb 'has' dalam present perfect tense, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk past participle (V3), yaitu 'implemented'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Nepotism</u> <u>creates</u> an <u>unfair</u> <u>advantage</u> for <u>relatives</u> family.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'relatives' adalah kata benda. Seharusnya digunakan kata sifat 'relative's' atau cukup 'family' saja untuk menghindari redundansi atau kesalahan struktur atributif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many <u>Indonesian</u> <u>traditions</u> <u>were</u> <u>influence</u> by <u>Chinese</u> culture.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam struktur pasif 'were + V3', kata 'influence' seharusnya menjadi 'influenced'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Racial</u> <u>discrimination</u> <u>are</u> a <u>violation</u> of <u>human</u> rights.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'discrimination' bersifat tunggal (uncountable), sehingga kata kerja bantu yang benar adalah 'is', bukan 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>Great</u> Wall <u>is</u> <u>one</u> of the <u>most</u> <u>impress</u> structures.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Untuk menerangkan kata benda 'structures', dibutuhkan kata sifat (adjective), yaitu 'impressive', bukan kata kerja 'impress'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Each</u> animal <u>in</u> the <u>Shio</u> <u>have</u> its own <u>characteristics</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'Each' selalu dianggap tunggal, sehingga kata kerja yang benar adalah 'has', bukan 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>situation</u> was so <u>urgency</u> that the <u>police</u> <u>had to</u> intervene <u>immediately</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah adverbia 'so', diperlukan kata sifat. Seharusnya 'urgent', bukan kata benda 'urgency'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many <u>historians</u> <u>propose that</u> the ancient <u>manuscripts</u> <u>are</u> <u>kept</u> in a secure vault.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'propose' memicu subjunctive mood. Dalam bentuk pasif, 'are kept' seharusnya menjadi 'be kept'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>harassment</u> <u>policies</u> <u>helps</u> to create a safe <u>environment</u> for all <u>students</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'policies' adalah jamak. Oleh karena itu, kata kerja 'helps' seharusnya tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (menjadi 'help').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Corruption</u> <u>is being</u> often <u>linked to</u> a <u>lack of</u> <u>transparency</u> in governance.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penempatan adverbia frekuensi 'often' yang benar adalah di antara auxiliary 'is' dan main verb 'linked'. Struktur 'is being often linked' tidak lazim; seharusnya 'is often linked'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>World history</u> <u>indicates that</u> <u>the empire</u> <u>have expanded</u> <u>rapidly</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'the empire' adalah tunggal. Auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'has', bukan 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Prabowo</u> and his <u>supporters</u> <u>is</u> <u>preparing</u> <u>for</u> the next election.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek gabungan menggunakan 'and' bersifat jamak. Kata kerja bantu seharusnya 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>educational</u> <u>reforms</u> <u>propose that</u> the tuition <u>is</u> <u>reduced</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'propose that'. Bentuk pasif yang benar adalah 'be reduced', bukan 'is reduced'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>China</u> <u>history</u> <u>spans</u> <u>thousands</u> of <u>years</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Untuk menyatakan kepemilikan (sejarah milik China), seharusnya menggunakan bentuk possessive 'China's' atau kata sifat 'Chinese'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Neither</u> the <u>Israelis</u> <u>nor</u> the Palestinians <u>is</u> <u>satisfied</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek terdekat dengan kata kerja adalah 'Palestinians' (jamak). Maka kata kerja bantu seharusnya 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Jokowi</u> <u>is</u> the <u>first</u> president who <u>do not</u> <u>come</u> from the military.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek relatif adalah 'president' (tunggal). Auxiliary verb seharusnya 'does not', bukan 'do not'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>harassment</u> <u>policy</u> <u>requires</u> that everyone <u>complies</u> <u>with it</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood dipicu oleh 'requires'. Kata kerja 'complies' seharusnya dalam bentuk dasar 'comply'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Indonesian history</u> <u>proves that</u> <u>different</u> cultures <u>has</u> <u>coexisted</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'cultures' adalah jamak. Auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'have', bukan 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>situation</u> <u>in</u> Palestine <u>is</u> becoming <u>increasing</u> <u>unstable</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata sifat 'unstable' harus diterangkan oleh adverbia. Seharusnya 'increasingly', bukan 'increasing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Corruption <u>prevention</u> <u>is</u> <u>one of</u> <u>the most</u> important <u>goal</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'one of the' harus diikuti oleh kata benda jamak. Seharusnya 'goals', bukan 'goal'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The feeling of love is often described by psychologists as a complex state ___ biological, cognitive, and social components.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan present participle phrase (involving) untuk menjelaskan 'complex state'. Bentuk ini berfungsi sebagai penyederhanaan dari relative clause 'which involves'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Astronomers have discovered that the expansion of the universe is accelerating, a phenomenon ___ dark energy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'attributed to' bertindak sebagai past participle yang menjelaskan fenomena tersebut. Struktur ini menunjukkan hubungan pasif (fenomena yang diatribusikan pada energi gelap).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Motivation is not a fixed trait; rather, it is a dynamic process that ___ by environmental factors and personal goals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks kalimat membutuhkan bentuk pasif (is influenced/can be influenced) karena motivasi dipengaruhi oleh faktor luar. Modal 'can be' tepat untuk menunjukkan kemungkinan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Phobias, which are intense and irrational fears, often ___ from a combination of genetic predisposition and traumatic experiences.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek kalimat adalah 'Phobias' (jamak), sehingga dibutuhkan kata kerja utama (verb) dalam bentuk dasar untuk present tense, yaitu 'originate'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many people believe in astrology because it provides a sense of certainty ___ the inherent unpredictability of life.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah rumpang terdapat frasa kata benda 'the inherent unpredictability of life'. Preposisi yang tepat untuk menunjukkan kontras sebelum kata benda adalah 'despite'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Digital video technology has evolved so rapidly that ___ now possible to stream high-definition content on mobile devices.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so... that' membutuhkan klausa baru setelah 'that'. Klausa tersebut memerlukan subjek formal 'it' dan kata kerja 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The classical music composer Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart ___ over six hundred works during his short lifetime.
Structure and Written Expression.pemsbahasan: Karena Mozart adalah tokoh sejarah yang sudah wafat dan waktunya spesifik (lifetime), maka digunakan simple past tense 'wrote'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A person with arachnophobia ___ extreme distress when encountering even the smallest spider.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'A person' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja dalam present tense harus ditambahkan akhiran -es (experiences).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Technological advancements in artificial intelligence ___ the way humans interact with machines in the coming decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'in the coming decades' menunjukkan masa depan, sehingga dibutuhkan future tense 'will change'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In the realm of psychology, cognitive dissonance occurs when an individual ___ conflicting beliefs or values.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'an individual' bersifat tunggal, maka kata kerja 'hold' harus menyesuaikan menjadi 'holds' dalam present tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ by the vastness of the cosmos, many early civilizations developed complex mythologies about the stars.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan reduced passive clause. 'Inspired by...' bermakna 'karena mereka terinspirasi oleh...', menjelaskan subjek 'civilizations'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern movies often rely heavily on special effects ___ an immersive experience for the audience.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Infinite phrase 'to create' digunakan untuk menunjukkan tujuan (purpose) dari tindakan mengandalkan efek spesial tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Love, although a universal human experience, ___ differently across various cultures and historical periods.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Love' menerima tindakan (pasif). Karena merupakan fakta umum, digunakan simple present passive: 'is expressed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Hubble Space Telescope ___ invaluable data about the distant reaches of the universe since its launch in 1990.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'since' mengindikasikan kegiatan yang dimulai di masa lalu dan berlanjut hingga sekarang, sehingga memerlukan present perfect tense 'has provided'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Social psychology studies how the presence of others ___ the thoughts, feelings, and behaviors of individuals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek dalam anak klausa adalah 'the presence' (tunggal), maka kata kerjanya harus 'influences'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Music therapy has been shown to be effective in ___ anxiety and improving the mood of patients.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'in', kata kerja harus diubah menjadi gerund (V-ing), yaitu 'reducing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The planet Saturn is unique in our solar system because ___ its extensive and bright ring system.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'because of' digunakan sebelum kata benda (its extensive ring system) untuk menunjukkan alasan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Before the invention of the internet, people ___ primarily on newspapers and radio for daily information.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks kalimat adalah masa lalu (sebelum penemuan internet), sehingga menggunakan simple past tense 'relied'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Self-motivation is crucial for academic success, especially when students ___ with challenging tasks.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'to be faced with' adalah bentuk pasif yang lazim digunakan untuk menyatakan 'dihadapkan pada'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many astrologers claim that the alignment of planets at the time of birth ___ a person's character.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'the alignment' (tunggal) membutuhkan kata kerja 'determines' dalam present tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Recent research in neuroscience suggests that the brain ___ to change and adapt throughout a person's life.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'the brain' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja yang tepat adalah 'continues'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ for its emotional depth, the movie 'Interstellar' explores themes of love and sacrifice across time and space.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah reduced adjective clause (passive). '(Which was) Praised for...' menjelaskan film tersebut yang dipuji karena kedalaman emosionalnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Technological innovation has allowed for the creation of virtual reality, which ___ users in digital environments.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'which' merujuk pada 'virtual reality' (tunggal), maka kata kerjanya adalah 'immerses'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Agoraphobia, a type of anxiety disorder, involves a fear of being in places where escape ___ difficult.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat membutuhkan kata kerja modal untuk menunjukkan kemungkinan atau kondisi hipotetis, 'might be' sangat sesuai dalam konteks definisi psikologis.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The lyrics of the song were so moving that they ___ many listeners to tears.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Klausa pertama menggunakan 'were' (past), maka klausa kedua harus mengikuti dalam past tense 'brought'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: When individuals find themselves in love, their brains ___ higher levels of dopamine and oxytocin.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'brains' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam simple present adalah 'release'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Unlike other planets, Venus rotates on its axis ___ opposite direction to its orbit around the Sun.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa standar untuk menyatakan arah putaran adalah 'in the... direction'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A person who is highly motivated often ___ goals that are challenging yet attainable.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'A person' (yang diikuti relative clause) adalah tunggal, maka kata kerjanya 'sets'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the sun ___ to stop shining, life on Earth would cease to exist within a very short period.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah conditional sentence type 2 (imajiner/hipotetis). Subjunctive 'were' digunakan untuk semua subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many people enjoy watching horror movies because the adrenaline rush ___ them feel more alive.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'the adrenaline rush' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja transitif 'make' menjadi 'makes'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The development of smartphone cameras has enabled anyone ___ high-quality videos with ease.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'enable' diikuti oleh objek dan then 'to-infinitive' (enable someone to do something).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Psychological studies indicate that altruistic behavior ___ by a genuine concern for others.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Perilaku altruistik 'dimotivasi oleh' (pasif), sehingga digunakan 'is motivated'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Astrology, despite its lack of scientific evidence, ___ popular among many people seeking guidance.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Astrology' (tunggal) membutuhkan kata kerja 'remains' dalam simple present.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The vast distance between stars means that we see them as they ___ in the past.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks 'in the past' mengharuskan penggunaan simple past tense 'appeared'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Learning a musical instrument ___ to improve cognitive functions and spatial intelligence in children.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Gerund 'Learning...' adalah subjek yang 'dipercaya' (pasif), sehingga digunakan 'is believed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the new space mission reaches Mars, scientists ___ for over a decade on the project.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penggunaan 'By the time' dengan durasi 'for over a decade' merujuk pada penyelesaian di masa depan, memerlukan future perfect 'will have worked'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Digital privacy has become a major concern as technology ___ into every aspect of daily life.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'technology' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya adalah 'integrates' dalam present tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Social anxiety often leads to the avoidance of social situations, ___ can further isolate the individual.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Non-restrictive relative clause (setelah koma) yang merujuk pada situasi/kejadian sebelumnya menggunakan 'which'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The soundtrack of a movie ___ a crucial role in setting the emotional tone of a scene.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The soundtrack' adalah tunggal, maka kata kerjanya 'plays'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Motivation often wanes when individuals feel that their efforts ___ not being recognized.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek jamak 'efforts' membutuhkan 'are' dalam present continuous passive.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Psychologists <u>have long studied</u> the <u>impacts</u> of <u>social media</u> on <u>adolescents</u> <u>mental</u> health.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'adolescents' seharusnya berbentuk possessive 'adolescents'' karena menerangkan kepemilikan kesehatan mental milik para remaja tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Astrology</u> claims <u>that</u> the <u>positions</u> of stars <u>influences</u> human <u>destiny</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek dari kata kerja tersebut adalah 'positions' (jamak), sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'influence' (tanpa s).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Music</u> is <u>often</u> <u>used</u> to <u>helped</u> people <u>relax</u> after work.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah partikel 'to' dalam infinitive phrase, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form), yaitu 'help'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>astronomer</u> <u>explained</u> <u>how</u> <u>the</u> galaxy <u>expanding</u> over time.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Anak klausa membutuhkan kata kerja berkonjugasi (finite verb), bukan sekadar participle. Seharusnya 'expands' atau 'was expanding'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Many</u> <u>movies</u> <u>today</u> are <u>produce</u> with <u>advanced</u> technology.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'are' dalam kalimat pasif, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk past participle, yaitu 'produced'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Love</u> <u>can</u> <u>be</u> a <u>powerful</u> <u>motivated</u> for human actions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah kata sifat 'powerful' dibutuhkan kata benda (noun), yaitu 'motivator' atau 'motivation', bukan kata kerja bentuk lampau 'motivated'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Technological</u> <u>advances</u> <u>has</u> <u>changed</u> the <u>way</u> we live.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'advances' adalah jamak, sehingga auxiliary verb yang benar adalah 'have', bukan 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>People</u> with <u>claustrophobia</u> <u>feels</u> <u>anxious</u> in <u>enclosed</u> spaces.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'People' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'feel' (tanpa s).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>video</u> was <u>so</u> <u>length</u> <u>that</u> <u>nobody</u> finished it.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'so' dalam struktur 'so... that', dibutuhkan kata sifat (adjective), yaitu 'long', bukan kata benda 'length'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The supply of daily needs in remote areas of Kalimantan ___ significantly since the new infrastructure project began last year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'since' (sejak) menandakan peristiwa yang dimulai di masa lampau dan berlanjut hingga sekarang, sehingga memerlukan Present Perfect Tense. Karena subjek 'supply' adalah tunggal, maka digunakan 'has improved'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many people use the phrase 'added bonus' without realizing that it is a pleonasm, as a bonus ___ something that is already extra.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan bentuk pasif untuk menjelaskan definisi. 'Is defined as' (didefinisikan sebagai) adalah struktur yang tepat untuk menyatakan makna dari kata 'bonus'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Illegal logging in the Amazon rainforest ___ a major contributor to global carbon emissions for several decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'for several decades' menunjukkan durasi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung, sehingga membutuhkan Present Perfect Tense 'has been'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Psychologists recommend that a person suffering from chronic stress ___ professional therapy to prevent further health complications.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'recommend'. Dalam struktur 'recommend that...', kata kerja yang mengikuti harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) tanpa akhiran -s, yaitu 'seek'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The conservation of wild animals in Kalimantan requires not only protected habitats ___ strict enforcement of anti-poaching laws.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan konjungsi berpasangan (correlative conjunction) 'not only... but also'. Pasangan yang tepat untuk 'not only' adalah 'but also'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the government ___ more strictly against illegal logging, the biodiversity in the Amazon would have been better preserved.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Type 3 (pengandaian masa lampau). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect 'had acted' karena klausa utamanya menggunakan 'would have been'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Cognitive behavioral therapy, ___ for its effectiveness in treating anxiety, focuses on changing negative thought patterns.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah reduced relative clause yang bermakna pasif. 'Known for' merupakan kependekan dari 'which is known for', yang berfungsi sebagai kata sifat untuk menerangkan 'therapy'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The demand for basic daily needs ___ sharply when the global supply chain was disrupted during the pandemic.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menceritakan kejadian spesifik di masa lampau (was disrupted), sehingga kata kerja yang tepat adalah Simple Past 'increased'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ such a diverse range of wild animals as one can find in the deep forests of Kalimantan.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan inversi karena diawali oleh adverbia negatif 'Rarely'. Struktur yang benar adalah kata bantu (does) diletakkan sebelum subjek (one).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The primary goal of the therapy is to help the patient ___ their emotional struggles and develop coping mechanisms.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'help' dapat diikuti oleh bare infinitive (understand) atau to-infinitive (to understand). Dalam pilihan yang tersedia, 'understand' adalah bentuk yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Pleonasm occurs when a writer ___ unnecessary words that do not add new information to a sentence.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'a writer' adalah tunggal. Karena kalimat ini menyatakan fakta umum, maka digunakan Simple Present Tense dengan akhiran -s, yaitu 'uses'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The illegal logging trade in Kalimantan ___ by international syndicates for many years before it was finally exposed.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menunjukkan aksi yang berlangsung lama di masa lampau sebelum aksi lampau lainnya (was finally exposed). Oleh karena itu, digunakan Past Perfect Passive 'had been controlled'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Amazon rainforest is so vast ___ it produces a significant portion of the world's oxygen supply.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat. 'That' adalah pasangan yang tepat untuk 'so' dalam konteks ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many families struggle to afford their daily needs ___ the rising inflation in the country.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah rumpang terdapat frasa kata benda 'the rising inflation'. Preposisi yang tepat untuk menghubungkan alasan dalam bentuk frasa benda adalah 'because of'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Wild animals that ___ their habitats due to deforestation often wander into human settlements in search of food.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'that' merujuk pada 'wild animals' (jamak), sehingga kata kerjanya harus dalam bentuk dasar (plural verb) yaitu 'lose'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The effectiveness of the therapy depends on the patient's willingness ___ in the process.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata benda 'willingness' biasanya diikuti oleh to-infinitive untuk menjelaskan maksud atau tujuan, yaitu 'to participate'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ the biodiversity, but illegal logging also disrupts the local climate in Kalimantan.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini diawali dengan 'Not only', sehingga memerlukan struktur inversi (kata bantu sebelum subjek). 'Does it threaten' adalah bentuk inversi yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The term 'free gift' is often criticized by linguists ___ a classic example of pleonasm.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'criticized... as being' digunakan untuk menunjukkan identitas atau kategori dari sesuatu yang dikritik tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The psychologist asked the patient ___ she had been experiencing the symptoms of anxiety.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Klausa 'how long' digunakan untuk menanyakan durasi waktu yang sesuai dengan tenses 'had been experiencing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In Kalimantan, the indigenous people have lived in the forest for generations, ___ in harmony with the wild animals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'existing' digunakan sebagai participle phrase untuk memberikan informasi tambahan tentang cara hidup orang-orang tersebut secara aktif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the new reforestation law is enacted, the illegal loggers ___ thousands of trees in the Amazon.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'By the time + Present Tense' menunjukkan penggunaan Future Perfect Tense (will have + V3) untuk menyatakan aksi yang akan sudah selesai di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Psychological trauma can be deeply rooted, ___ it difficult for individuals to lead a normal life without therapy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'making' berfungsi sebagai penjelas hasil atau konsekuensi dari klausa sebelumnya (trauma yang mengakar).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A person ___ daily needs are not met often experiences significant psychological stress.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'whose' digunakan untuk menunjukkan kepemilikan (seseorang yang kebutuhan sehari-harinya tidak terpenuhi).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The illegal logging in Kalimantan must be stopped; ___ , the forest will disappear within a few decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata transisi 'Otherwise' (jika tidak) digunakan untuk menunjukkan konsekuensi negatif jika aksi di klausa pertama tidak dilakukan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Amazon rainforest acts as a carbon sink, ___ it absorbs more carbon dioxide than it releases into the atmosphere.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Participle 'meaning' digunakan untuk menjelaskan maksud atau definisi dari fungsi 'carbon sink' yang disebutkan sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Individuals who undergo regular therapy sessions ___ to have better emotional control.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan bentuk pasif 'are reported' karena subjek 'individuals' (jamak) dilaporkan memiliki kontrol emosi yang lebih baik.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the government nor the environmentalists ___ able to completely stop illegal logging in the remote areas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam struktur 'Neither... nor...', kata kerja harus mengikuti subjek terdekat (environmentalists) yang berbentuk jamak, sehingga digunakan 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The wild animals in the forest are threatened by habitat loss ___ by illegal logging and land clearing.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'caused' (past participle) digunakan untuk menerangkan 'habitat loss' (kehilangan habitat yang disebabkan oleh...).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Daily needs, such as food and water, are essential for human survival, ___ they must be accessible to everyone.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'so' digunakan untuk menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat (karena penting, maka harus bisa diakses).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The therapist suggested that the patient ___ a journal to track their daily emotional fluctuations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah struktur subjunctive setelah kata kerja 'suggested'. Kata kerja selanjutnya harus dalam bentuk dasar 'keep'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The illegal logging in the Amazon is ___ a local problem ___ a global crisis that affects everyone.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'Not only... but also' tepat untuk menekankan bahwa masalah tersebut memiliki skala yang lebih besar dari sekadar lokal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Wild animals in Kalimantan are losing their natural instincts because they ___ to scavenge for food near villages.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif 'are forced' (dipaksa) sesuai dengan subjek jamak 'they' (hewan-hewan liar) dalam konteks present.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Psychology students must learn how to differentiate between normal behavior ___ pathological conditions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan kata untuk 'between' adalah 'and'. Jadi, struktur yang benar adalah 'between... and...'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The abundance of natural resources in Kalimantan ___ it a prime target for illegal logging operations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The abundance' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja Simple Present harus diakhiri dengan -s, yaitu 'makes'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Effective therapy involves not just talking about problems ___ active listening and empathy from the therapist.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'not just' adalah variasi dari 'not only', sehingga pasangannya tetap 'but also'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: To avoid pleonasm, one should ensure that every word in a sentence ___ a unique purpose.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'every word' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerja yang tepat adalah 'serves'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ of illegal logging in the Amazon have been captured by satellite imagery in recent years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'evidence' adalah kata benda tak terhitung (uncountable noun) yang tidak memiliki bentuk jamak, sehingga 'Evidence' adalah bentuk yang benar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The therapist's office was designed to be a quiet space ___ patients could feel safe and relaxed.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative adverb 'where' digunakan untuk merujuk pada tempat (quiet space).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many people do not realize that the phrase 'past history' is a pleonasm, as history ___ refers to past events.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'by nature' (secara alami/dasarnya) tepat digunakan untuk menjelaskan sifat inheren dari kata 'history'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The illegal logging task force ___ for several months before they made their first major arrest in Kalimantan.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Aksi yang berlangsung dalam durasi tertentu sebelum aksi lampau lainnya terjadi (made their arrest) membutuhkan Past Perfect Continuous 'had been working'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Wild animals are often forced to leave their habitat ___ their food sources are destroyed by human activities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'Because' (karena) digunakan untuk menghubungkan sebab (sumber makanan hancur) dengan akibat (hewan meninggalkan habitat).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Human trafficking is a global crisis that ___ millions of vulnerable individuals across international borders every year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menyatakan fakta umum (general truth), sehingga membutuhkan Simple Present Tense. Karena subjeknya adalah 'global crisis' (tunggal), maka kata kerja 'affect' harus mendapatkan akhiran -s menjadi 'affects'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Ministry of Religious Affairs ___ a new regulation regarding the minimum age for marriage to prevent social issues.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks kalimat menunjukkan tindakan yang telah diselesaikan di masa lalu namun hasilnya masih berlaku atau penting saat ini. Present Perfect Tense 'has issued' tepat untuk subjek lembaga tunggal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Cases of forced labor in the fishing industry ___ by international human rights organizations for several years now.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'for several years now' menunjukkan durasi yang dimulai di masa lampau dan masih berlanjut (Present Perfect). Karena subjek 'Cases' adalah jamak dan menerima tindakan, maka digunakan 'have been documented' (pasif).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: During the holiday season, the massive traffic congestion in Jakarta ___ by the sudden influx of travelers from neighboring cities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menceritakan kejadian di masa lampau atau kondisi spesifik yang terjadi (during the holiday season). Karena kemacetan tersebut 'diperparah' (pasif), maka digunakan Simple Past Passive 'was exacerbated'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The advocates argued that if the government ___ more strictly against premanism, the streets would be much safer for women.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Type 2 (pengandaian masa kini/masa depan yang tidak riil). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Simple Past 'acted' karena klausa utamanya menggunakan 'would + V1'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many sociologists believe that early marriage often ___ from a lack of access to quality education in rural areas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'early marriage' dianggap tunggal. Kalimat ini menyatakan pendapat atau fakta umum, sehingga menggunakan Simple Present 'results'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The New Year celebrations were so loud that the sound of fireworks ___ from several kilometers away.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Klausa pertama menggunakan 'were' (past tense), maka klausa kedua harus menyesuaikan dalam bentuk past. Bentuk pasif modal 'could be heard' (dapat didengar) adalah yang paling tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Ministry of Religious Affairs suggested that every citizen ___ the diversity of beliefs during the national holiday.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah struktur Subjunctive setelah kata kerja 'suggested'. Dalam 'suggest that...', kata kerja yang mengikuti harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive) tanpa akhiran -s, yaitu 'respect'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ such explicit discussions about LGBT rights in the mainstream media a decade ago.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat diawali dengan adverbia negatif 'Rarely', sehingga memerlukan inversi (kata kerja sebelum subjek). Karena merujuk pada 'a decade ago' (past) dan subjek 'discussions' (jamak), digunakan 'were there'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The victim of human trafficking ___ to a safe house before the police raided the suspect's headquarters.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menceritakan dua kejadian di masa lampau. Aksi pemindahan korban terjadi lebih dulu sebelum penggerebekan (raided), sehingga digunakan Past Perfect Passive 'had been moved'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Traffic congestion in major cities ___ by the rapid increase in private vehicle ownership over the last five years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan 'over the last five years' adalah penanda Present Perfect. Karena kemacetan tersebut 'didorong/disebabkan' (pasif), maka digunakan 'has been driven'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the authorities ___ the signs of human trafficking earlier, many victims could have been saved.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Type 3 (pengandaian masa lampau). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect 'had recognized' karena klausa utamanya menggunakan 'could have been saved'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Ministry of Religious Affairs coordinates with various organizations to ensure that the Hari Raya festivities ___ peacefully.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'festivities' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present untuk menyatakan harapan atau rencana rutin adalah 'run' (tanpa s).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Forced labor remains a significant human rights violation that ___ immediate international attention.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'that' merujuk pada 'violation' (tunggal), sehingga kata kerja yang mengikuti harus 'requires'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Psychologists specialized in trauma recovery help victims of rape ___ with the emotional aftereffects of the crime.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'help' dapat diikuti oleh bare infinitive (V1) atau to-infinitive. Di sini 'cope' adalah pilihan yang paling tepat secara gramatikal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The debate regarding LGBT rights in the country ___ more intense since the new legislation was proposed.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'since' menunjukkan peristiwa yang dimulai di masa lalu dan berlanjut hingga sekarang, sehingga membutuhkan Present Perfect 'has become'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Public transportation systems must be improved significantly to reduce the chronic ___ in metropolitan areas.
