Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah kata sifat 'chronic', dibutuhkan kata benda (noun). Bentuk noun dari 'congest' adalah 'congestion'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Premanism often thrives in urban areas where the local economy ___ by informal and illegal groups.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menjelaskan kondisi umum (present). Karena ekonomi 'dikendalikan' (pasif) oleh kelompok tertentu, digunakan Simple Present Passive 'is controlled'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the end of the year, the government ___ a comprehensive report on the progress of anti-trafficking efforts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan 'By the end of the year' menunjukkan aksi yang akan sudah selesai di masa depan, sehingga membutuhkan Future Perfect 'will have published'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Efforts to end early marriage require a change in social norms ___ providing better opportunities for young girls.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan konjungsi penambahan. 'As well as' (serta/dan juga) tepat digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua elemen pendukung usaha tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The sound of church bells and the call to prayer during Hari Raya ___ the religious harmony in the region.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek kalimat ini adalah gabungan 'The sound... and the call', yang bersifat jamak. Maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present adalah 'represent' (tanpa s).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Several suspects involved in the human trafficking ring ___ last night by the special task force.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan 'last night' menunjukkan Simple Past. Karena subjek 'Several suspects' adalah jamak dan menerima tindakan, digunakan 'were arrested'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many individuals avoid traveling during the New Year due to the extreme ___ of the roads.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'due to' dan kata sifat 'extreme', dibutuhkan kata benda (noun). 'Crowdedness' (kepadatan) adalah bentuk noun yang tepat di sini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Ministry of Religious Affairs officials ___ with community leaders to discuss the impact of early marriage on health.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menceritakan kejadian yang sudah dilakukan (past). Simple Past 'met' (bertemu) adalah kata kerja utama yang paling sesuai.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Victims of sexual violence often find it difficult ___ justice because of the social stigma surrounding the crime.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'find it + adjective + to-infinitive' adalah pola standar dalam bahasa Inggris. Maka 'to seek' adalah pelengkap yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The debate on LGBT rights ___ by several prominent religious figures in the national colloquium yesterday.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan 'yesterday' menunjukkan Simple Past. Karena debat tersebut 'dihadiri' (pasif), maka digunakan 'was attended'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Forced labor is a crime that ___ not only the victims but also the economic stability of the region.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'that' merujuk pada 'crime' (tunggal), sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'undermines' dalam Simple Present.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Premanism in public transportation centers ___ significantly since the police started regular patrols.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'since' mengindikasikan penggunaan Present Perfect Tense. Subjek 'Premanism' (tunggal) menggunakan 'has decreased'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The government is considering ___ new laws to protect migrant workers from human trafficking syndicates.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'consider' biasanya diikuti oleh gerund (V-ing). Maka 'implementing' adalah bentuk yang tepat setelah 'is considering'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: During Hari Raya, many people return to their hometowns, ___ to the severe traffic congestion on major highways.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'contributing' (yang berkontribusi) digunakan sebagai participle phrase untuk menjelaskan hasil dari aksi orang-orang yang pulang kampung tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Early marriage is often a consequence of poverty, as some families believe it ___ their financial burden.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Anak klausa setelah 'believe it' membutuhkan kata kerja. Karena subjek 'it' (merujuk pada marriage) tunggal, maka digunakan 'lessens' dalam Simple Present.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The sound of fireworks during the New Year ___ that the celebration has officially begun.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The sound' adalah tunggal. Kalimat ini menyatakan aksi yang terjadi berulang atau fakta umum saat itu, sehingga menggunakan 'signals'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sexual violence is a serious crime that ___ the dignity and physical safety of the victims.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'that' merujuk pada 'crime' (tunggal), maka kata kerja yang tepat adalah 'violates'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Ministry of Religious Affairs ___ to promote tolerance and understanding among different religious groups for decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan 'for decades' menunjukkan aksi yang sudah berlangsung lama dan masih berlanjut, sehingga membutuhkan Present Perfect Continuous 'has been working'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Forced labor in some agricultural sectors ___ by recent investigations conducted by the labor department.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menceritakan penemuan yang sudah terjadi (recent investigations). Karena kerja paksa tersebut 'diungkapkan' (pasif), digunakan 'was revealed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>Ministry</u> of Religious Affairs <u>was</u> <u>announce</u> the official <u>date</u> for <u>the</u> holiday.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'was' diikuti 'announce' adalah salah. Seharusnya menggunakan Simple Past 'announced' (mengumumkan) atau Past Continuous 'was announcing' (sedang mengumumkan).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Raja Ampat Islands in West Papua ___ for their extraordinary marine biodiversity by divers from all over the world.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The Raja Ampat Islands' adalah jamak, sehingga membutuhkan kata kerja bantu 'are' dalam bentuk pasif present untuk menyatakan reputasi umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many linguists believe that the languages spoken in Papua ___ from the Austronesian language family.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan kata kerja (linking verb + adjective). 'Are distinct' tepat karena subjek 'languages' bersifat jamak.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Located in Central Sulawesi, Lore Lindu National Park ___ home to many endemic species of birds and mammals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama 'Lore Lindu National Park' membutuhkan kata kerja utama (main verb). Karena subjeknya tunggal, maka digunakan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The traditional houses of the Toraja people in South Sulawesi ___ for their unique boat-shaped roofs.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'traditional houses' adalah jamak dan menerima tindakan (pasif). Maka digunakan 'are recognized' dalam bentuk present tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Tourism in Bali ___ rapidly since the international airport was expanded to accommodate larger aircraft.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'since' mengindikasikan peristiwa yang dimulai di masa lampau dan berlanjut hingga sekarang, sehingga membutuhkan Present Perfect Tense 'has developed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Before the rise of modern resorts, the village of Ubud in Bali ___ primarily as a center for arts and culture.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks kalimat adalah masa lampau (before the rise of modern resorts). Karena desa tersebut 'dikenal' (pasif), maka digunakan Simple Past Passive 'was known'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The dense rainforests of Kalimantan ___ the lungs of Indonesia due to their vast oxygen production.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'rainforests' adalah jamak. Karena subjek tersebut dianggap atau disebut sebagai sesuatu (pasif), maka digunakan 'are considered'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Environmentalists argue that illegal logging in Kalimantan ___ to a significant loss of wildlife habitat.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'illegal logging' adalah uncountable noun (tunggal). Dalam menyatakan argumen atau fakta umum, digunakan Simple Present dengan akhiran -s, yaitu 'leads'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Borobudur Temple in Central Java ___ by the Sailendra Dynasty in the 9th century.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'in the 9th century' menunjukkan Simple Past. Karena candi tersebut 'dibangun' (pasif), maka digunakan 'was built'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Java is the most populous island in Indonesia, ___ over half of the country's total population.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle 'containing' digunakan sebagai participle phrase untuk menjelaskan karakteristik pulau Jawa secara aktif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sumatera is known for its volcanic activity, with Mount Kerinci ___ the highest volcano in the region.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'with + noun + being' sering digunakan dalam penulisan formal untuk memberikan keterangan tambahan tentang subjek tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The traditional cuisine of West Sumatera ___ for its rich flavors and extensive use of spices.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan linking verb 'is' sebelum kata sifat 'famous' untuk menerangkan subjek tunggal 'cuisine'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Historically, the Maluku Islands ___ as the Spice Islands because they were the only source of nutmeg and cloves.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The Maluku Islands' adalah jamak. Karena konteksnya sejarah (historically), maka digunakan 'were known'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The trade in spices from Maluku ___ significant wealth to several European colonial powers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini merujuk pada peristiwa sejarah di masa lampau, sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense 'brought'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Komodo National Park in Nusa Tenggara ___ to protect the world's largest lizard species.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Taman nasional tersebut 'didirikan' (pasif) di masa lalu, sehingga bentuk yang benar adalah Simple Past Passive 'was established'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Flores, an island in Nusa Tenggara, ___ for its beautiful multi-colored volcanic lakes at Mount Kelimutu.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Flores' adalah tunggal. 'Is renowned for' adalah frasa pasif present untuk menyatakan reputasi atau kekhasan suatu tempat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The outlying islands of Indonesia ___ vital for defining the country's maritime boundaries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The outlying islands' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja bantu yang tepat adalah 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Border security in North Kalimantan ___ by the deployment of additional troops recently.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'recently' sering berpasangan dengan Present Perfect. Karena keamanan 'diperkuat' (pasif), maka digunakan 'has been strengthened'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the government ___ more infrastructure in Papua, the region's economy would grow faster.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Type 2 (pengandaian masa kini/depan). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Simple Past 'built' karena klausa utamanya menggunakan 'would grow'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The construction of a trans-Papua highway ___ to connect isolated communities across the province.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The construction' adalah tunggal. Kata kerja 'aims' dalam bentuk present digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan proyek tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sulawesi ___ unique geographical shape often described as resembling the letter K.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan kata kerja transitif 'has' dan artikel 'a' untuk menerangkan karakteristik bentuk pulau tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Traditional dances from Bali ___ tourists from all over the world for many decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'for many decades' menunjukkan Present Perfect. Subjek 'dances' jamak, sehingga menggunakan 'have attracted'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The preservation of peatlands in Kalimantan is crucial ___ mitigate the effects of global warming.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Infinitive of purpose 'to' digunakan sebelum kata kerja 'mitigate' untuk menunjukkan tujuan dari pelestarian tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mount Bromo in East Java is one of the most ___ active volcanoes in Indonesia.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata sifat yang tepat untuk menerangkan 'volcanoes' dalam konteks pariwisata adalah past participle 'photographed' (yang difoto).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The city of Palembang in Sumatera ___ as a center for trade during the Srivijaya Empire.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Merujuk pada masa kerajaan masa lalu, sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense 'served'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Spices from Maluku ___ to China and India long before the Europeans arrived.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Aksi perdagangan terjadi jauh sebelum kedatangan Eropa (past before past), sehingga menggunakan Past Perfect Passive 'had been traded'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The diverse cultures of Nusa Tenggara ___ by its geographical isolation between islands.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'cultures' jamak dan menerima pengaruh (pasif). Bentuk present passive 'are shaped' tepat untuk fakta sosiologis tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Monitoring the outlying islands is difficult ___ their remote locations and lack of transportation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Diikuti oleh frasa kata benda 'remote locations', sehingga preposisi yang tepat adalah 'because of'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Border disputes ___ diplomatically through international negotiations between the two countries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan bentuk pasif modal 'must be resolved' (harus diselesaikan) untuk subjek 'disputes'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The development of sea toll roads in Indonesia ___ to reduce logistics costs between islands.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The development' adalah tunggal dan menerima tujuan proyek (pasif), sehingga 'is intended' adalah pilihan tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many people from Java ___ to outer islands as part of the transmigration program in the past.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks 'in the past' menunjukkan masa lampau, sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense 'moved'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The unique flora and fauna of Papua ___ it a prime location for biological research.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek gabungan 'flora and fauna' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya adalah 'make'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Traditional woven fabrics from East Nusa Tenggara, known as Tenun Ikat, ___ by hand using natural dyes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'fabrics' adalah jamak dan 'dibuat' (pasif), maka digunakan 'are made'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The government is currently ___ the telecommunication network in remote border areas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan 'currently' berpasangan dengan Present Continuous (is + V-ing), yaitu 'expanding'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ such pristine beaches as those found on the small islands of Maluku.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Inversi negatif karena diawali 'Rarely'. Struktur yang benar adalah auxiliary 'does' sebelum subjek 'one'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Papua's biodiversity <u>are</u> remarkably unique and should be preserved by everyone to maintain the ecological balance.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'biodiversity' adalah kata benda tunggal/tak terhitung, sehingga membutuhkan linking verb tunggal 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>islands</u> of Bali is famous for its beautiful terraces and vibrant religious festivals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Karena kata kerja bantunya adalah 'is' dan 'its', maka subjeknya harus tunggal, yaitu 'Island'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many different cultures <u>coexists</u> peacefully in the multicultural society of Java.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'cultures' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'coexist' (tanpa s).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The government has <u>building</u> new schools in the border regions to improve education quality.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah auxiliary 'has' dalam Present Perfect, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk V3, yaitu 'built'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Papua's biodiversity <u>are</u> remarkably unique and shoul be preserved by everyone.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'biodiversity' adalah tunggal/uncountable, sehingga harus menggunakan 'is', bukan 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern aquaculture techniques ___ significantly over the last decade to meet the rising global demand for seafood.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'over the last decade' menunjukkan peristiwa yang dimulai di masa lampau dan masih berlangsung atau memiliki dampak hingga sekarang, sehingga membutuhkan Present Perfect Tense. Karena subjeknya jamak (techniques), maka digunakan 'have evolved'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Gajah Mada, the prime minister of the Majapahit Empire, ___ the Palapa Oath to unify the entire archipelago.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini merujuk pada peristiwa sejarah yang terjadi secara spesifik di masa lampau (kerajaan Majapahit), sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense 'took'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Javanese culture, with its intricate wayang kulit performances, ___ deep philosophical values rooted in ancient traditions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Javanese culture' adalah tunggal/abstrak. Kalimat ini menyatakan fakta umum tentang budaya tersebut, sehingga menggunakan Simple Present Tense dengan akhiran -s (reflects).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: During the Japanese occupation of Indonesia, many villagers ___ as Romusha to work on massive infrastructure projects.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks kalimat adalah masa lampau (pendudukan Jepang). Karena subjek 'many villagers' (jamak) menerima tindakan (pasif), maka digunakan Simple Past Passive 'were forced'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the Majapahit Empire ___ more internal stability, it might have lasted for several more centuries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Type 3 (pengandaian masa lampau). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect (had + V3). Karena kata kerjanya adalah 'have' (memiliki), maka bentuknya menjadi 'had had'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The tensions between North Korea and South Korea ___ a major geopolitical concern since the end of the Korean War.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penggunaan 'since' mengindikasikan Present Perfect Tense. Subjeknya adalah 'tensions' (jamak), sehingga auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'have', menjadi 'have remained'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In the Mataram Sultanate, the King ___ as the spiritual and political leader of the Javanese people.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menceritakan status raja di masa lampau (Kesultanan Mataram). Karena raja tersebut 'dilihat/dianggap' (pasif), digunakan Simple Past Passive 'was seen'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Freshwater aquaculture in Java ___ by the abundance of volcanic soil and natural water resources.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'aquaculture' adalah tunggal dan menerima dukungan dari faktor alam (pasif). Dalam konteks fakta umum, digunakan Simple Present Passive 'is supported'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Second Sino-Japanese War ___ when Japan invaded China in July 1937.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini merujuk pada awal peristiwa sejarah di tahun 1937, sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense 'escalated'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Rarely ___ such monumental Buddhist structures as Borobudur outside of Central Java.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat diawali dengan adverbia negatif 'Rarely', sehingga memerlukan inversi (kata bantu sebelum subjek). Struktur yang benar adalah 'Does one find'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Demak Sultanate, established in the late 15th century, ___ the first major Islamic kingdom on the island of Java.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Merujuk pada fakta sejarah kerajaan di masa lampau, sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense 'was' untuk subjek tunggal (Demak Sultanate).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many scholars argue that the influence of Hindu and Buddhist cultures ___ seen in modern Javanese rituals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan bentuk pasif modal untuk menyatakan kemungkinan yang masih ada hingga sekarang. 'Can still be seen' berarti 'masih dapat dilihat'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the Japanese forces surrendered in 1945, the Romusha program ___ immense suffering among the population.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'By the time' yang diikuti Simple Past (surrendered) menunjukkan penggunaan Past Perfect Tense (had caused) untuk aksi yang terjadi sebelum titik waktu lampau tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The DMZ between North and South Korea ___ one of the most heavily fortified borders in the world for over seventy years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'for over seventy years' menunjukkan durasi dari masa lalu hingga sekarang, sehingga membutuhkan Present Perfect Tense 'has been'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Traditional gamelan music ___ in Javanese royal courts for centuries to accompany sacred ceremonies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan 'for centuries' menunjukkan durasi yang panjang hingga saat ini. Musik tersebut 'dimainkan' (pasif), sehingga digunakan Present Perfect Passive 'has been performed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The expansion of aquaculture ponds in coastal areas ___ mangroves if not managed properly.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menyatakan kemungkinan masa depan atau konsekuensi dari suatu syarat (if not managed). Maka digunakan Future Tense 'will destroy'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Hayam Wuruk, during whose reign Majapahit reached its peak, ___ by Gajah Mada as his most trusted advisor.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat sejarah ini membutuhkan bentuk pasif (didukung oleh). Karena subjeknya tunggal dan terjadi di masa lalu, digunakan 'was supported'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The North Korean government strictly ___ the information that its citizens can access from the outside world.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'government' adalah tunggal. Kalimat ini menyatakan fakta saat ini, sehingga menggunakan Simple Present Tense dengan akhiran -s (controls).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The atrocities committed during the Japanese occupation ___ a lasting impact on the collective memory of Indonesians.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kejadian pendudukan sudah selesai di masa lalu, sehingga aksi 'meninggalkan dampak' menggunakan Simple Past Tense 'left'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Most Javanese wedding ceremonies ___ several rituals that symbolize the union of two families.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'ceremonies' adalah jamak. Karena menyatakan kebiasaan atau tradisi umum, digunakan Simple Present Tense 'involve' (tanpa s).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Technological advancements in South Korea ___ it into one of the world's leading economies within a few decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'advancements' jamak. 'Have transformed' (Present Perfect) tepat untuk menyatakan perubahan yang terjadi selama beberapa dekade terakhir dan hasilnya terlihat sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Aquaculture farmers must ensure that water quality ___ constantly to prevent disease outbreaks among the fish.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah kata penghubung 'that', dibutuhkan klausa baru. Kualitas air 'dipantau' (pasif). Karena menyatakan keharusan rutin, digunakan Simple Present Passive 'is monitored'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Majapahit's maritime power ___ it to control the key trade routes in Southeast Asia for many years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat sejarah tentang kekuasaan Majapahit di masa lalu menggunakan Simple Past Tense 'enabled'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The conflict between China and Japan in the 1930s ___ by complex territorial and political disagreements.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kejadian di masa lampau (1930s). Konflik tersebut 'dipicu' (pasif), sehingga digunakan Simple Past Passive 'was fueled'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Javanese concept of 'musyawarah' emphasizes that decisions ___ through community consensus.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Klausa setelah 'that' membutuhkan kata kerja. Keputusan 'dicapai' (pasif). Modal 'should be reached' tepat untuk menyatakan anjuran dalam konsep tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: South Korean pop culture, often referred to as Hallyu, ___ global popularity in recent years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan 'in recent years' menunjukkan Present Perfect Tense. Subjek 'pop culture' tunggal, sehingga menggunakan 'has gained'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Romusha workers ___ for long hours with very little food or rest by the Japanese military.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'toil' (bekerja keras) adalah kata kerja intransitif. Karena menceritakan penderitaan di masa lalu, digunakan Simple Past 'toiled'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sustainable aquaculture practices ___ to protect marine ecosystems from pollution and overfishing.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Praktik-praktik tersebut 'dirancang' (pasif) untuk tujuan tertentu. Sebagai pernyataan umum/program saat ini, digunakan 'are designed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The fall of the Majapahit Empire ___ by a combination of internal succession disputes and the rise of Islamic sultanates.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keruntuhan tersebut terjadi di masa lalu. Kalimat pasif 'was caused' (disebabkan oleh) tepat untuk menjelaskan alasan keruntuhan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: China's economic growth since the late 20th century ___ its relationship with Japan and other neighbors.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan 'since' mengarahkan pada Present Perfect Tense. Pertumbuhan ekonomi (tunggal) 'telah mempengaruhi' (has impacted) hubungan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Traditional Javanese batik ___ by applying wax to cloth before dyeing it in vibrant colors.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Batik 'dibuat' (pasif). Karena ini merupakan penjelasan proses yang masih berlaku hingga sekarang (fakta umum), digunakan Simple Present Passive 'is created'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: North Korea ___ into self-isolation for decades, maintaining a policy of national self-reliance known as Juche.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan 'for decades' menunjukkan aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung, menggunakan Present Perfect 'has withdrawn'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The archaeological site of Trowulan ___ evidence of the administrative and religious center of Majapahit.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Situs tersebut saat ini memberikan bukti (fakta ilmiah). Subjek 'site' tunggal, maka menggunakan 'provides' dalam present tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Japanese <u>occupation</u> forces <u>had</u> <u>implementing</u> <u>harsh</u> <u>labor</u> policies in Southeast Asia.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah auxiliary 'had' dalam Past Perfect, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk past participle (V3), yaitu 'implemented'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>production of shrimp</u> in <u>traditional</u> coastal <u>aquaculture</u> <u>ponds</u> <u>were rising</u> steadily over the last decade.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The production' (tunggal), sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'was rising', bukan 'were rising'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many scholars argue that plagiarism ___ the fundamental principles of academic integrity and personal honesty.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'plagiarism' adalah kata benda abstrak tunggal (uncountable), sehingga membutuhkan kata kerja tunggal (singular verb) yaitu 'violates'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Animism is a belief system ___ that spirits inhabit not only living creatures but also inanimate objects.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bagian ini memerlukan present participle 'suggesting' sebagai bentuk pemendekan dari relative clause 'which suggests'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Interfaith marriages ___ increasingly common in urban centers where diverse cultures frequently interact.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'interfaith marriages' adalah jamak (plural), maka auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Recent surveys show that millennials are more likely to remain single ___ their Gen-Z counterparts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan tingkat perbandingan (comparative degree) 'more likely', sehingga membutuhkan konjungsi 'than'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The baby boomer generation has been criticized for ___ multiple residential properties as investment assets.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'for', kata kerja harus diubah menjadi gerund (verb-ing), yaitu 'accumulating'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If a student ___ someone else's work without proper citation, it is considered a serious academic offense.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Conditional sentence type 1 yang menyatakan fakta umum; subjek 'student' (tunggal) memerlukan kata kerja 'uses'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In certain animistic traditions, the spirits of ancestors ___ to protect the village from misfortune.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'spirits' adalah jamak, maka bentuk pasif yang tepat adalah 'are believed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ by religious differences, many couples still decide to proceed with interfaith weddings.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced adjective clause dalam bentuk pasif; 'undeterred' (tidak terhalangi) menjelaskan kondisi pasangan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Millennials often prioritize career stability ___ marriage, unlike Gen-Z who may have different perspectives.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'over' digunakan bersama kata kerja 'prioritize' untuk menunjukkan perbandingan pilihan (prioritize A over B).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By ___ vast amounts of property, boomers have unintentionally made housing less affordable for younger people.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'by' harus diikuti oleh gerund, yaitu 'hoarding' (menimbun).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Strict anti-plagiarism policies ___ by most universities to maintain their academic reputation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'policies' adalah jamak, sehingga memerlukan 'have been implemented' (telah diterapkan).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The core of animism lies in the ___ that all natural things possess a spiritual essence.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata benda (noun) setelah artikel 'the', yaitu 'belief'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Although it is legal in many jurisdictions, interfaith marriage ___ social challenges for the family.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek tunggal 'interfaith marriage' memerlukan kata kerja tunggal 'presents'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Millennials tend to delay marriage ___ economic factors and shifting social norms.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'Due to' adalah preposisi yang tepat diikuti oleh frasa kata benda 'economic factors'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Property ___ among the older generation has led to a shortage of starter homes for millennials.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Gerund 'hoarding' di sini berfungsi sebagai subjek atau penjelas dari tipe aktivitas properti.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not until the professor checked the software ___ that the student had copied the essay.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur inversi setelah 'Not until...'. Karena kalimat dalam bentuk past, maka menggunakan 'did he realize'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Ancient tribes practiced animism, ___ that rituals could appease the spirits of the forest.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle phrase 'thinking' menjelaskan subjek 'tribes' (berpikir bahwa...).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: One of the primary difficulties in interfaith marriage ___ the religious education of the children.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek kalimat adalah 'One' (bukan 'difficulties'), sehingga kata kerja harus tunggal 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Compared to Gen-Z, millennials ___ more cautious about making long-term marital commitments.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'millennials' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja 'appear' tidak menggunakan akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The boomers' tendency ___ property has been a major driver of real estate price inflation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata benda 'tendency' biasanya diikuti oleh to-infinitive (tendency to do something).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Software developers have created tools that can ___ identify similarities between different texts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata keterangan (adverb) 'automatically' untuk menerangkan kata kerja 'identify'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ of nature is a central theme in the study of animistic religions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan noun phrase sebagai subjek; 'The veneration' (pemujaan) adalah pilihan yang paling tepat secara gramatikal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Couples in interfaith marriages often find that they must ___ to reach a middle ground.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal verb 'must', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Millennials have high rates of singlehood, ___ is attributed to various socio-economic factors.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'which' digunakan untuk merujuk pada seluruh situasi yang disebutkan di klausa sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Investors warn that the older generation's habit of ___ homes prevents young families from buying.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks 'habit of...' diikuti gerund yang bermakna menimbun, yaitu 'hoarding'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Plagiarism, whether intentional ___ accidental, is treated as a breach of ethics.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan korelasi untuk 'whether' adalah 'or'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Shintoism, a Japanese religion, ___ many elements of animism in its rituals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Shintoism' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja yang tepat adalah 'incorporates'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The legal ___ for interfaith marriage vary significantly from one country to another.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'vary' adalah bentuk jamak, sehingga subjeknya harus jamak pula (requirements).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ many millennials are still single, they are often active in the workforce and digital economy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'Although' digunakan untuk menghubungkan klausa yang menunjukkan kontras.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many boomers ___ property long before the prices reached their current peak.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat membutuhkan kata kerja past tense 'acquired' untuk menceritakan kejadian di masa lalu.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Ethical writing requires that every source ___ properly acknowledged in the bibliography.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah kata kerja 'requires that', digunakan bentuk subjunctive, sehingga 'be' adalah bentuk yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Traditional animists believe that ___ spirits can cause illness if they are offended.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Noun adjunct 'nature' digunakan untuk menerangkan kata benda lain 'spirits' (roh alam).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: For couples of different faiths, ___ can be a lengthy and complicated process.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata benda (noun) sebagai subjek kalimat, yaitu 'marriage'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The shift in social values ___ that being single is no longer seen as a failure by millennials.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'shift' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja yang tepat adalah 'means'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Boomers, ___ hold a large portion of the nation's wealth, are often seen as a barrier to younger homeownership.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'who' digunakan untuk merujuk pada subjek manusia (boomers).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>student</u> <u>admit</u> <u>that</u> he <u>had</u> <u>copied</u> the work.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'student' adalah tunggal, seharusnya kata kerja adalah 'admitted' (karena konteks past) atau 'admits'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Animism <u>is</u> <u>one</u> of the <u>most</u> <u>ancient</u> <u>belief</u> in the world.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'one of the...' harus diikuti oleh kata benda jamak. Seharusnya 'beliefs'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Interfaith <u>marriage</u> <u>are</u> <u>becoming</u> <u>more</u> common <u>today</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'marriage' adalah tunggal, sehingga to be seharusnya 'is', bukan 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Millennials <u>is</u> <u>more</u> <u>likely</u> <u>to</u> be single <u>than</u> Gen-Z.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'millennials' adalah jamak, seharusnya menggunakan 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many <u>boomers</u> <u>prefers</u> <u>to</u> <u>keep</u> <u>their</u> second homes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'boomers' jamak, maka kata kerja tidak boleh menggunakan akhiran -s. Seharusnya 'prefer'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Plagiarism <u>is</u> a <u>violate</u> of <u>the</u> <u>university</u> <u>code</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah artikel 'a' dibutuhkan kata benda. Seharusnya 'violation', bukan kata kerja 'violate'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>practice</u> of <u>animistic</u> <u>rituals</u> <u>vary</u> <u>among</u> tribes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'practice' (tunggal), maka kata kerja seharusnya 'varies'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Couples <u>who</u> <u>marry</u> <u>interfaithly</u> <u>often</u> <u>faces</u> opposition.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'couples' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja seharusnya 'face'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Millennials <u>has</u> <u>different</u> <u>views</u> <u>on</u> <u>life</u> than Gen-Z.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'millennials' jamak, seharusnya menggunakan 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Boomers <u>owns</u> <u>most</u> <u>of</u> the <u>residential</u> <u>property</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'boomers' jamak, maka kata kerja seharusnya 'own'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>software</u> <u>detected</u> that the <u>paper</u> <u>were</u> <u>plagiarized</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'paper' tunggal, seharusnya menggunakan 'was'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Animists <u>believes</u> that <u>trees</u> <u>have</u> <u>souls</u> <u>just like</u> humans.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'animists' jamak, seharusnya 'believe'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In <u>some</u> <u>cultures</u>, interfaith <u>marriage</u> <u>are</u> <u>highly</u> discouraged.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'marriage' tunggal, seharusnya 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Millennials <u>frequently</u> <u>prioritize</u> <u>career</u> <u>than</u> <u>getting</u> married.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'prioritize' biasanya berpasangan dengan preposisi 'over', bukan 'than'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>investor</u> <u>criticized</u> the <u>boomers</u> <u>for</u> <u>hoard</u> property.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'for' harus menggunakan gerund. Seharusnya 'hoarding'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Academic <u>integrity</u> <u>are</u> <u>violated</u> <u>when</u> <u>plagiarism</u> occurs.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'integrity' tunggal, seharusnya 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Animism <u>is</u> <u>more</u> <u>popular</u> <u>than</u> <u>others</u> ancient beliefs.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'others' tidak bisa berfungsi sebagai adjective sebelum noun. Seharusnya 'other'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Interfaith <u>weddings</u> <u>is</u> <u>becoming</u> <u>a</u> growing <u>trend</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'weddings' jamak, seharusnya 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Millennials <u>prefers</u> <u>freedom</u> <u>over</u> <u>early</u> <u>marriage</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'millennials' jamak, seharusnya 'prefer'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The competitive nature of MOBA games often ___ players to develop complex strategies and quick reflexes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'nature' adalah tunggal, sehingga membutuhkan kata kerja tunggal (singular verb) 'requires'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many tech startups, despite ___ massive funding, failed to achieve a sustainable profit margin last year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'despite', kata kerja harus diubah menjadi gerund (-ing).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ mass layoffs in the tech sector, but they also reduced employee benefits significantly.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur negatif di awal kalimat (Not only) membutuhkan inversi (auxiliary + subject + verb).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: People with diabetes should monitor their blood sugar levels regularly and ___ a balanced diet.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Paralelisme dengan modal 'should monitor'. Bentuk dasar 'maintain' diperlukan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The candidate's involvement in practical politics ___ by the opposition during the recent debate.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'involvement' adalah tunggal, dan konteksnya pasif (ditanyakan oleh...), sehingga menggunakan 'was questioned'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Excessive weight gain, or obesity, ___ to increase the risk of developing cardiovascular diseases.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif 'is known' tepat untuk subjek tunggal 'weight gain/obesity'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Legal experts are currently debating whether the act constitutes blasphemy ___ merely a form of free speech.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi korelasi 'whether' berpasangan dengan 'or'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The accountant was arrested after the police discovered evidence of widespread fund ___ within the corporation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata benda (noun) 'embezzlement' untuk melengkapi frasa 'fund embezzlement'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In recent investigations, the suspect confessed to the ___ of the victim following a heated argument.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah artikel 'the', diperlukan kata benda (noun) 'mutilation'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The debate regarding LGBT rights ___ many social and legal challenges in conservative societies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'debate' adalah tunggal, maka kata kerjanya adalah 'presents'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Some individuals with antisocial tendencies find it difficult ___ meaningful relationships with others.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'find it + adj + to-infinitive' adalah pola yang benar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: MOBA games, ___ are played by millions worldwide, have significantly influenced the esports industry.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'which' digunakan untuk merujuk pada benda (MOBA games) dalam non-restrictive clause.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the startup ___ its business model earlier, it might have avoided bankruptcy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Conditional type 3 (past unreal) menggunakan 'had + V3' di klausa 'if'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mass layoffs often result in a decrease in consumer spending ___ the loss of income for many families.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'Due to' adalah preposisi yang diikuti oleh frasa kata benda 'the loss of income'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Managing diabetes requires constant monitoring of glucose levels ___ strict adherence to medication.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'As well as' digunakan untuk menambahkan poin yang setara (monitoring and adherence).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Practical politics often ___ the use of strategic alliances to gain influence within the government.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'politics' (ilmu politik) dianggap tunggal, sehingga menggunakan 'involves'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Obesity is often linked to a sedentary lifestyle ___ a diet high in processed foods.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Menghubungkan dua faktor penyebab yang sejalan menggunakan 'and'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The suspect denied any involvement in the penggelapan funds, ___ the evidence presented by the prosecution.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'Despite' adalah preposisi yang tepat untuk menunjukkan kontras dengan frasa kata benda.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Blasphemy laws in some countries ___ to protect religious sentiments from public insult.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'laws' adalah jamak, maka 'are designed' adalah bentuk pasif yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The graphic nature of the mutilation case ___ widespread shock and anger throughout the community.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat membutuhkan kata kerja utama dalam bentuk past tense 'caused'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Some antisocial behaviors ___ as early as childhood and may persist into adulthood.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif 'can be observed' (dapat diamati) sesuai dengan konteks perilaku tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Successful MOBA players must be able to communicate ___ with their teammates during intense matches.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata keterangan (adverb) 'effectively' untuk menerangkan kata kerja 'communicate'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The startup's decision to pivot its strategy was ___ by the lack of market interest.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur pasif 'was + V3' (dipengaruhi oleh...).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mass layoffs are sometimes necessary for a company ___ in a highly competitive market.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Infinitive 'to survive' digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan atau alasan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Diabetes education programs help patients ___ how to manage their condition effectively.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'help' bisa diikuti oleh bare infinitive 'understand' atau to-infinitive.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Practical politics requires a deep understanding of human behavior ___ effective communication skills.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Menghubungkan dua persyaratan yang diperlukan menggunakan 'and'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Obesity among children ___ a major public health concern in many developed nations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'obesity' adalah tunggal, sehingga menggunakan 'has become'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The penggelapan of funds was so sophisticated ___ it took years for the auditors to detect it.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menyatakan hasil atau konsekuensi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Activists are calling for the repeal of blasphemy laws, ___ they infringe upon freedom of expression.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present participle phrase 'arguing that' menjelaskan tindakan para aktivis.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The forensic report provided a detailed analysis of the ___ found at the crime scene.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata benda 'evidence' (uncountable) setelah preposisi 'of'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Social media platforms have been criticized for allowing the spread of antisocial ___ among teenagers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata benda jamak 'ideologies' untuk melengkapi frasa.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: MOBA games require players to make split-second decisions, ___ can determine the outcome of the match.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'Which' merujuk pada 'decisions' dalam non-restrictive relative clause.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many startups fail because they do not have a clear strategy ___ their target audience.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Infinitive 'to reach' menjelaskan tujuan dari strategi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mass layoffs can lead to a loss of morale among the employees who ___ at the company.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'employees' jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya adalah 'remain'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Preventing diabetes through lifestyle changes is ___ more cost-effective than treating its complications.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'Much' digunakan sebagai penguat (intensifier) untuk comparative 'more cost-effective'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Practical politics <u>are</u> often associated with compromised ethics and power struggles.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Politics sebagai subjek bidang ilmu adalah tunggal, seharusnya menggunakan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Obesity <u>have</u> become a significant health crisis in many urban populations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Obesity adalah subjek tunggal, seharusnya menggunakan 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The accountant was found guilty of fund <u>embezzle</u> after a six-month trial.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah kata 'fund' dibutuhkan kata benda 'embezzlement'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The suspect is accused of <u>mutilate</u> the body to conceal the identity of the victim.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'of', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk gerund 'mutilating'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Laws against blasphemy <u>is</u> often criticized for violating international human rights standards.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjeknya adalah 'Laws' (jamak), sehingga to be yang tepat adalah 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>rise</u> of <u>toxic</u> <u>behavior</u> in MOBA <u>communities</u> <u>are</u> a concern for developers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The rise' (tunggal), maka kata kerja seharusnya 'is', bukan 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many <u>startups</u> <u>fails</u> <u>due to</u> <u>poor</u> <u>management</u> and lack of market research.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'startups' jamak, kata kerjanya seharusnya 'fail' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Mass</u> <u>layoffs</u> <u>has</u> <u>caused</u> <u>significant</u> stress among the remaining employees.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'layoffs' jamak, seharusnya menggunakan auxiliary 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Diabetes <u>can</u> <u>be</u> <u>managed</u> <u>effective</u> through <u>proper</u> diet and exercise.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Seharusnya menggunakan kata keterangan 'effectively' untuk menerangkan kata kerja 'managed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Practical</u> <u>politics</u> <u>often</u> <u>involve</u> <u>complex</u> negotiations between different parties.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Politics sebagai subjek tunggal membutuhkan kata kerja 'involves'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Obesity <u>increase</u> the <u>likelihood</u> <u>of</u> <u>developing</u> <u>several</u> chronic health conditions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Obesity' tunggal, kata kerjanya seharusnya 'increases'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Antisocial <u>personality</u> <u>disorder</u> <u>are</u> <u>difficult</u> to <u>diagnose</u> in young children.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'disorder' tunggal, maka kata kerja seharusnya 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Blasphemy</u> <u>is</u> <u>considered</u> a <u>seriously</u> <u>crime</u> in many religious countries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Seharusnya menggunakan kata sifat 'serious' untuk menerangkan kata benda 'crime', bukan adverb 'seriously'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>mutilation</u> <u>case</u> <u>were</u> <u>handled</u> by <u>the most</u> experienced detectives.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'case' adalah tunggal, seharusnya menggunakan 'was handled'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the auditors finished their investigation, the CFO ___ more than two million dollars from the startup's operational fund.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Past Perfect Tense ('had embezzled') karena menunjukkan sebuah aksi yang telah selesai dilakukan sebelum aksi lain terjadi di masa lampau ('finished').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many millennials are currently choosing to remain single, ___ they prioritize personal growth and financial stability over traditional family milestones.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'for' di sini berfungsi sama dengan 'because' (karena), yang menghubungkan alasan mengapa generasi milenial memilih untuk tetap melajang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The competitive landscape of MOBA games requires that a player ___ constant communication with teammates to secure victory.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'requires that'. Dalam struktur ini, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form) tanpa akhiran -s, terlepas dari subjeknya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the government had not intervened in practical politics, the democratic process ___ more transparent during the last election.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat pengandaian tipe 3 (Conditional Sentence Type 3) digunakan untuk situasi masa lalu yang tidak terjadi. Strukturnya adalah 'if + past perfect, would have + V3'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Obesity is not merely a cosmetic concern ___ a medical problem that increases the risk of other diseases.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'not... but rather' digunakan untuk mengoreksi anggapan dan memberikan penjelasan yang lebih akurat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Startups that face mass layoffs often struggle ___ the morale of their remaining employees.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'struggle' diikuti oleh to-infinitive untuk menunjukkan usaha dalam mencapai sesuatu.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The patient ___ from type 2 diabetes for ten years before he finally decided to change his lifestyle radically.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Continuous Tense ('had been suffering') digunakan untuk menekankan durasi suatu aksi yang berlangsung terus-menerus sebelum aksi lain terjadi di masa lampau ('decided').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not until the late 20th century ___ a significant shift in public perception regarding LGBT rights.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat yang diawali dengan frasa negatif 'Not until' memerlukan inversi (kata kerja bantu diletakkan sebelum subjek).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Animism, ___ involves the belief that non-human entities possess a spiritual essence, is found in many indigenous cultures.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'which' digunakan untuk memberikan informasi tambahan tentang benda atau konsep (Animism) dalam non-defining relative clause.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The rise of antisocial behavior in digital spaces ___ by researchers studying the impact of anonymity on internet users.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Present Perfect Passive Tense. 'The rise' adalah subjek tunggal, sehingga menggunakan 'has been' diikuti Past Participle.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Baby boomers often accumulated vast property portfolios ___ the housing market was more accessible to middle-class workers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata hubung 'when' digunakan untuk merujuk pada periode waktu tertentu di masa lalu ketika suatu kondisi terjadi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In cases of embezzlement, the court must determine ___ the suspect acted alone or as part of a larger conspiracy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan kata 'whether... or' digunakan untuk menunjukkan pilihan di antara dua kemungkinan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The mutilation of historical artifacts during the war was condemned as a form of cultural ___ by the international community.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata benda (noun) setelah kata sifat 'cultural'. 'Desecration' adalah bentuk benda dari 'desecrate'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Startups rarely survive the first year without a solid business plan, ___ they receive massive initial investments.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'even if' digunakan untuk menunjukkan bahwa hasil akan tetap sama meskipun ada kondisi tertentu.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mass layoffs usually occur ___ a company experiences a sharp decline in revenue or undergoes major restructuring.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Conjunction 'whenever' (kapanpun) digunakan untuk menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat yang konsisten antara dua kejadian.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Practical politics ___ the art of compromise, often requiring leaders to balance conflicting interests.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Passive Tense digunakan untuk menyatakan definisi atau sebutan umum. 'Politics' adalah subjek tunggal (singular uncountable).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Obese individuals are encouraged to engage in regular physical activity ___ help manage their body weight.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: To-infinitive ('to help') digunakan untuk menunjukkan tujuan (purpose).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The suspect, ___ by the evidence found at the crime scene, finally confessed to the crime.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah bentuk Reduced Adjective Clause (yang dipendekkan). 'The suspect who was confronted' menjadi 'The suspect, confronted...'

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many Gen-Z workers value work-life balance more than higher salaries, ___ differs from the traditional mindset of older generations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'which' digunakan untuk merujuk pada seluruh pernyataan/ide di klausa sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the management ___ the employees were prepared for the sudden announcement of the company's closure.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan korelasi yang tepat untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The development of effective insulin treatments ___ the life expectancy of individuals with diabetes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek kalimat adalah 'The development' (tunggal), maka auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In many MOBA communities, toxic behavior ___ leads to a decrease in player retention and game popularity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata keterangan (adverb) 'inevitably' untuk menerangkan kata kerja 'leads'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The belief in animism ___ back to prehistoric times when humans first developed spiritual concepts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'dates back to' adalah idiom yang digunakan untuk menunjukkan asal-usul waktu sesuatu. Karena subjeknya 'The belief' (tunggal), maka menggunakan 'dates'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Before the advent of modern software, auditors ___ to check financial records manually for signs of embezzlement.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kejadian masa lalu ('Before the advent...') memerlukan Past Tense. 'Had' adalah bentuk lampau dari 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Practical politics is often criticized for being too focused on short-term gains ___ long-term national interests.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'instead of' (daripada/alih-alih) digunakan untuk menunjukkan kontras antara dua pilihan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A person is considered clinically obese ___ their body mass index (BMI) exceeds thirty.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'if' mengawali klausa syarat yang mendefinisikan kondisi medis tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Some experts argue that antisocial personality disorder ___ more effectively if diagnosed during early adolescence.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Klausa pasif ('can be treated') diperlukan karena subjek 'disorder' menerima tindakan pengobatan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Startups should prioritize building a loyal customer base ___ expanding too rapidly into new markets.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'rather than' digunakan untuk menunjukkan preferensi atau pilihan yang lebih baik.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The mass layoffs announced by the tech giant ___ shockwaves throughout the global economy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menceritakan kejadian lampau, sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense ('sent').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Diabetes can lead to serious complications ___ it is not managed through medication and diet.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi syarat 'if' digunakan untuk menunjukkan konsekuensi dari kegagalan dalam manajemen penyakit.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Millennials often face greater economic challenges than baby boomers ___ when they first entered the workforce.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam perbandingan, auxiliary 'did' digunakan untuk menggantikan kata kerja 'face' di masa lampau (merujuk pada generasi boomer).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The suspect was accused of ___ the victim's remains in an attempt to hide the evidence.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'of', kata kerja harus diubah menjadi Gerund (V-ing).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: LGBT activists argue that legal recognition is essential ___ the protection of their basic human rights.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Adjektiva 'essential' diikuti oleh preposisi 'for' untuk menunjukkan kegunaan atau tujuan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Animistic rituals often involve ___ offerings to spirits to ensure a bountiful harvest.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'involve' diikuti oleh Gerund (V-ing).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Practical politics ___ widely depending on the cultural and historical context of a nation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Politics adalah subjek tunggal yang tidak dapat dihitung, sehingga kata kerjanya harus tunggal ('varies').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The accountant <u>embezzle</u> nearly half a million dollars before being caught by the internal security team.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks kalimat menunjukkan kejadian lampau yang sudah selesai, sehingga memerlukan Simple Past ('embezzled').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Millennials often <u>prefers</u> living in urban areas due to better job opportunities and accessibility.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Millennials' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'prefer' (tanpa akhiran -s).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Obesity <u>become</u> a global epidemic as more people adopt sedentary lifestyles and poor eating habits.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Perfect Tense ('has become') digunakan untuk menyatakan situasi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut hingga sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The startup <u>receive</u> a massive investment from a venture capital firm last month.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'last month' menunjukkan kejadian di masa lalu, sehingga menggunakan Simple Past ('received').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Diabetes patients <u>must to check</u> their blood sugar levels regularly to prevent complications.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal verb 'must' harus langsung diikuti oleh bare infinitive (V1) tanpa 'to'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>embezzlement</u> of corporate <u>funds</u> <u>were</u> <u>discovered</u> <u>during</u> the routine audit.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The embezzlement' (tunggal), maka kata kerja bantu yang tepat adalah 'was', bukan 'were'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Animism</u> is a <u>belief</u> system that <u>claims</u> all <u>natural things</u> <u>possesses</u> a soul.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'natural things' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya seharusnya 'possess' (tanpa akhiran -es).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many <u>millennials</u> are <u>more likely</u> to <u>remains</u> single <u>than</u> <u>previous</u> generations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'to', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive). Seharusnya 'remain'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Mass layoffs</u> <u>can having</u> a <u>devastating</u> <u>impact</u> on <u>local</u> economies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal verb 'can' harus diikuti oleh bare infinitive. Seharusnya 'can have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Diabetes</u> is <u>often</u> <u>associated</u> <u>to</u> obesity and a <u>lack of</u> exercise.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan preposisi yang tepat untuk kata sifat 'associated' adalah 'with', bukan 'to'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>mutilation</u> of the <u>crime scene</u> <u>made</u> <u>it</u> <u>difficultly</u> to find fingerprints.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'made it + adjective' diperlukan di sini. Seharusnya 'difficult' (kata sifat), bukan 'difficultly' (kata keterangan).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Successful <u>startups</u> <u>requires</u> a <u>combination</u> of <u>innovation</u> <u>and</u> capital.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'startups' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya seharusnya 'require' (tanpa akhiran -s).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In <u>practical politics</u>, <u>every</u> <u>candidates</u> must <u>address</u> <u>the</u> economic concerns.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'every' harus diikuti oleh kata benda tunggal (singular noun). Seharusnya 'candidate'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Antisocial behavior</u> <u>are</u> often <u>linked</u> <u>to</u> <u>early childhood trauma</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Antisocial behavior' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja bantunya seharusnya 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many <u>boomers</u> <u>owns</u> properties that <u>have</u> <u>increased</u> <u>significantly</u> in value.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'boomers' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya seharusnya 'own' (tanpa akhiran -s).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: MOBA <u>games</u> <u>requires</u> <u>fast</u> reflexes and <u>strategic</u> <u>thinking</u> skills.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'games' adalah jamak, maka kata kerjanya seharusnya 'require'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The dedicated fans of JKT48 ___ for several hours outside the theater before the anniversary performance finally began.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Soal ini menggunakan Past Perfect Continuous Tense ('had been waiting'). Tense ini digunakan untuk menyatakan suatu aksi yang telah berlangsung selama beberapa waktu di masa lampau sebelum aksi lain (began) terjadi. Karena konteksnya adalah masa lalu yang sudah selesai, 'had been' adalah bentuk yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The government's recent policy regarding teacher welfare suggests that every educator ___ a significant increase in their monthly allowance starting next year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood. Setelah kata kerja yang menunjukkan saran, permintaan, atau keharusan seperti 'suggests that', kata kerja setelah subjek (every educator) harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form/infinitive without to) tanpa tambahan -s/-es.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many political observers argue that the alleged foreign agents, often called the foreign stooges, ___ the nation's economic sovereignty for decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Present Perfect Continuous Tense ('have been undermining'). Tense ini menunjukkan aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut atau memiliki dampak hingga sekarang. Subjek 'observers' atau 'stooges' adalah jamak, sehingga menggunakan 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Traditional food from West Sumatra, such as Rendang, ___ to be one of the most delicious dishes in the world by various international culinary experts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Present Perfect Passive Voice. Subjek 'Traditional food' adalah tunggal/uncountable, sehingga membutuhkan 'has been' + verb 3 (considered) untuk menyatakan reputasi yang sudah terbangun hingga saat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the new investment regulations are fully implemented, the Minister of Investment ___ several strategic agreements with global corporations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Soal ini menguji Future Perfect Tense ('will have signed'). Tense ini digunakan untuk menyatakan suatu aksi yang akan sudah selesai dilakukan pada titik waktu tertentu di masa depan (ketika regulasi diimplementasikan).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The controversy surrounding explicit adult videos on social media platforms has prompted the authorities ___ stricter digital censorship laws.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'prompt' membutuhkan objek yang diikuti oleh to-infinitive (prompt someone to do something). Opsi 'To draft and enforce' memenuhi syarat gramatikal ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Fuji and Arap, two prominent social media influencers, ___ their collaboration project despite the various rumors circulating online.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek kalimat adalah 'Fuji and Arap' (jamak), sehingga membutuhkan auxiliary 'are' untuk membentuk Present Continuous Tense guna menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ in Jakarta, but it also contributes significantly to the local tourism industry through night market festivals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Inversion digunakan ketika kalimat diawali oleh ekspresi negatif seperti 'Not only'. Karena kalimat selanjutnya menggunakan 'contributes' (Present Tense), maka bagian pertama membutuhkan 'is' atau 'does'. 'Is the nightlife thriving' tepat untuk menunjukkan kondisi saat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Opposition to LGBT movements in Indonesia ___ by traditional social norms and religious interpretations for many years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Opposition' adalah tunggal. Frasa 'for many years' menunjukkan Present Perfect. Bentuk pasif (dipengaruhi oleh) membutuhkan 'has been' + V3.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The quality of life for rural teachers ___ improved if the regional budget allocation had been managed more efficiently.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3. Karena klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect (had been managed), maka klausa utama harus menggunakan 'would/could/might have' + V3 (been).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many people believe that foreign investments ___ by Bahlil Lahadalia will create more job opportunities for the younger generation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Reduced Adjective Clause. 'Initiated and promoted' merupakan kependekan dari 'which are initiated and promoted', berfungsi sebagai kata sifat untuk menjelaskan 'foreign investments'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The traditional ceremonies in Bali, ___ by thousands of tourists every month, are essential for preserving cultural identity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative Clause 'Which are witnessed' memberikan informasi tambahan tentang subjek jamak 'ceremonies' dalam bentuk pasif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The government officials denied that they were ___ by any foreign entities during the negotiation of the mining contract.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur pasif (were + V3) diperlukan di sini. 'Controlled or influenced' (dikendalikan atau dipengaruhi) adalah bentuk participle yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: JKT48's management ensures that every member ___ the necessary training before appearing on the national television stage.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Meskipun 'every member' biasanya tunggal, kata 'ensures that' sering kali memicu Subjunctive Mood dalam konteks formal TOEFL, di mana kata kerja tetap dalam bentuk dasar (undergo). Namun, jika dianggap fakta rutin, 'undergoes' juga umum. Dalam standar TOEFL tingkat tinggi, bentuk dasar lebih diutamakan untuk 'that-clause' yang bersifat mandat/instruksi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ the night clubs in the city center close at 2 AM, many young adults still find ways to enjoy the nightlife.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'Even though' adalah konjungsi yang menghubungkan dua klausa yang berlawanan. 'Despite' dan 'In spite of' harus diikuti frasa benda, bukan klausa lengkap.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The distribution of traditional snacks during the festival ___ a sense of community among the local residents.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The distribution' (tunggal), maka kata kerja bantu yang tepat adalah 'is'. Bentuk pasif 'is intended to' (dimaksudkan untuk) sangat tepat di sini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Several teachers in remote areas ___ for better facilities and salary increases since the beginning of the academic year.
