Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penggunaan 'since' menunjukkan aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung. Subjek 'Several teachers' jamak, maka menggunakan 'Have been advocating'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If Fuji and Arap ___ their social media presence more effectively, their new brand could reach a wider international audience.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 2 (unreal present). Klausa utama menggunakan 'could reach', sehingga klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Simple Past ('managed').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The censorship board found it difficult ___ the spread of leaked adult videos due to the rapid nature of internet sharing.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'find it + adjective + to-infinitive' adalah pola standar. 'To prevent and control' melengkapi kalimat tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Practical politics in developing nations often ___ a high degree of adaptability and strategic networking among party members.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'politics' adalah kata benda tunggal (singular uncountable), sehingga kata kerja 'demand' harus mendapatkan akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The public remains divided on the issue of LGBT rights, with some arguing for equality and ___ for traditional values.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur paralel. 'Some arguing... others advocating'. 'Others' di sini merujuk pada 'other people' secara umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ by the ministry, the new curriculum for vocational teachers will focus on practical skills and technology integration.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced Adjective Clause (kependekan dari 'Once it is approved'). Menggunakan Past Participle untuk makna pasif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The economic influence of foreign stooges is often ___ as a threat to national stability by conservative politicians.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif (is often + V3). 'Perceived' (dianggap/dilihat) adalah pilihan yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Traditional food markets are often crowded ___ they offer fresh ingredients at much lower prices than supermarkets.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi sebab-akibat 'because' diperlukan untuk menjelaskan alasan mengapa pasar tradisional ramai.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: JKT48 members ___ follow a strict set of rules to maintain their public image as role models for young fans.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'must' menunjukkan keharusan atau kewajiban yang kuat sesuai dengan peraturan manajemen.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ the controversy, Bahlil Lahadalia continued to promote the new mining project to potential international investors.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'Despite' adalah preposisi yang diikuti oleh frasa kata benda ('the controversy') untuk menunjukkan pertentangan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The night city life in Jakarta ___ by a vibrant mix of traditional street food and modern entertainment venues.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'life' tunggal. Bentuk pasif Present Tense 'is characterized' (dicirikan oleh) menjelaskan kondisi umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The suspect in the adult video distribution case ___ by the police for questioning earlier this morning.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'earlier this morning' menunjukkan kejadian lampau. Bentuk pasif 'was detained' (ditahan) adalah yang paling tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many teachers find that their current income ___ to cover the rising costs of living in metropolitan areas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'income' tunggal/uncountable. Kata kerja 'is' diikuti kata sifat 'insufficient' (tidak memadai) adalah struktur yang benar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Practical politics requires that a leader ___ both public opinion and internal party dynamics before making a decision.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'requires that'. Bentuk dasar 'consider' digunakan tanpa tambahan apa pun.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Fuji and Arap ___ significant media attention since they announced their joint venture in the entertainment industry.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'since' mengindikasikan Present Perfect Tense. Subjek 'Fuji and Arap' jamak, maka menggunakan 'have received'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: LGBT groups in Indonesia often struggle to find safe spaces ___ to social and legal opposition from various groups.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'due to' (karena/disebabkan oleh) digunakan untuk menghubungkan alasan yang berupa frasa kata benda.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Traditional cooking methods, ___ time-consuming, are still preferred by many families for special occasions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'Although' di sini berfungsi sebagai konjungsi yang disingkat (Although they are time-consuming). Menunjukkan kontras.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: JKT48 fans are known for their loyalty, ___ they often spend large amounts of money on merchandise and tickets.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'for' (karena) digunakan untuk memberikan alasan atau bukti atas pernyataan sebelumnya tentang loyalitas fans.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Bahlil Lahadalia ___ to increase the ease of doing business in Indonesia to attract more foreign companies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Perfect Continuous ('Has been working hard') menyatakan aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih dilakukan Bahlil hingga sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The welfare of public teachers <u>are</u> considered a critical factor in improving the national education quality.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'welfare' adalah tunggal/uncountable, sehingga kata kerja bantunya harus 'is', bukan 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The foreign stooges <u>undermines</u> the economic stability of the country through illegal trade practices.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The foreign stooges' adalah jamak, maka kata kerjanya harus dalam bentuk dasar 'undermine' (tanpa -s).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Traditional food <u>prepare</u> by experienced chefs often tastes much better than mass-produced meals from factories.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan bentuk Past Participle 'prepared' sebagai reduced adjective clause (food which is prepared) untuk memberikan makna pasif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Fuji and Arap <u>has</u> announced their plans to launch a new digital media platform together.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Fuji and Arap' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja bantu Present Perfect yang tepat adalah 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The night life in the city <u>become</u> more vibrant after the new regulations were introduced.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Klausa 'after the new regulations were introduced' menunjukkan masa lampau, sehingga kata kerja utama harus dalam bentuk Past Tense 'became'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>The welfare of teachers</u> <u>have</u> <u>long been</u> <u>neglected by</u> <u>the local government</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'welfare' adalah tunggal, sehingga seharusnya menggunakan 'has' bukan 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Many politicians</u> <u>suspects</u> that <u>foreign entities</u> <u>are trying</u> <u>to interfere</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Many politicians' jamak, maka kata kerjanya harus 'suspect' (tanpa -s).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Traditional food</u> <u>is</u> <u>more healthier</u> <u>than</u> <u>processed snacks</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Double comparison tidak diperbolehkan. Kata 'healthier' sudah merupakan komparatif, sehingga tidak perlu kata 'more'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>JKT48 members</u> <u>is</u> <u>required to</u> <u>attend</u> <u>every training session</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'members' jamak, maka to be yang tepat adalah 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Practical politics</u> <u>often</u> <u>involve</u> <u>complex</u> <u>negotiations</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'politics' adalah tunggal, maka kata kerjanya harus 'involves'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>The censorship board</u> <u>are preventing</u> <u>the distribution</u> <u>of</u> <u>adult videos</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'censorship board' adalah kata benda kolektif tunggal, sehingga harus menggunakan 'is preventing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Bahlil Lahadalia</u> <u>has been successfully</u> <u>attract</u> <u>massive investments</u> <u>lately</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'has been', jika ingin menyatakan aktivitas berkelanjutan harus menggunakan Present Participle (attracting) atau bentuk pasif (attracted). Di sini makna aktif diperlukan, jadi 'attracting'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Fuji and Arap</u> <u>was</u> <u>seen</u> <u>at</u> <u>a famous night club</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Fuji and Arap' jamak, maka to be lampau yang tepat adalah 'were'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>LGBT opposition</u> <u>in the country</u> <u>have grown</u> <u>significantly</u> <u>recently</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'opposition' tunggal, maka harus menggunakan 'has grown'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Traditional spices</u> <u>are used</u> <u>to enhance</u> <u>the flavors</u> <u>of many dish</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'many' harus diikuti oleh kata benda jamak. Seharusnya 'of many dishes'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The existential fear of death ___ by many philosophers as a fundamental driver of human creativity and cultural development throughout history.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Present Perfect Passive Voice ('has been analyzed') untuk menyatakan tindakan yang telah dilakukan secara konsisten hingga saat ini. Subjek 'fear' adalah tunggal/uncountable, sehingga menggunakan 'has been'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the new KPOP group officially debuts next month, their pre-release single ___ more than fifty million views on major streaming platforms.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Soal ini menguji Future Perfect Tense. Pola 'By the time + simple present' menunjukkan titik waktu di masa depan, sehingga klausa utama harus menggunakan 'will have + V3' untuk menunjukkan aksi yang akan sudah selesai pada waktu tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The podcast Hearts2Hearts features various individuals ___ their most vulnerable stories regarding love, loss, and the complexity of human relationships.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Present Participle sebagai penjelas subjek ('individuals'). Bentuk '-ing' (sharing and discussing) bermakna aktif, yaitu orang-orang yang secara aktif berbagi dan mendiskusikan cerita mereka.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Korean dramas, which often depict intricate social hierarchies, ___ a significant influence on the fashion choices of young adults across Southeast Asia.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'Korean dramas' (jamak), sehingga membutuhkan to-be jamak 'are'. Frasa 'are known to have' adalah bentuk pasif yang menyatakan reputasi atau fakta umum yang diakui.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The unique social position of the 'third gender' in Thailand ___ by historians as a complex intersection of Buddhist traditions and modern identity politics.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'position' adalah tunggal. Kalimat ini menggunakan Passive Voice (is interpreted) untuk menjelaskan bagaimana posisi tersebut ditafsirkan oleh para sejarawan dalam konteks akademis.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Applying for an Australian Work and Holiday Visa (WHV) requires that an applicant ___ a minimum level of English proficiency through an official test.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'requires that'. Dalam pola ini, kata kerja setelah subjek (applicant) harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form) tanpa tambahan -s/-es meskipun subjeknya tunggal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The LPDP scholarship committee announced that they ___ thousands of candidates before selecting the finalists for the interview stage.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Past Perfect Tense ('had screened') karena aksi penyaringan terjadi sebelum aksi pengumuman (announced). Keduanya terjadi di masa lampau, namun satu terjadi lebih awal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many students find it nearly impossible to pursue higher education ___ the exorbitant costs associated with private universities and living expenses.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'due to' (karena) digunakan untuk menghubungkan alasan yang berbentuk frasa kata benda ('the exorbitant costs'). 'Because' membutuhkan klausa lengkap (subjek + predikat).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The 'Free Nutritious Meal' program, although well-intentioned, ___ widespread criticism from various civil society organizations regarding its budget allocation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'program' adalah tunggal. 'Has faced' (Present Perfect) menunjukkan bahwa program tersebut telah menghadapi kritik sejak kemunculannya hingga saat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Economists argue that haphazardly made programs, often called 'program asal buat', ___ more harm than good to the long-term national economy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'might' harus diikuti oleh bare infinitive (V1 tanpa to), yaitu 'cause'. Kata keterangan 'ultimately' diletakkan di antara modal dan kata kerja utamanya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: KPOP idols ___ to undergo rigorous training for many years before they are deemed ready for their official debut.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'idols' jamak, sehingga membutuhkan 'are'. Bentuk pasif 'are mandated' (diwajibkan) sesuai dengan konteks sistem pelatihan industri musik Korea.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the scholarship program ___ more transparent, many underprivileged students would have had a better chance of succeeding.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (pengandaian masa lalu yang tidak terjadi). Klausa utama 'would have had' berpasangan dengan 'if + past perfect' (had been).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Listening to the life-changing experiences on Hearts2Hearts ___ many people to reconsider their own priorities and life goals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek kalimat adalah Gerund Phrase 'Listening to...'. Gerund sebagai subjek selalu dianggap tunggal, sehingga menggunakan auxiliary 'has' untuk Present Perfect.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not until the protagonist in the Korean drama discovers the truth ___ the audience understand the complexity of the plot.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Inversion digunakan setelah frasa negatif 'Not until'. Karena subjek 'the audience' dianggap tunggal dalam konteks ini dan kata kerja 'understand' adalah base form, maka membutuhkan auxiliary 'does'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The social acceptance of diverse gender identities in Thailand ___ as a model for other conservative nations in the region.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'acceptance' adalah tunggal. 'Is often cited' (sering dikutip/disebut) adalah bentuk pasif yang tepat untuk menyatakan fakta umum yang berulang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Applicants for the WHV Australia program ___ their bank statements to prove they have sufficient funds for their stay.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'must' harus diikuti oleh bare infinitive ('provide and verify'). Tidak boleh menggunakan 'to' atau akhiran '-ing' langsung setelah must dalam fungsi keharusan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: High-quality education has become so expensive ___ many middle-class families are forced to take out substantial loans.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat (begitu mahal sehingga...). 'That' di sini mengawali klausa akibat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The rejection of the 'Free Nutritious Meal' program ___ to the lack of transparency in its implementation strategy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif modal 'can be attributed' (dapat dikaitkan dengan) adalah frasa standar untuk menunjukkan penyebab atau faktor pendukung sebuah fenomena.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the government ___ the local communities were fully aware of the consequences of the haphazardly made policy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan korelasi yang tepat untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'. Jika menggunakan 'neither', maka pembandingnya harus dipisahkan oleh 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The concept of death ___ a central theme in many classic Korean dramas, exploring themes of reincarnation and eternal love.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'concept' tunggal. 'Has long been' (telah lama menjadi) menggunakan Present Perfect untuk menunjukkan status yang berlanjut dari masa lalu hingga sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Before the KPOP industry became a global phenomenon, several pioneer groups ___ the foundation for the Hallyu wave.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect ('had laid') digunakan karena aksi peletakan fondasi terjadi sebelum industri menjadi fenomena global (became). 'Already' menekankan urutan waktu tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The Hearts2Hearts episodes, ___ by millions of listeners, continue to provide a platform for unheard voices.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative Clause 'Which are streamed' memberikan informasi tambahan tentang subjek jamak 'episodes'. Bentuk pasif diperlukan karena episode tersebut 'disiarkan'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Thailand is often considered a pioneer in gender diversity ___ its progressive laws regarding gender reassignment surgery.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'Because of' adalah preposisi yang diikuti frasa kata benda ('its progressive laws') untuk menunjukkan alasan atau penyebab.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Applicants who ___ their WHV visa will have the opportunity to work and travel across Australia for a year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata keterangan (adverb) 'successfully' untuk menerangkan kata kerja 'obtain' dalam klausa relatif tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: LPDP scholars ___ to return to Indonesia after completing their studies to contribute to national development.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'scholars' jamak, membutuhkan 'are'. Bentuk pasif 'are expected' (diharapkan untuk) adalah bentuk yang paling tepat secara formal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ by financial difficulties, many bright students are unable to finish their doctoral programs on time.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced Adjective Clause (kependekan dari 'Because they are hampered'). Menggunakan Past Participle untuk makna pasif (terhambat oleh).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Public health experts suggest that the nutrition program ___ more focus on local food sources to ensure sustainability.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah kata kerja 'suggest that'. Kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar 'have', meskipun subjek 'program' bersifat tunggal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The 'haphazardly made' policies often lead to public confusion ___ they lack a clear implementation roadmap.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Conjunction 'since' (karena) digunakan untuk mengawali klausa alasan. Struktur ini menghubungkan dua klausa yang menunjukkan hubungan sebab.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Death is viewed ___ a transition to another realm in many traditional Southeast Asian belief systems.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja pasif 'is viewed' biasanya berpasangan dengan preposisi 'as' untuk mendefinisikan status atau persepsi terhadap subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: KPOP entertainment agencies ___ large sums of money in the visual production of their music videos.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'agencies' jamak, maka kata kerja 'invest' tidak perlu tambahan -s. Adverb 'constantly' diletakkan sebelum kata kerja utama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The emotional depth of the drama ___ many international fans to learn the Korean language.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'depth' (tunggal), sehingga menggunakan 'has inspired' untuk menyatakan dampak yang sudah terjadi dan masih terasa.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In Thailand, individuals who belong to the 'third gender' ___ more freedom of expression than in neighboring countries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'individuals' jamak, sehingga kata kerja 'enjoy' tidak menggunakan -s. Adverb of frequency 'usually' diletakkan sebelum verb.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Obtaining a WHV Australia ___ easier if the applicant prepares all documents several months in advance.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek kalimat adalah Gerund 'Obtaining...' yang bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerja dalam present tense membutuhkan akhiran -s ('becomes').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: LPDP scholarship recipients are required to maintain a high GPA, ___ they might lose their funding.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'Otherwise' (jika tidak) digunakan untuk menunjukkan konsekuensi atau hasil negatif jika syarat atau kewajiban sebelumnya tidak dipenuhi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Education costs in the city are rising so rapidly ___ many families struggle to keep up.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adverb + that' (begitu cepat sehingga...). 'That' digunakan untuk mengawali klausa yang merupakan akibat dari kondisi sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The 'Free Nutritious Meal' program faces rejection because <u>its</u> ineffective in reaching rural areas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat tersebut membutuhkan subjek + kata kerja (It is / It's) sebelum kata sifat 'ineffective', bukan kata ganti kepemilikan 'its'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The exorbitant <u>tuition</u> fees are preventing many students from attending top-tier private universities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'tuition' (biaya kuliah) adalah kata benda tak terhitung (uncountable), sehingga tidak memerlukan bentuk jamak meskipun biayanya besar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Haphazardly made programs often lead to <u>fail</u> if they are not supported by data.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah kata kerja 'lead to', dibutuhkan kata benda (noun) 'failure' untuk melengkapi objek dari preposisi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The LPDP scholarship <u>committee</u> has screening thousands of applications for the next period.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Present Perfect Tense membutuhkan 'has + V3'. Seharusnya 'has screened', bukan 'has screening'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Thailand's laws <u>regarding</u> gender diversity have been a topic of interest for years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penggunaan participle 'regarding' sebagai preposisi (mengenai) sudah tepat, namun jika harus diubah dalam konteks perbaikan kata, ini menguji pemahaman kelas kata.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the end of this academic year, the literature students ___ more than twenty classical Indonesian novels for their final thesis research.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Future Perfect Tense ('will have + V3') karena terdapat keterangan waktu 'By the end of this academic year' yang menunjukkan suatu aksi yang akan sudah selesai dilakukan pada titik waktu tertentu di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The controversial scenes in many adult-themed Indonesian horror movies ___ significant debate among cultural critics regarding ethical standards.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'scenes' adalah jamak (plural), sehingga membutuhkan auxiliary verb jamak 'have'. Kalimat ini menggunakan Present Perfect Tense untuk menyatakan peristiwa yang terjadi berulang kali hingga sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Artificial Intelligence is increasingly integrated into consumer electronics, ___ the production costs and final retail prices of high-end gadgets.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Present Participle Phrase ('thereby increasing') untuk menunjukkan hasil atau konsekuensi dari klausa sebelumnya. Kata 'thereby' mempertegas hubungan sebab-akibat tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the engineering department ___ the robotic arm more precisely, the factory would have avoided the recent production failure.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (pengandaian masa lalu yang tidak terjadi). Klausa utama 'would have avoided' berpasangan dengan Past Perfect 'had calibrated' di dalam klausa 'if'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern children's literature ___ a balance between imaginative storytelling and educational values to foster healthy psychological development.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal verb 'must' harus diikuti oleh bare infinitive (V1 tanpa to), yaitu 'maintain'. Kata keterangan 'carefully' diletakkan di antara modal dan kata kerja utama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The rare species of orchids found in the deep forests of Papua ___ by international botanists for several decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'species' (dalam konteks ini jamak karena merujuk pada berbagai jenis anggrek). Frasa 'for several decades' menandakan Present Perfect Passive Voice ('have been + V3').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ in traditional Indonesian folklore, but it also appears frequently in modern romantic literature.
opsi: The theme of true love exists
Is the theme of true love existing
Exists the theme of true love
The theme of true love exist
Does the theme of true love exist
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Inversion (pembalikan) digunakan setelah frasa negatif 'Not only'. Karena kalimat tersebut menyatakan fakta umum (Present Tense), maka membutuhkan auxiliary 'does' diikuti subjek dan V1.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Technical errors in the initial design of the robotic vacuum ___ several malfunctions during the public demonstration last week.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'last week' menunjukkan Simple Past Tense. Karena subjek 'Technical errors' melakukan aksi (aktif), maka digunakan bentuk 'caused'. 'Reportedly' adalah adverb penjelas.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many young couples find that maintaining a long-distance relationship ___ a high level of trust and constant digital communication.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek klausa benda tersebut adalah gerund 'maintaining', yang selalu dianggap tunggal. Oleh karena itu, kata kerjanya harus menggunakan akhiran -s ('necessitates').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The robotics competition, ___ by a major electronic company, attracted hundreds of brilliant students from across the country.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative clause 'Which was sponsored' memberikan informasi tambahan tentang subjek 'competition'. Bentuk pasif diperlukan karena kompetisi tersebut disponsori.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Before the advent of CGI technology, Indonesian horror films ___ practical special effects and heavy makeup to terrify the audience.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Tense ('had used') digunakan untuk menyatakan aksi yang terjadi sebelum aksi lain di masa lampau ('became/advent').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The complex engineering required to build a humanoid robot ___ years of research and massive financial investment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek kalimat adalah 'engineering' (tunggal), maka kata kerja Simple Present harus menggunakan akhiran -s ('involves').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Literary critics suggest that the author ___ more focus on the development of the female protagonist's character.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'suggest that'. Kata kerja setelah subjek (author) harus dalam bentuk dasar 'place' tanpa tambahan -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The rapid growth of the fauna population in the national park ___ to the success of recent conservation efforts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif modal 'can be attributed' (dapat dikaitkan dengan) adalah frasa standar untuk menunjukkan penyebab atau faktor pendukung.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Children who are exposed to diverse cultures through literature ___ more empathetic as they grow older.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Children' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja 'tend' tidak menggunakan akhiran -s. Pola 'tend + to-infinitive' adalah yang benar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Romantic relationships depicted in modern films ___ a shift in societal values regarding marriage and commitment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'relationships' jamak, maka kata kerjanya adalah 'reflect' (tanpa -s). Kalimat ini menyatakan fakta atau kondisi saat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The integration of AI into smartphones ___ the battery life of most devices more efficient than ever before.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'integration' tunggal, sehingga menggunakan auxiliary 'has' untuk Present Perfect Tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the robot completes its mission on Mars, it ___ thousands of high-resolution images back to Earth.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Future Perfect Tense digunakan karena ada keterangan 'By the time' yang merujuk pada penyelesaian misi di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Indonesian horror films that rely on jump scares ___ to receive negative reviews from serious cinema enthusiasts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'films' jamak, maka to-be yang tepat adalah 'are'. 'Are likely to' berarti kemungkinan besar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The engineering team ___ working on the new bridge design for six months when the funding was suddenly cut.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Continuous ('had been working') digunakan karena aksi berlangsung selama durasi tertentu ('six months') sebelum kejadian lain di masa lampau ('was cut').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Classical Indonesian literature ___ a rich source of inspiration for contemporary poets and novelists.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'literature' tunggal, sehingga kata kerja Simple Present menggunakan akhiran -s ('remains').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the technical director ___ the lead engineer was satisfied with the performance of the prototype.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan korelasi yang tepat untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The flora and fauna found in the Amazon rainforest ___ unique adaptations to survive in the dense environment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'flora and fauna' (dua entitas) dianggap jamak, sehingga menggunakan 'have developed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Parents should encourage their children to read books ___ they can develop their vocabulary and cognitive skills.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'so that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan tujuan (purpose) dari aksi menyemangati anak membaca.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The production of high-end robotics ___ extremely difficult without the availability of precision-engineered parts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Conditional Type 2 (unreal present) yang menyatakan pengandaian situasi saat ini. 'Would be' adalah bentuk yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many people believe that true romance ___ finding a partner who shares the same life values and goals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'romance' tunggal, maka menggunakan 'consists of' (terdiri dari).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The latest AI-powered smartphones ___ to be much more expensive than the previous generation of mobile phones.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'smartphones' jamak, maka menggunakan passive voice 'are expected' (diharapkan/diperkirakan).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ by the beautiful landscape of the countryside, the poet wrote several poems about nature.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced Adjective Clause pasif. 'Inspired by...' adalah kependekan dari 'As he was inspired by...'

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Technical students must learn how to operate complex machinery safely ___ they graduate from the vocational school.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'before' (sebelum) logis digunakan untuk menunjukkan urutan aktivitas pendidikan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Horror movies that include adult content ___ restricted to viewers who are over seventeen years old.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'movies' jamak, membutuhkan auxiliary 'are' dan adverb 'strictly' untuk menerangkan batasan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The delicate balance of the ecosystem ___ if we continue to destroy the natural habitats of various animals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Conditional Sentence Type 1. Klausa 'if + present' berpasangan dengan 'will + V1' (bentuk pasif: 'will be + V3').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Ancient literature often provides insights into the social structures and religious beliefs of ___ civilizations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata sifat (adjective) 'ancient' untuk menerangkan kata benda 'civilizations'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The development of AI technology has become so rapid ___ experts are concerned about its ethical implications.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' (begitu cepat sehingga...).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Children who grow up in a supportive environment ___ better at managing their emotions in adulthood.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Children' jamak, membutuhkan 'are'. 'Usually' adalah adverb of frequency.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The engineering team has been testing the new robotic limb, ___ to improve the quality of life for amputees.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative clause 'Which aims' (yang bertujuan) menjelaskan benda 'robotic limb'. Karena limb tunggal, aim menggunakan akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Industrial robotics <u>have</u> revolutionized the manufacturing sector in the last decade.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Robotics' (bidang ilmu) dianggap tunggal, sehingga harus menggunakan 'has', bukan 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The protagonist in the romantic novel <u>finding</u> that true love requires a lot of sacrifices and patience.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat membutuhkan kata kerja utama (verb). Subjek 'protagonist' adalah tunggal, maka dalam Simple Present Tense kata kerjanya adalah 'finds'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: High-quality electronic <u>component</u> are essential for building reliable medical equipment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'are' menunjukkan bahwa subjek harus jamak. Maka 'component' harus diubah menjadi 'components'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Children <u>enjoys</u> listening to stories about animals and mythical creatures.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Children' jamak, maka kata kerja tidak boleh menggunakan akhiran -s. Seharusnya 'enjoy'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The engineering project <u>was finish</u> on time despite the budget constraints.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Passive voice membutuhkan 'to be + V3'. Maka 'was finish' harus diperbaiki menjadi 'was finished'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The massive mining operations in the region ___ significant environmental degradation before the government finally implemented stricter conservation regulations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Past Perfect Tense ('had + V3') karena terdapat dua kejadian di masa lampau, di mana satu kejadian (menyebabkan kerusakan) terjadi sebelum kejadian lainnya (implementasi regulasi/implemented). Penanda 'before' memperjelas urutan waktu ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Advocates for free higher education believe that providing accessible learning opportunities ___ the socio-economic gap within the next decade.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menunjukkan prediksi di masa depan dengan keterangan waktu 'within the next decade'. Penggunaan Future Tense ('will + bare infinitive') adalah pilihan yang paling tepat secara gramatikal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Despite the long years of struggle and social exclusion, the community members ___ their commitment to achieving local empowerment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'community members' adalah jamak. Penggunaan Simple Past Tense ('never once wavered') menceritakan fakta sejarah perjuangan mereka di masa lampau yang sudah selesai.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The local government is currently developing a comprehensive system to help homeless individuals ___ to the workforce through vocational training.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'help' dapat diikuti oleh 'object + bare infinitive' atau 'object + to-infinitive'. 'Reintegrate successfully' adalah bare infinitive yang tepat, diikuti oleh adverb untuk menerangkan proses reintegrasi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Inclusive education requires that every school ___ adequate facilities to support students with physical and mental disabilities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'requires that'. Dalam struktur ini, kata kerja setelah subjek (every school) harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form) tanpa tambahan -s/-es.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Researchers found that individuals struggling with mental health issues ___ significant improvement after attending regular cognitive behavioral therapy sessions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Karena klausa utama menggunakan 'found' (Simple Past), maka klausa pendukungnya juga harus menggunakan Simple Past ('experienced') untuk menjaga keselarasan waktu (sequence of tenses).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In many Islamic law interpretations, the concept of justice ___ as the foundation for all social and legal interactions within the community.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'the concept of justice' adalah tunggal. Kalimat ini membutuhkan Passive Voice ('is regarded') untuk menyatakan bagaimana konsep tersebut dipandang secara umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The development of advanced calculus and complex mathematics ___ for the progress of modern engineering and robotic technology.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The development' (tunggal), bukan 'mathematics'. Oleh karena itu, auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'has been' (Present Perfect) untuk menunjukkan kontribusi yang terus berlanjut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Copyright laws are designed to protect creative works ___ they are illegally distributed or reproduced without the author's permission.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'so that' (agar/supaya) menunjukkan tujuan dari dirancangnya hukum hak cipta. Ini menghubungkan tindakan (merancang hukum) dengan tujuannya (mencegah distribusi ilegal).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A severe norm violation within a traditional society ___ to social ostracization or other forms of community punishment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'can' harus diikuti oleh bare infinitive (lead). Kata keterangan 'often' diletakkan di antara modal dan kata kerja utama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Patients diagnosed with type 2 diabetes must monitor their carbohydrate intake ___ maintain stable blood glucose levels.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'in order to' diikuti oleh bare infinitive ('maintain') untuk menunjukkan tujuan atau maksud dari tindakan memonitor asupan karbohidrat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The environmental impact of deep-sea mining ___ by marine biologists for several years before the project was finally approved.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Passive ('had been evaluated') digunakan karena proses evaluasi berlangsung sebelum proyek disetujui (was approved). Penanda 'for several years' menunjukkan durasi sebelum kejadian lampau lainnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The struggle for civil rights in the 20th century ___ many legal reforms that continue to affect modern society today.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'struggle' (tunggal) melakukan aksi aktif di masa lampau. Simple Past Tense ('prompted and facilitated') adalah pilihan yang paling tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Programs for free college tuition often fail ___ they are supported by a sustainable long-term financial model.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'unless' (kecuali jika) digunakan untuk menunjukkan kondisi negatif. Program akan gagal kecuali jika didukung oleh model finansial yang berkelanjutan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Providing shelter for the homeless requires both government funding ___ active participation from non-profit organizations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan korelasi yang tepat untuk 'both' adalah 'and'. Struktur 'both A and B' digunakan untuk menggabungkan dua unsur yang setara.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mathematical models ___ to predict the spread of infectious diseases have become increasingly sophisticated in recent years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Reduced Adjective Clause. 'Used' (V3) di sini bermakna pasif, kependekan dari 'which are used'. Berfungsi menerangkan 'mathematical models'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The ethics of AI development should ensure that technology ___ human rights and privacy at all times.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Klausa 'that technology respects' menggunakan Simple Present Tense untuk menyatakan prinsip atau fakta umum yang harus dijalankan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mental health professionals emphasize that therapy sessions ___ more effective when the patient feels safe and supported.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'therapy sessions' adalah jamak, sehingga to-be yang tepat untuk menyatakan fakta umum (Present Tense) adalah 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Islamic law principles of inheritance ___ carefully to ensure a fair distribution of assets among the heirs.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'principles' adalah jamak. Kalimat ini membutuhkan Passive Voice ('are applied') untuk menyatakan bagaimana prinsip tersebut dijalankan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Copyright infringement ___ a serious legal issue that can result in heavy fines or imprisonment for the violator.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Copyright infringement' (pelanggaran hak cipta) adalah tunggal/uncountable. Maka menggunakan 'is considered' (dianggap sebagai).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A norm violation in a workplace can cause ___ in productivity and a decrease in employee morale.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah kata kerja 'cause', dibutuhkan objek berupa kata benda (noun). 'A decline' adalah noun phrase yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Diabetes education programs are designed to help patients ___ the long-term risks associated with high blood sugar.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'help' dapat diikuti oleh bare infinitive ('understand'). Menandakan proses membantu pasien untuk memahami risiko.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the new mining facility opens next year, the company ___ hundreds of workers from the local community.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Future Perfect Tense ('will have hired') digunakan karena ada penanda 'By the time + Simple Present' yang menunjukkan aksi yang akan sudah selesai di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many people with disabilities ___ to overcome social barriers through persistent effort and community support.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Many people' adalah jamak, sehingga menggunakan auxiliary 'have'. Present Perfect menunjukkan keberhasilan yang telah dicapai hingga saat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Homelessness often stems from a lack of affordable housing ___ a shortage of mental health services in urban areas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'as well as' (serta/dan juga) digunakan untuk menambahkan informasi yang setara tanpa mengubah struktur kalimat secara drastis.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The struggle for gender equality in education ___ significantly over the past few decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The struggle' adalah tunggal. Frasa 'over the past few decades' menunjukkan Present Perfect Tense ('has evolved').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the government ___ free college education earlier, many more students would have graduated by now.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (pengandaian masa lalu). Klausa utama 'would have graduated' berpasangan dengan 'if + past perfect' (had provided).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mining corporations are often required to conduct an environmental audit ___ they start any new extraction project.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi waktu 'before' (sebelum) sangat logis dalam konteks ini untuk menunjukkan urutan prosedur hukum pertambangan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The beauty of complex mathematics lies in its ability ___ abstract concepts through logical reasoning.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata benda 'ability' biasanya diikuti oleh to-infinitive ('to explain') untuk menunjukkan fungsi atau kemampuan dari benda tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Copyright protection ___ only to original works of authorship that are fixed in a tangible medium of expression.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Copyright protection' tunggal, kata kerjanya adalah 'applies' (Present Tense) untuk menyatakan fakta hukum yang berlaku secara umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Social norms are implicit rules that ___ the behavior of individuals within a particular group or society.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'that' merujuk pada 'implicit rules' (jamak), sehingga kata kerjanya harus dalam bentuk jamak 'govern' (tanpa -s).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Diabetes can lead to serious health complications ___ it is not managed through proper diet and exercise.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'if' (jika) digunakan untuk menunjukkan hubungan syarat antara kondisi (tidak dikelola) dan akibat (komplikasi).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Therapy sessions provide a safe environment for individuals to explore their emotions ___ fear of judgment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'without' (tanpa) menunjukkan ketiadaan rasa takut dalam lingkungan yang aman tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Islamic law emphasizes the importance of ethics ___ conducting business and financial transactions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'when' (ketika) digunakan untuk menunjukkan waktu atau situasi di mana prinsip etika tersebut harus diterapkan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The integration of technology in education ___ to provide better learning experiences for students with disabilities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'integration' tunggal, maka menggunakan 'aims' (Present Tense) untuk menyatakan tujuan dari sistem tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The mining company <u>have</u> been operating in the forest for over twenty years before the new law was passed.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu menunjukkan kejadian lampau sebelum kejadian lampau lainnya (was passed). Seharusnya menggunakan Past Perfect 'had', bukan 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Students <u>which</u> want to apply for free college tuition must submit their applications by Friday.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'which' hanya untuk benda. Karena merujuk pada 'Students' (orang), seharusnya menggunakan 'who'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The struggle for <u>independent</u> was a long and difficult process for the local citizens.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata benda (noun) 'independence' setelah preposisi 'for', bukan kata sifat 'independent'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mathematics <u>are</u> considered the language of science by many prominent researchers worldwide.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bidang studi berakhiran -ics seperti 'Mathematics' dianggap tunggal, sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'is', bukan 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mental health <u>aware</u> has increased significantly in urban societies in the last few years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata benda (noun) 'awareness' (kesadaran) sebagai subjek kalimat, bukan kata sifat 'aware'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Individuals <u>with</u> physical <u>disabilities</u> often <u>faces</u> barriers <u>when</u> accessing <u>public facilities</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Individuals' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya seharusnya 'face', bukan 'faces'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Providing <u>shelter</u> for <u>the homeless</u> <u>is</u> a <u>challenging</u> task <u>for the city</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini sebenarnya benar secara gramatikal. Namun jika harus memilih sesuai format soal 'pilih yang salah', poin 'is' sering diuji kesesuaiannya dengan gerund 'providing' (tunggal).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Islamic law</u> <u>provide</u> a <u>framework</u> for <u>ethical</u> <u>conduct</u> in the community.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Islamic law' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya seharusnya 'provides', bukan 'provide'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Copyright</u> protection <u>ensure</u> that <u>authors</u> <u>receive</u> <u>credit</u> for their works.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'protection' adalah tunggal, maka kata kerjanya harus 'ensures', bukan 'ensure'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Severe <u>norm violation</u> <u>can</u> <u>leads</u> to <u>serious</u> social <u>consequences</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal 'can', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive). Seharusnya 'lead', bukan 'leads'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Managing <u>diabetes</u> <u>require</u> constant <u>monitoring</u> of <u>blood sugar</u> <u>levels</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Managing diabetes' (gerund phrase) bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerja seharusnya 'requires', bukan 'require'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Many mining</u> operations <u>has</u> <u>caused</u> <u>significant</u> damage <u>to the environment</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'operations' adalah jamak, maka auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'have', bukan 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Free <u>college education</u> <u>can help</u> <u>reducing</u> <u>the</u> <u>socio-economic gap</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'can help', biasanya diikuti bare infinitive 'reduce' atau 'to reduce'. Penggunaan 'reducing' (gerund) kurang tepat dalam konteks ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>struggle for</u> <u>civil rights</u> <u>were</u> a <u>pivotal moment</u> <u>in history</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The struggle' (tunggal), sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'was', bukan 'were'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Mathematics</u> <u>is</u> a <u>subject</u> <u>who</u> <u>requires</u> logical thinking.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'who' digunakan untuk orang. Karena merujuk pada 'subject' (benda), seharusnya menggunakan 'which' atau 'that'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the global recession reached its peak last year, many international trade organizations ___ significant policy adjustments to stabilize the market.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Past Perfect Tense ('had already implemented') karena terdapat penanda waktu 'By the time + simple past' yang menunjukkan suatu aksi telah selesai dilakukan sebelum aksi lain terjadi di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Ancient Indonesian kingdoms, such as Majapahit and Sriwijaya, ___ their maritime influence across Southeast Asia through strategic trade and diplomacy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks kalimat adalah sejarah (fakta masa lampau), sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense ('successfully expanded'). Subjeknya jamak, namun dalam past tense tidak ada perbedaan akhiran untuk subjek tunggal/jamak.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Legal experts argue that customary law, or 'hukum adat', ___ respected by modern judicial systems to preserve the cultural identity of inland communities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'should' harus diikuti oleh 'be' + Past Participle (V3) untuk membentuk kalimat pasif. Adverb diletakkan di antara modal be dan kata kerja utama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The rapid advancement of cybercrime techniques necessitates that software developers ___ more sophisticated encryption protocols in every update.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'necessitates that'. Dalam struktur ini, kata kerja setelah subjek (developers) harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form) tanpa akhiran -s/-es.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Patriotism in the modern era ___ limited to military service but also encompasses active participation in maintaining national ethics and values.
opsi: To be not merely and exclusively
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Patriotism' adalah tunggal/uncountable. Kalimat ini menggunakan struktur 'is not merely... but also' untuk menyatakan definisi yang meluas.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many inland tribes, despite their geographic isolation, ___ intricate social structures that prioritize community welfare over individual gain.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'tribes' adalah jamak. Frasa 'have long practiced' (Present Perfect) menunjukkan tindakan yang sudah dimulai sejak lama dan masih berlanjut hingga sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Classical literature scholars discovered that several old manuscripts ___ for centuries in hidden temple vaults before their recent recovery.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Passive ('had been preserved') digunakan karena aksi penyimpanan terjadi selama durasi tertentu ('for centuries') sebelum penemuan di masa lampau ('discovered').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The ocean's biodiversity ___ a critical role in regulating the global climate and supporting the livelihoods of coastal populations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'biodiversity' adalah tunggal. Present Perfect ('has played') digunakan untuk menyatakan fakta atau peranan yang sudah ada dan masih berlaku.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sociologists worry that the widespread moral decay among the urban population ___ the stability of future social institutions.
opsi: Could ultimately and severely be undermined
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'could' diikuti oleh bare infinitive 'undermine'. Adverb diletakkan di tengah untuk memberikan penekanan pada dampak kerusakan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the previous administration ___ the emerging cyber threats more seriously, the national data breach could have been prevented.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect ('had + V3') karena klausa utamanya menggunakan 'could have been prevented'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern software architecture ___ modularity and scalability to ensure that applications can handle an increasing number of users.
opsi: Must intentionally and strategically to prioritize
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'must' harus diikuti bare infinitive 'prioritize'. Kalimat ini bermakna aktif karena subjeknya adalah arsitektur perangkat lunak yang 'memprioritaskan' prinsip tertentu.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The ancient trade routes connecting Indonesian islands ___ exchange of not only spices but also religious and philosophical ideas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kejadian masa lalu (sejarah) menggunakan Simple Past Tense ('facilitated'). Subjek 'routes' jamak, namun dalam past tense bentuk kata kerja tetap sama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Books that delve into the lives of inland people often ___ the misconceptions held by urban society about indigenous cultures.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Books' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja 'challenge' dan 'deconstruct' tidak boleh menggunakan akhiran -s. Ini adalah pernyataan fakta (Simple Present).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The global recession ___ that international cooperation is essential for maintaining the stability of the financial system.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The global recession' tunggal, menggunakan Present Perfect ('has demonstrated') untuk merujuk pada fenomena yang baru saja terjadi atau dampaknya masih terasa.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Traditional customary laws ___ by local elders to resolve conflicts within the community for generations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'laws' jamak. Frasa 'for generations' menunjukkan durasi yang membutuhkan Present Perfect Passive ('have been applied').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Marine ecosystems are becoming increasingly vulnerable ___ the rising levels of chemical pollutants in the ocean.
opsi: In order to and so that
Regardless of and in spite of
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan preposisi yang menyatakan alasan/sebab. 'Due to' dan 'because of' adalah pilihan yang tepat diikuti frasa kata benda.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The patriotic spirit of the citizens ___ when the nation faced its most difficult economic challenges last decade.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'spirit' tunggal. Keterangan waktu 'last decade' menunjukkan Simple Past Passive ('was ignited').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Researchers are finding that cybercrime syndicates ___ more sophisticated methods to bypass modern security software.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'syndicates' jamak. Present Continuous ('are developing') digunakan untuk menyatakan aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Old literature manuscripts ___ into digital formats to ensure they remain accessible to future generations of scholars.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal pasif 'should be converted' (seharusnya dikonversi) diperlukan untuk menyatakan rekomendasi/keharusan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The King of the ancient Majapahit Empire ___ his territory across the archipelago through a series of tactical military campaigns.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks sejarah masa lampau (The King... Majapahit) memerlukan Simple Past Tense ('expanded').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Ethical therapy sessions provide a safe environment where individuals ___ their mental health struggles without fear of judgment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'can' diikuti bare infinitive 'discuss'. Kalimat bermakna aktif (individu berdiskusi).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the end of the next century, scientists believe that several maritime species ___ due to the continuous warming of the oceans.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Future Perfect Tense ('will have + V3') digunakan untuk prediksi masa depan yang akan sudah selesai pada waktu tertentu ('By the end of the next century').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mathematical principles ___ to design complex algorithms are often derived from abstract logic and set theory.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced Adjective Clause (kependekan dari 'which are used'). 'Used' (V3) menjelaskan kata benda 'principles'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The moral decay observed in modern society ___ as a failure of the traditional family structure and educational system.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'decay' tunggal, menggunakan Passive Voice ('is regarded') untuk menyatakan pendapat umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Customary laws in inland regions ___ to resolving disputes related to land ownership and community boundaries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'laws' jamak, maka kata kerja 'pertain' tidak menggunakan -s (Simple Present).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The software update ___ many of the critical vulnerabilities that hackers exploited in the previous version.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'update' tunggal, menggunakan Present Perfect ('has addressed') untuk menunjukkan aksi yang baru saja selesai.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Indigenous people living in the interior of the jungle ___ deep spiritual connection with the flora and fauna surrounding them.
opsi: Are maintained a remarkably and deeply
Was maintained a remarkably and deeply
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'people' adalah jamak. Kata kerja 'maintain' digunakan dalam bentuk dasar (Simple Present).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The global recession ___ a significant increase in the price of essential commodities and basic services.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'recession' tunggal, menggunakan Present Perfect aktif ('has caused').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Books written during the colonial era ___ valuable insights into the social struggles of the Indonesian people.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Books' jamak, maka kata kerja 'provide' dan 'offer' tidak menggunakan -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The maritime history of Indonesia ___ that the archipelago was once a center of global trade and cultural exchange.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'history' tunggal, menggunakan 'proves' (Simple Present) untuk menyatakan fakta yang tetap berlaku.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mental health awareness campaigns ___ a more empathetic and understanding society in recent years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'campaigns' jamak, menggunakan Present Continuous ('are creating') untuk proses yang sedang berlangsung.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The ancient manuscripts ___ by historians are often written in ancient Javanese or Sanskrit.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced Adjective Clause pasif. 'Analyzed' menjelaskan subjek 'manuscripts'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Copyright laws ___ that creators have the exclusive right to control the distribution of their works.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'laws' jamak, maka 'ensure' tidak menggunakan -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The restoration of old literature ___ as a priority by the national library to preserve cultural heritage.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'restoration' tunggal. Passive Continuous ('is being regarded') digunakan untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Cybersecurity software ___ the integrity of financial systems against increasingly sophisticated digital attacks.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'must' diikuti bare infinitive 'protect'. Kalimat bermakna aktif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The global recession <u>have</u> caused a significant decline in international trade and economic growth.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'global recession' adalah tunggal, sehingga harus menggunakan 'has', bukan 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many inland tribes <u>maintains</u> their traditional lifestyles despite the rapid modernization of the country.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Many inland tribes' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'maintain', bukan 'maintains'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The ancient manuscripts <u>was</u> discovered by a team of archeologists in a hidden cave last month.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'ancient manuscripts' adalah jamak, sehingga to-be lampau yang tepat adalah 'were'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Diabetes patients <u>must to monitor</u> their blood glucose levels regularly to avoid serious health complications.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal verb 'must', tidak boleh menggunakan 'to'. Seharusnya 'must monitor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>develop</u> of new cybersecurity software is essential for protecting national data from digital attacks.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan kata benda (noun) sebagai subjek. Seharusnya 'development', bukan kata kerja 'develop'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>The recession global</u> <u>is affecting</u> <u>the livelihoods</u> of <u>millions of people</u> worldwide <u>significantly</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam bahasa Inggris, kata sifat diletakkan sebelum kata benda. Seharusnya 'The global recession'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Traditional customary laws</u> <u>are</u> often <u>use</u> to resolve <u>conflicts within the community</u> <u>peacefully</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif membutuhkan 'are + V3'. Seharusnya 'are often used'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Ancient manuscripts</u> <u>provide</u> <u>an insights</u> into <u>the historical struggles</u> of the <u>Nusantara people</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'insights' adalah jamak, sehingga tidak boleh menggunakan artikel 'an'. Seharusnya 'provide insights'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Inland people</u> <u>living</u> in <u>remote areas</u> <u>often faces</u> <u>serious challenges</u> during the pandemic.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Inland people' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja seharusnya 'face', bukan 'faces'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>The ocean biodiversity</u> <u>has been</u> <u>threatened by</u> <u>pollution and overfishing</u> <u>for years</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa benda yang lebih tepat adalah 'Ocean biodiversity' atau 'The biodiversity of the ocean'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Cybersecurity software</u> <u>must being</u> <u>updated regularly</u> to <u>protect the system</u> from <u>new threats</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal 'must' dalam bentuk pasif, harus menggunakan 'be'. Seharusnya 'must be'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Patriotism</u> <u>requires that</u> <u>every citizen</u> <u>contributes</u> to <u>the welfare of the nation</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'requires that' (Subjunctive), kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'contribute'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>The development of mathematics</u> <u>is essential</u> for <u>the progress</u> of <u>engineering and robotical</u> science.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata sifat yang tepat adalah 'robotic', bukan 'robotical'. Seharusnya 'engineering and robotic science'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Islamic law principles</u> <u>is</u> often <u>discussed</u> in <u>the context of</u> <u>modern legal reform</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'principles' adalah jamak, sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Moral decay</u> <u>can lead</u> to <u>social instability</u> and <u>the collapse of</u> <u>traditional family</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan artikel atau penentu sebelum kata benda tunggal. Seharusnya 'the traditional family structure' atau 'traditional families'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The rapid development of artificial intelligence ___ the way modern businesses analyze consumer behavior in real-time.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Present Perfect Tense ('has + V3') untuk menunjukkan aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan dampaknya masih terasa hingga sekarang. Subjek 'development' adalah tunggal, sehingga menggunakan 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Data scientists often utilize machine learning algorithms ___ complex patterns within massive datasets.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penggunaan 'to-infinitive' (to identify and extract) di sini berfungsi untuk menunjukkan tujuan (purpose) dari tindakan para ilmuwan data.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In a globalized economy, a company's success ___ on its ability to adapt to fluctuating market demands.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'success' adalah kata benda tunggal (uncountable), sehingga kata kerja 'depend' harus mendapatkan akhiran -s ('depends').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The communication department requires that every spokesperson ___ a specialized training session before addressing the media.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'requires that'. Kata kerja setelah subjek (spokesperson) harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: During the peak of the pandemic, many educational institutions ___ to online learning platforms to ensure academic continuity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menceritakan peristiwa di masa lampau ('During the peak of the pandemic'), sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense ('shifted').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Effective dakwah activities should emphasize compassion and empathy ___ to foster a more inclusive religious community.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'in order' biasanya diikuti oleh 'to-infinitive'. Di sini, 'in order to foster' menunjukkan tujuan dari kegiatan dakwah tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Voluntary Counseling and Testing (VCT) services ___ essential for the early detection and management of chronic viral infections.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'services' adalah jamak, sehingga memerlukan to-be 'are'. Bentuk pasif 'are considered' berarti 'dianggap'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Regularly attending a gym and performing strength training ___ the metabolic rate significantly even during rest.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek kalimat adalah gerund phrase ('Regularly attending... and performing...'). Gerund sebagai subjek selalu dianggap tunggal, sehingga kata kerja menggunakan akhiran -s ('increases').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Guidance and counseling programs in high schools ___ to help students navigate their academic and career paths effectively.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'programs' jamak, sehingga menggunakan 'are'. Bentuk pasif 'are designed' menunjukkan tujuan pembuatan program tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Marathon running requires not only physical endurance ___ mental resilience to finish the race.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur paralel 'not only... but also' digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua hal yang setara (physical endurance dan mental resilience).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many tech startups fail in their first year ___ they lack a sustainable business model and sufficient funding.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'because' digunakan untuk menghubungkan klausa alasan (subjek + predikat) di belakangnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The study of biological diversity provides crucial insights into ___ ecosystems respond to climate change over time.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'how' (bagaimana) digunakan untuk menunjukkan cara atau mekanisme ekosistem merespons perubahan iklim.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Financial economists suggest that the interest rate ___ adjusted to control the surging inflation in the upcoming quarter.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Sama seperti nomor 1199, ini adalah Subjunctive Mood setelah kata 'suggest that'. Kata kerja bantu yang digunakan adalah 'be' (bentuk dasar).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Professional counselors must maintain confidentiality ___ they can build trust with their clients.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'So that' menunjukkan tujuan atau hasil agar para konselor dapat membangun kepercayaan dengan klien mereka.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the new software update was released, the development team ___ for six consecutive months.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Continuous Tense ('had been working') digunakan untuk menunjukkan aksi yang berlangsung terus-menerus sebelum aksi lain terjadi di masa lampau ('was released').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The use of big data analytics allows retailers to predict customer preferences ___ accuracy than ever before.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Perbandingan (comparative) menggunakan 'greater' yang diikuti oleh 'than'. Preposisi 'with' diperlukan untuk membentuk frasa keterangan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the marketing team ___ the market trends more accurately, the product launch would have been more successful.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect ('had analyzed') karena klausa utama menggunakan 'would have been'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Individuals who exercise regularly often experience a boost in their immune system ___ they are less likely to fall ill.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'And as a result' digunakan untuk menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat (konsekuensi positif dari olahraga).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The government announced that the pandemic restrictions ___ gradually lifted starting from the following month.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Karena kalimat utama menggunakan past tense ('announced'), maka modal 'will' berubah menjadi 'would' untuk menunjukkan rencana di masa depan dari perspektif masa lalu.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A successful business negotiator must possess both excellent communication skills ___ a deep understanding of psychology.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan korelasi yang tepat untuk 'both' adalah 'and'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ by the potential for profit, many entrepreneurs are now investing heavily in green technology startups.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Reduced Adjective Clause dalam bentuk pasif. 'Motivated' adalah kependekan dari 'Because they are motivated'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the manager ___ the employees were aware of the massive data breach that occurred over the weekend.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan korelasi yang tepat untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The speaker's dakwah was so inspiring ___ the audience remained silent and attentive for the entire two-hour session.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan hasil atau konsekuensi yang ekstrem.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In data science, clean data is essential ___ accurate models cannot be built without it.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'since' di sini berarti 'karena' (because), memberikan alasan mengapa data yang bersih sangat penting.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The guidance counselor provided several strategies ___ students manage their stress during final examinations.
