Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: To-infinitive ('to help') digunakan untuk menunjukkan tujuan dari pemberian strategi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Marathon runners often consume energy gels during the race ___ maintain their stamina levels throughout the 42-kilometer course.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'in order to' diikuti bare infinitive 'maintain' untuk menyatakan tujuan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The biological diversity in tropical rainforests ___ by scientists for many decades to understand its ecological importance.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'biological diversity' tunggal. Penanda waktu 'for many decades' menunjukkan Present Perfect Passive ('has been studied').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Economic analysts predict that the inflation rate ___ gradually over the next few months as supply chains stabilize.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Prediksi masa depan menggunakan Future Tense ('will decrease').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The patient decided to go for a VCT test ___ he suspected he might have been exposed to the virus.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'because' menghubungkan tindakan dengan alasan (kecurigaan pasien).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern software development relies heavily on collaboration tools ___ developers can work together regardless of their physical location.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'So that' menunjukkan tujuan dari penggunaan alat kolaborasi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The athlete ___ training for the marathon since early morning before the storm suddenly began.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Continuous ('had been training') karena aksi tersebut berlangsung sebelum kejadian lampau lainnya ('began').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Business ethics ___ by most corporations as a way to maintain a positive public image and long-term sustainability.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Meskipun 'ethics' berakhiran -s, kata ini dianggap tunggal (singular uncountable), namun dalam konteks umum korporasi, 'business ethics' sering dipasangkan dengan 'are' jika merujuk pada prinsip-prinsip jamak. Namun dalam TOEFL standar, kata yang berakhiran -ics (seperti ethics, physics) dianggap tunggal. Jawaban: 'Is promoted'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Data science helps businesses identify market trends ___ they can stay competitive in a rapidly changing world.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: 'So that' menyatakan tujuan atau hasil yang diinginkan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The pandemic ___ the vulnerability of the global healthcare system and the need for better preparedness.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Perfect ('has highlighted') menunjukkan peristiwa masa lalu yang hasilnya masih relevan saat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Information technology ___ an integral part of modern education, providing students with access to vast resources.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Perfect ('has become') menunjukkan proses perubahan yang sudah selesai dan dampaknya terasa sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The athlete <u>run</u> ten kilometers around the park every single morning to prepare for the marathon.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'athlete' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present (rutinitas 'every morning') harus menggunakan akhiran -s ('runs').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The company <u>announcing</u> its plans to expand into international markets during the board meeting yesterday.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'yesterday' menunjukkan Simple Past Tense, sehingga kata kerja yang tepat adalah 'announced'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Data scientists <u>collects</u> a large amount of raw information from various sources to train their models.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Data scientists' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja 'collect' tidak boleh menggunakan akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The counselor <u>help</u> the students to identify their strengths and weaknesses during the session.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'counselor' tunggal, membutuhkan kata kerja Simple Present berakhiran -s ('helps').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern software <u>rely</u> heavily on cloud technology to provide users with seamless data synchronization.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Software di sini dianggap sebagai subjek tunggal (uncountable/general category), sehingga kata kerjanya adalah 'relies'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Athletes</u> who <u>trains</u> at the <u>gym</u> regularly <u>usually</u> see <u>better</u> results.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Athletes' jamak, maka kata kerja 'train' tidak boleh menggunakan akhiran -s (should be 'train').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>business</u> manager <u>was</u> <u>very</u> <u>happy</u> with the <u>results financial</u> of the quarter.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam bahasa Inggris, kata sifat diletakkan sebelum kata benda. Seharusnya 'financial results', bukan 'results financial'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Many</u> <u>economists</u> <u>believes</u> that <u>inflation</u> will <u>continue</u> to rise in the future.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'economists' jamak, maka kata kerja 'believe' tidak boleh menggunakan akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>software</u> <u>was</u> <u>designed</u> to <u>protects</u> the <u>user's personal data</u> from hackers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'to' dalam to-infinitive, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'to protect', bukan 'to protects'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Counselors</u> <u>are</u> <u>professional</u> who <u>provide</u> <u>guidance</u> to people in need.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Counselors' jamak, maka kata benda predikatnya juga harus jamak. Seharusnya 'professionals'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>pandemic</u> <u>highlighted</u> the <u>important</u> of <u>digital communication</u> in <u>business</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata benda (noun) 'importance' setelah artikel 'the', bukan kata sifat 'important'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The human immune system ___ to recognize and neutralize foreign pathogens through a complex network of cells and proteins.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Passive Voice dalam Simple Present Tense ('is designed') untuk menyatakan fakta atau fungsi biologis yang tetap. Subjek 'immune system' adalah tunggal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Fictional characters with superhuman strength ___ by comic book writers to symbolize the peak of human potential.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'characters' adalah jamak, sehingga membutuhkan auxiliary 'are'. Bentuk pasif ('are created') digunakan karena karakter tersebut 'diciptakan'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the soil scientists finished the molecular analysis, they ___ several new types of minerals in the volcanic sample.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Past Perfect Tense ('had identified'). Tense ini digunakan untuk menyatakan aksi yang telah selesai sebelum aksi lain di masa lampau (finished) terjadi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Crossbreeding between different plant species ___ to develop more resilient crops that can withstand extreme weather conditions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'can' harus diikuti oleh bare infinitive (help). Adverb 'effectively' diletakkan di antara modal dan kata kerja utama.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Inbreeding within a small population often ___ the risk of genetic disorders due to the lack of genetic diversity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Inbreeding' adalah gerund yang berfungsi sebagai kata benda tunggal, sehingga kata kerja membutuhkan akhiran -s ('increases').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern biological research into human sexuality ___ that both genetics and environment play a role in identity formation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'research' adalah tunggal/uncountable. Present Perfect ('has shown') digunakan untuk merujuk pada temuan penelitian yang masih berlaku hingga sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Surgeons must ensure that the operating theater ___ completely sterile before any surgical procedure begins.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata 'must ensure that'. Kata kerja bantu yang digunakan adalah 'be' (base form).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Molecules in a liquid state ___ more freely than those in a solid state, allowing the substance to flow.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Molecules' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Game developers often spend years ___ the physics engine to create more realistic character movements.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'spend + time + V-ing' digunakan untuk menunjukkan durasi melakukan sesuatu. 'Refining' adalah gerund yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A person with a superhuman immune system ___ to fight off diseases that would be fatal to most individuals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Conditional Sentence Type 2 (unreal situation) menggunakan 'would' untuk menunjukkan kemungkinan yang bersifat hipotesis.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Soil science, ___ often overlooked, is vital for understanding agricultural productivity and environmental health.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'although' digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua klausa kontras. Di sini, 'although it is often overlooked' dipendekkan menjadi 'although often overlooked'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The molecular structure of water ___ for its unique properties, such as high surface tension and boiling point.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'structure' adalah tunggal, sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: During the robotic surgery, the machine ___ more precise incisions than a human hand ever could.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat menceritakan peristiwa yang terjadi (Past Tense), sehingga menggunakan 'made'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Geneticists warn that constant inbreeding ___ to a significant decline in the health of a livestock population.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'can' harus diikuti oleh bare infinitive 'lead'. Kalimat ini menyatakan kemungkinan masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Successful crossbreeding requires that the parent plants ___ closely related enough to produce viable offspring.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'requires that' menggunakan base form 'be'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The main character in the video game ___ of many unique skills that players can upgrade over time.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'character' tunggal, sehingga kata kerja Simple Present menggunakan akhiran -es.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Health professionals suggest that an individual ___ plenty of rest after undergoing a major surgical operation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'suggest that' menggunakan base form 'take' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Biological diversity ___ by climate change, habitat loss, and pollution for several decades now.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'diversity' tunggal. Penanda 'for several decades' menunjukkan Present Perfect Passive.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Molecules that move at high speeds ___ a higher temperature within a gaseous substance.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Molecules' jamak, kata kerja 'indicate' tidak menggunakan -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ human sexuality influenced by biology, but it is also shaped by socio-cultural factors.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Inversion setelah 'Not only'. Subjek 'sexuality' tunggal, maka menggunakan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Soil science studies show that the nutrient content of soil ___ depending on the local environmental conditions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'content' tunggal, kata kerja 'vary' menjadi 'varies' (Simple Present).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The fictional world of the game ___ with mythical creatures that challenge the player's tactical skills.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'world' tunggal, menggunakan Passive Voice 'is filled'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the end of the next decade, medical technology ___ enough to create truly superhuman physical enhancements.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Future Perfect Tense ('will have + V3') digunakan untuk aksi yang akan selesai pada titik waktu tertentu di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Inbreeding depression is a term ___ to describe the reduced biological fitness in a given population.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced Adjective Clause (kependekan dari 'which is used'). 'Used' (V3) menjelaskan kata benda 'term'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Biological crossbreeding ___ in agriculture to combine the best traits of two different parental lineages.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'crossbreeding' tunggal. Bentuk pasif Simple Present ('is employed') menunjukkan praktik umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Molecular biology ___ rapidly since the discovery of the double-helix structure of DNA.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Molecular biology' tunggal. Penanda 'since' menunjukkan Present Perfect Continuous.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The superhuman characters in the movie ___ to be indestructible, but they each have a hidden weakness.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'characters' jamak, kata kerja 'appear' tidak menggunakan akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Health warnings about the side effects of certain surgeries ___ clearly in the medical consent forms.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'warnings' jamak. Bentuk pasif Simple Present 'are stated' (dinyatakan) tepat di sini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Soil science helps farmers understand how ___ fertilizers to improve the quality of their harvest.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'how + to-infinitive' digunakan untuk menunjukkan cara melakukan sesuatu.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Fictional characters often exhibit traits that ___ impossible in the real biological world.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'that' merujuk pada 'traits' (jamak), sehingga membutuhkan to-be 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Complex surgeries require that the surgical team ___ for several hours without any interruption.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'require that' menggunakan base form 'work'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The molecular weight of a substance ___ its physical properties, such as its boiling and melting points.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'weight' tunggal, kata kerja Simple Present menggunakan akhiran -s ('affects').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Game character customization ___ players to create unique avatars that reflect their personal preferences.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'customization' tunggal, kata kerja 'allow' menjadi 'allows'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Immunity to certain viral infections ___ through natural exposure or vaccinations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Immunity' tunggal. Bentuk pasif Simple Present ('is acquired') menunjukkan proses pemerolehan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Inbreeding within endangered species ___ to the eventual extinction of the entire population.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'can' diikuti bare infinitive 'contribute'. Kalimat ini menyatakan kemungkinan biologis.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the humanitarian aid arrived at the site of the natural disaster, the local volunteers ___ most of the survivors from the debris.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Past Perfect Tense ('had + V3') karena terdapat penanda waktu 'By the time + simple past' yang menunjukkan suatu aksi telah selesai dilakukan sebelum aksi lain terjadi di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The economic tragedy following the market crash ___ thousands of small business owners to file for bankruptcy within a few months.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menceritakan peristiwa sejarah/fakta masa lampau ('following the market crash'), sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense ('forced').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Astronomers believe that black holes, ___ are regions of space with gravitational pulls so strong that nothing can escape, play a key role in galaxy formation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'which' digunakan untuk memberikan informasi tambahan tentang benda (black holes) dalam non-restrictive relative clause.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Public policy experts suggest that the government ___ more funds to the development of renewable energy sources in rural areas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'suggest that'. Kata kerja setelah subjek harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form) tanpa tambahan -s/-es.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many traditional communities uphold unwritten norms ___ a harmonious relationship between humans and the natural environment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: To-infinitive ('to ensure') digunakan untuk menunjukkan tujuan atau maksud dari tindakan komunitas tersebut dalam mempertahankan norma.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The concept of divinity ___ differently across various religious and philosophical traditions throughout human history.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'concept' adalah tunggal. Kalimat ini menggunakan Present Perfect Passive Voice untuk menunjukkan tindakan yang telah berlangsung lama dan hasilnya masih relevan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ASEAN member states recently signed an agreement ___ economic cooperation and reduce trade barriers within the region.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: To-infinitive ('to strengthen') menunjukkan tujuan dari penandatanganan perjanjian tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Marine researchers discovered that deep-sea ecosystems ___ to climate change much faster than previously anticipated.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Karena klausa utama menggunakan 'discovered' (past), maka klausa pendukung menggunakan Past Continuous ('were responding') untuk menunjukkan proses yang sedang terjadi saat penemuan itu dilakukan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sustainable forestry practices require that logging companies ___ new trees for every one they cut down during the operation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'require that' menggunakan base form 'plant'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Agriculture in tidal lands, or 'pertambakan', ___ a sophisticated understanding of water salinity and soil acidity levels.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Agriculture' dianggap tunggal/uncountable, sehingga kata kerja Simple Present menggunakan akhiran -s ('necessitates').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the space mission ___ better shielding, the astronauts would not have been exposed to high levels of cosmic radiation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect ('had possessed') karena klausa utama menggunakan 'would not have been'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Atheism is defined not merely as a lack of belief in deities ___ a philosophical position that relies on evidence and reason.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur korelasi 'not merely... but as' digunakan untuk memberikan definisi yang lebih akurat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The plantation sector ___ a major source of revenue for many developing nations in Southeast Asia for several decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'sector' tunggal. Penanda 'for several decades' menunjukkan Present Perfect ('has been').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Economists argue that a global recession ___ by a combination of high inflation and supply chain disruptions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif modal 'can be triggered' (dapat dipicu oleh) adalah pilihan yang tepat secara gramatikal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The unwritten norm of reciprocity suggests that individuals ___ the favors they receive from others within the community.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'suggests that' menggunakan base form 'return'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Space exploration costs have become so high ___ many nations are opting for collaborative missions rather than solo ventures.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' menunjukkan konsekuensi dari tingginya biaya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Fisheries and pond farming ___ significantly to the protein intake of populations living in coastal areas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Fisheries and pond farming' adalah jamak, maka kata kerjanya adalah 'contribute'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not until the satellite reached the outer edges of the solar system ___ it begin transmitting high-resolution data.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Inversion setelah 'Not until'. Karena konteksnya sejarah misi yang sudah terjadi, menggunakan 'did'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The tragedy of the commons occurs when individuals ___ communal resources for their own benefit without regard for the collective good.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'individuals' jamak, kata kerja 'overexploit' dalam Simple Present tidak menggunakan -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: National forestry laws often ___ to protect endangered species from illegal logging and habitat destruction.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'laws' jamak, maka kata kerja 'aim' tidak menggunakan akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ASEAN was established in 1967 ___ regional stability and promote economic growth among its founding members.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: To-infinitive ('to maintain') menunjukkan tujuan pendirian organisasi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The divinity of the sun was a central belief in many ancient civilizations, ___ it was seen as the source of all life.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'for' di sini bermakna 'karena', memberikan alasan mengapa matahari dipuja.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Recent statistics show that the productivity of rubber plantations ___ by nearly twenty percent over the last year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'productivity' tunggal, menggunakan Present Perfect ('has decreased') karena ada penanda 'over the last year'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The economic impact of natural disasters ___ by governments to allocate resources for future mitigation efforts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal passive 'must be assessed' (harus dinilai) adalah pilihan yang benar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Public policies concerning the ocean ___ on sustainable fishing and the protection of marine biodiversity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'policies' jamak, maka kata kerja 'focus' tidak menggunakan -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ by the vastness of the galaxy, early astronomers developed various tools to map the night sky.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced Adjective Clause pasif. 'Intrigued' adalah kependekan dari 'Because they were intrigued'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Atheists often argue that morality ___ necessarily tied to religious beliefs or divine commands.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'morality' tunggal, menggunakan to-be 'is not' untuk menyatakan fakta umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The ASEAN Secretariat, ___ in Jakarta, coordinates the various activities and initiatives of the member states.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced Adjective Clause pasif. 'Located' berarti 'yang berlokasi di'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Soil fertility in agricultural lands ___ by the continuous rotation of different crops.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif modal 'can be maintained' (dapat dipertahankan) adalah struktur yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The development of palm oil plantations ___ a subject of intense international debate regarding deforestation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'development' tunggal, menggunakan Present Perfect 'has become'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Ancient manuscripts found in old temple libraries ___ valuable insights into the history of early Indonesian kingdoms.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'manuscripts' jamak, maka kata kerja 'provide' tidak menggunakan -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Space agencies ___ more powerful telescopes to detect distant planets orbiting other stars in the galaxy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'agencies' jamak, menggunakan Present Continuous 'are building' untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The tragedy of the forest fires ___ by both natural factors and human activities such as land clearing.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'tragedy' tunggal. Bentuk pasif Simple Past 'was caused' adalah yang paling tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Customary law requires that every member of the community ___ the collective decisions made by the elders.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'requires that' menggunakan base form 'respect'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Marine biodiversity in the coral triangle is so high ___ it attracts researchers and divers from all over the world.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' menunjukkan konsekuensi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The ASEAN leaders <u>recently met</u> in Jakarta to discuss economic policies that will benefit the region.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks kalimat adalah peristiwa yang sudah terjadi, maka 'met recently' (V2) adalah bentuk yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A space mission <u>requiring</u> a high degree of precision to ensure the safety of the crew.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'mission' tunggal membutuhkan kata kerja utama dalam Simple Present, yaitu 'requires'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The economic tragedy <u>were</u> caused by a sudden drop in global oil prices last year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'tragedy' adalah tunggal, sehingga to-be lampau yang tepat adalah 'was'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Customary laws <u>provides</u> a framework for resolving conflicts within the community peacefully.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'laws' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja Simple Present seharusnya 'provide', bukan 'provides'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The forest <u>biodiversity</u> has decreasing significantly due to illegal logging and agricultural expansion.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Present Perfect aktif membutuhkan 'has + V3'. Seharusnya 'has decreased'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Medical researchers have found that many individuals infected with HIV ___ any visible symptoms for several years after the initial exposure.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menyatakan fakta medis umum (Simple Present Tense). Subjek 'many individuals' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja bantu negatif yang tepat adalah 'do not experience'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The risk of transmitting sexually transmitted infections (STIs) ___ significantly if barrier protection is not used consistently.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek kalimat adalah 'The risk' (tunggal), maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense harus menggunakan akhiran -s ('increases').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Recent sociological studies suggest that teenagers who fall into the trap of drug abuse ___ social and psychological challenges.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'teenagers' adalah jamak. Klausa utama membutuhkan kata kerja utama dalam bentuk dasar untuk subjek jamak, yaitu 'face'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Pornography addiction often alters the brain's reward system, ___ it difficult for individuals to form healthy emotional connections.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Present Participle Phrase ('making') untuk menunjukkan hasil atau konsekuensi dari klausa sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The prevalence of sexual activity among school-aged children has prompted educators ___ more comprehensive sexual health programs.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'prompt' diikuti oleh 'object + to-infinitive'. Frasa 'to develop and implement' memenuhi syarat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Child grooming, a predatory behavior used to build a relationship with a child, ___ as a severe violation of child protection laws.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Child grooming' adalah tunggal. Kalimat pasif dalam Simple Present Tense ('is recognized') digunakan untuk menyatakan status hukum saat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the authorities identified the child trafficking syndicate, dozens of victims ___ to foreign countries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Soal ini menguji Past Perfect Passive Tense ('had been sold'). Digunakan karena aksi penjualan terjadi sebelum aksi identifikasi (identified) di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Pedophiles often use digital platforms to target vulnerable children ___ to gain their trust through emotional manipulation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'in order' biasanya diikuti oleh 'to-infinitive'. Di sini, 'in order to gain' menunjukkan tujuan jahat dari pelaku.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Teenage parents face significant risks, including higher rates of poverty ___ medical complications during pregnancy and childbirth.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'and' digunakan untuk menggabungkan dua risiko yang setara (poverty dan medical complications).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the government ___ stricter monitoring of nightlife districts, the rate of drug-related crimes might have decreased.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect ('had enforced') karena klausa utama menggunakan 'might have decreased'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The illegal trade of infants ___ a growing concern for international human rights organizations in recent years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'trade' tunggal. Penanda 'in recent years' menunjukkan Present Perfect Tense ('has become').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Educators recommend that every student ___ about the dangers of free association and substance abuse at an early age.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah kata kerja 'recommend that'. Bentuk pasif yang digunakan adalah 'be + V3' (be taught).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The nightlife industry in metropolitan areas often ___ with issues related to public health and social order.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'industry' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense harus menggunakan akhiran -s ('collides').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A person who is addicted to adult content ___ experience significant psychological distress when attempting to stop the behavior.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'may' digunakan untuk menunjukkan kemungkinan perilaku atau reaksi psikologis.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The grooming process ___ months of grooming before the actual abuse occurs, making it difficult for parents to detect.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'process' tunggal, membutuhkan kata kerja berakhiran -s ('involves').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: HIV/AIDS awareness campaigns ___ to reduce the stigma associated with the disease and encourage testing.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'campaigns' jamak, sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'are'. Bentuk pasif 'are designed' berarti 'dirancang'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sexual crimes against children ___ extremely high penalties in many modern legal systems to deter potential offenders.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'crimes' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s ('carry').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The risk of infant mortality is significantly higher ___ teenage mothers compared to those in their twenties.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'among' (di antara) digunakan untuk merujuk pada kelompok orang (teenage mothers).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not until the police raided the illegal nightclub ___ evidence of widespread drug distribution among minors.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Inversion setelah frasa negatif 'Not until'. Membutuhkan 'did + subject + V1' karena menceritakan peristiwa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many adolescents ___ to peer pressure when they first experiment with illegal substances.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'adolescents' jamak, maka kata kerjanya adalah 'succumb' (menyerah pada).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The victims of child trafficking are often ___ through false promises of employment or education.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif (are + V3). 'Lured' (dipikat/dijebak) adalah past participle yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the end of the year, the clinic ___ over five hundred individuals for STIs through its mobile testing unit.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Future Perfect Tense ('will have + V3') digunakan untuk aksi yang akan selesai pada akhir tahun nanti.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The psychological impact of grooming can be devastating, ___ long-term effects on the child's mental health.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Participle Phrase ('causing') menunjukkan hasil atau dampak dari klausa sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Laws against child abuse require that any suspicious behavior ___ to the authorities immediately.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood pasif setelah 'require that' menggunakan 'be + V3'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the school administration ___ the parents were aware of the sexual activity occurring in the student dormitory.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan korelasi yang tepat untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The addict ___ struggling with the urge to consume adult content for several months before seeking help.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Continuous ('had been') menunjukkan durasi perjuangan sebelum titik waktu lampau lainnya (seeking help).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Free association without proper parental guidance ___ to dangerous social behaviors among teenagers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'can' diikuti bare infinitive 'lead'. Menunjukkan kemungkinan logis.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sexually transmitted infections are ___ through unprotected physical contact with an infected partner.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif 'are spread' (menyebar) diikuti oleh adverb 'commonly' untuk menerangkan frekuensi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The development of drug resistance in HIV patients ___ that they adhere strictly to their medication schedule.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'development' tunggal, membutuhkan kata kerja Simple Present berakhiran -s ('requires').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Teenage pregnancy often results in the mother dropping out of school, ___ her future career opportunities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Participle Phrase ('limiting') menunjukkan konsekuensi dari putus sekolah.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The groomer's strategy was so sophisticated ___ the child did not realize they were being manipulated.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' (begitu canggih sehingga...).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Child trafficking remains a global tragedy, ___ millions of children are exploited for labor and sexual purposes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative adverb 'where' (di mana) merujuk pada situasi tragedi tersebut secara spasial/kontekstual.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ by the addictive nature of digital content, some children spend hours viewing inappropriate material online.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Reduced Adjective Clause pasif. 'Influenced' adalah kependekan dari 'As they are influenced'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Drug abuse among teenagers ___ into adulthood if not addressed through early intervention programs.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'abuse' tunggal. Kata kerja 'persist' mendapatkan akhiran -s ('persists').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many pedophiles operate under aliases to conceal their ___ during online interactions with potential victims.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan noun phrase (adjective + noun). 'True identities' (identitas asli) adalah pilihan yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Teenage mothers <u>has</u> higher risks of developing complications such as anemia and preeclampsia during their pregnancy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Teenage mothers' adalah jamak, sehingga harus menggunakan 'have', bukan 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The trafficking of children <u>are</u> considered one of the most heinous crimes against humanity in the modern era.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The trafficking' (tunggal), maka to-be yang tepat adalah 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Pedophiles <u>targetting</u> vulnerable children through social media platforms by using emotional manipulation and false identities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat membutuhkan kata kerja utama (verb), bukan present participle tanpa auxiliary. 'Target' adalah bentuk yang benar untuk subjek jamak.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: HIV infections can <u>be prevent</u> by using barrier protection and adhering to safe practices during physical contact.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur modal pasif membutuhkan 'be + V3'. Seharusnya 'be prevented'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Drug addicts <u>struggles</u> to overcome their dependency on illegal substances due to the chemical changes in their brain.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Drug addicts' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya tidak boleh menggunakan akhiran -s ('struggle').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>prevalence</u> of HIV <u>among</u> teenagers <u>is rising</u> rapidly <u>whenever</u> <u>education are</u> not provided to the youth.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'education' adalah kata benda tunggal (uncountable), sehingga kata kerja bantunya seharusnya 'is', bukan 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Grooming <u>behavior</u> often <u>begins with</u> <u>emotionally</u> manipulation to isolate the child <u>from</u> their <u>supportive family</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'emotionally' adalah kata keterangan (adverb). Seharusnya digunakan kata sifat 'emotional' untuk menerangkan kata benda 'manipulation'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Many pedophiles</u> <u>uses</u> digital <u>platforms</u> to <u>target</u> children who are often left <u>unsupervised</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Many pedophiles' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya seharusnya 'use', bukan 'uses'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Child trafficking</u> syndicates <u>is</u> <u>operating</u> <u>secretly</u> to <u>avoid</u> detection by the police.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama kalimat adalah 'syndicates' (jamak), sehingga kata kerja bantu yang tepat adalah 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>risk of</u> teenage pregnancy <u>increases</u> when <u>comprehensive</u> sexual <u>education</u> <u>is not provided</u> by most schools.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks kalimat ini secara gramatikal benar, namun dalam pola soal ini, poin 'education' sering diuji sebagai subjek tunggal yang tidak dapat dihitung. Opsi 3 adalah pengecoh yang sering muncul dalam analisis data jurnal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Pornography addiction</u> <u>can having</u> a <u>destructive</u> <u>impact</u> on <u>healthy social relationships</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal 'can', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive). Seharusnya 'can have', bukan 'can having'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Adolescents</u> who <u>consume drugs</u> <u>often</u> <u>faces</u> <u>severe</u> legal and health consequences.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Adolescents' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense seharusnya 'face', bukan 'faces'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Nightlife districts</u> <u>is</u> often <u>associated</u> <u>with</u> <u>higher rates</u> of crime.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'districts' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja bantu yang tepat adalah 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Child crime</u> <u>prevention</u> <u>requires</u> that <u>every parent</u> <u>monitors</u> their child's digital interactions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah struktur Subjunctive 'requires that', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'monitor', bukan 'monitors'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>sale and purchase</u> <u>of infants</u> <u>is</u> a <u>violation</u> of <u>basic human right</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Istilah yang umum digunakan untuk hak asasi manusia adalah bentuk jamak, yaitu 'basic human rights'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Teenage mothers</u> <u>often</u> <u>finding</u> it <u>difficult</u> to <u>balance</u> parenting and academics.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan kata kerja utama (verb). Seharusnya 'often find', bukan bentuk present participle 'finding' tanpa to-be.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>HIV patients</u> <u>must</u> <u>taking</u> <u>antiretroviral</u> medication <u>consistently</u> to maintain health.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal 'must', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive). Seharusnya 'must take', bukan 'must taking'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Groomers</u> <u>use</u> <u>deception</u> to <u>manipulated</u> <u>children</u> into believing they are safe.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah 'to' dalam to-infinitive, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'to manipulate', bukan 'manipulated'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Free association</u> <u>without</u> <u>supervision</u> <u>can</u> <u>results</u> in unplanned pregnancies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal 'can', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'can result', bukan 'can results'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Chemical catalysts are substances that increase the rate of a reaction ___ permanently consumed in the process.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'without being' digunakan untuk menunjukkan bahwa subjek (katalis) tidak mengalami perubahan permanen meskipun berpartisipasi dalam reaksi kimia. Ini adalah bentuk gerund setelah preposisi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In the field of thermodynamics, heat is defined as energy that ___ between two systems due to a temperature difference.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'energy' adalah tunggal dan tidak dapat dihitung, sehingga membutuhkan kata kerja pasif tunggal 'is transferred' untuk menyatakan proses pemindahan energi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the economic recession ended in 2008, many developing nations ___ significant fiscal reforms to protect their currencies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Past Perfect Tense ('had + V3') karena menyatakan aksi yang telah selesai dilakukan sebelum titik waktu tertentu di masa lampau (ended).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Photosynthesis is the biological process by which green plants and some other organisms ___ light energy into chemical energy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'plants and some other organisms' adalah jamak, sehingga membutuhkan kata kerja bentuk dasar 'convert' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A cardiologist, who is a specialist in heart diseases, usually ___ a thorough examination before recommending a surgical procedure.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama kalimat adalah 'A cardiologist' (tunggal), maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense harus menggunakan akhiran -s (performs).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Public health initiatives in rural villages often focus on providing clean water ___ the spread of waterborne diseases.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: To-infinitive ('to prevent') digunakan untuk menunjukkan tujuan (purpose) dari dilakukannya inisiatif kesehatan masyarakat tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Livestock farmers find that crossbreeding different cattle breeds ___ to animals that are more resistant to tropical parasites.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'can' harus diikuti oleh bare infinitive (lead). Frasa ini menunjukkan kemungkinan logis dalam praktik peternakan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sociological research indicates that traditional norms in small communities ___ more resistant to change than those in metropolitan areas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'norms' adalah jamak, sehingga membutuhkan to-be jamak 'are' untuk menyatakan fakta atau kondisi umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The unique landscape of the volcanic island was formed over millions of years ___ multiple tectonic shifts and eruptions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'by and through' diletakkan sebelum agen atau penyebab dalam kalimat pasif untuk memberikan penekanan pada proses pembentukan bentang alam.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Geography students are required to master the use of GIS software ___ they can accurately map regional demographic changes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'so that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan maksud atau tujuan akhir dari penguasaan perangkat lunak tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The molecular structure of DNA ___ for containing the genetic instructions used in the development of all living organisms.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'structure' adalah tunggal, sehingga membutuhkan linking verb tunggal 'is' diikuti oleh adjective 'responsible'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the physicist ___ the experimental parameters more carefully, the anomaly in the data would have been detected earlier.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect ('had + V3') karena klausa utama menggunakan 'would have been detected'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Epidemiologists recommend that every person in the affected area ___ vaccinated to achieve collective immunity against the virus.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'recommend that'. Bentuk to-be yang digunakan harus dalam bentuk dasar 'be'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Agricultural economists argue that global food prices ___ by fluctuations in oil prices and international trade policies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'prices' jamak, kalimat membutuhkan Passive Voice ('are influenced') untuk menunjukkan dampak dari faktor eksternal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In many remote villages, the tradition of oral storytelling ___ as a primary method for passing down historical knowledge.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'tradition' adalah tunggal, sehingga dalam Simple Present Tense kata kerjanya harus berakhiran -s (serves).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ in the study of subatomic particles, but it also has practical applications in medical imaging technology.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Inversion digunakan setelah frasa negatif 'Not only'. Karena kalimat pasif dibutuhkan, polanya adalah 'is + subjek + V3'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The biodiversity of a coral reef ___ by the temperature and salinity levels of the surrounding ocean waters.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'biodiversity' adalah tunggal (uncountable). Kalimat pasif 'is determined' (ditentukan oleh) tepat untuk menyatakan fakta ilmiah.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Health specialists suggest that an individual ___ a balanced diet rich in micronutrients to maintain optimal organ function.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'suggest that' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar (maintain) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The tectonic plates that form the Earth's crust ___ at a rate of only a few centimeters per year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'plates' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (move).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sociology focuses on the systematic study of social groups, ___ how individuals interact within various institutional frameworks.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Participle ('analyzing') digunakan di sini sebagai penjelas aktivitas yang dilakukan oleh ilmu sosiologi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the geologist reached the summit of the mountain, the weather ___ significantly worse due to the approaching storm.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Tense ('had become') digunakan untuk menyatakan aksi yang sudah terjadi sebelum aksi lain (reached) di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Public health specialists emphasize that regular physical activity ___ the risk of developing chronic cardiovascular diseases.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'activity' adalah tunggal/uncountable, sehingga kata kerja membutuhkan akhiran -s (reduces).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern livestock production requires that animals ___ in environments that meet specific welfare and health standards.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood dalam bentuk pasif setelah 'requires that' menggunakan 'be + V3'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The discovery of a new species of bacteria ___ that the local soil ecosystem is much more complex than previously thought.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The discovery' (tunggal), maka kata kerja Simple Present harus berakhiran -s (indicates).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Geography is concerned with the distribution of physical features ___ the impact of human activities on the environment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'as well as' digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua hal yang setara yang menjadi fokus studi geografi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Organic chemistry deals with the study of carbon-based compounds, many of ___ are essential for the existence of life.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'which' digunakan untuk merujuk pada benda (carbon-based compounds) setelah preposisi 'of'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the economic analysts ___ the government officials expected such a rapid decline in the inflation rate last month.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan korelasi tetap untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The gravitational force between two objects ___ on their masses and the distance between their centers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'force' tunggal, membutuhkan kata kerja berakhiran -s (depends) dalam Simple Present Tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sustainable agriculture aims to produce food while ___ the natural resources and environmental quality for future generations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Gerund ('preserving') diletakkan setelah konjungsi 'while' untuk menunjukkan tindakan yang dilakukan secara bersamaan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The sosiological impact of urbanization ___ by researchers studying the change in community values over several decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'impact' tunggal. Penanda waktu 'over several decades' menunjukkan penggunaan Present Perfect Passive.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Molecules that are in a gas state ___ to move much more freely than those in a liquid or solid state.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Molecules' jamak, maka kata kerja 'tend' tidak menggunakan akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The bentang alam of the region was significantly altered ___ the constant flow of glacial water during the last ice age.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'by' digunakan untuk menunjukkan agen atau penyebab dalam kalimat pasif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Surgeons must ensure that the operating theater ___ completely sterile before beginning any sub-specialist procedure.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Sama seperti kasus lainnya, 'ensure that' memicu penggunaan Subjunctive Mood (be).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The productivity of the plantation ___ by the quality of the soil and the availability of consistent irrigation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'productivity' tunggal, kalimat pasif Simple Present 'is influenced' diletakkan dengan adverb 'primarily'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Geography studies have shown that global climate patterns ___ significantly over the last century due to human activities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'patterns' jamak, penanda waktu 'over the last century' menunjukkan Present Perfect Tense ('have shifted').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A <u>cardiologist</u> <u>specialize</u> in <u>diagnosing</u> <u>heart</u> <u>conditions</u> through various medical tests and procedures.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'cardiologist' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja seharusnya menggunakan akhiran -s (specializes).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Public health</u> initiatives often focus on <u>provide</u> clean water to <u>prevent</u> the <u>spread</u> of <u>diseases</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'on', kata kerja harus diubah menjadi gerund. Seharusnya 'focus on providing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Livestock</u> <u>farmers</u> must <u>ensuring</u> that their <u>animals</u> <u>receive</u> proper nutrition every day.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal verb 'must', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'must ensure'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In <u>small</u> <u>villages</u>, the <u>elders</u> <u>is</u> respected for <u>their</u> knowledge of traditional laws.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'elders' adalah jamak, sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>volcanic</u> <u>landscape</u> <u>was</u> <u>forming</u> over <u>millions</u> of years through tectonic activity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat pasif dibutuhkan untuk menyatakan bentang alam 'terbentuk'. Seharusnya 'was formed'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In <u>chemical</u> labs, <u>reactions</u> often <u>is</u> faster when the <u>temperature</u> <u>increases</u> significantly during the experiment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'reactions' adalah jamak, sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In a physical system, <u>light</u> <u>travels</u> much <u>more faster</u> through a <u>vacuum</u> than <u>through</u> glass.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Double comparison tidak diperbolehkan. 'Faster' sudah merupakan bentuk komparatif, sehingga tidak membutuhkan kata 'more'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>global</u> <u>inflation</u> rate <u>have</u> <u>affected</u> many <u>developing</u> nations in Southeast Asia over the years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'rate' adalah tunggal, sehingga auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'has', bukan 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Biologists <u>believe</u> that <u>genetic</u> information <u>is</u> <u>stored</u> within the complex <u>DNA molecule</u> structures.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Istilah yang tepat untuk merujuk pada struktur jamak adalah 'DNA molecules' atau 'DNA molecular structures'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the power plant technicians arrived at the substation, the circuit breaker ___ more than three times due to a massive voltage surge.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Past Perfect Tense ('had + V3') karena menyatakan suatu aksi yang telah selesai dilakukan sebelum aksi lain terjadi di masa lampau (arrived).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Data scientists suggest that the algorithm ___ more efficient if the developers had used a more structured database architecture.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect (had used), sehingga klausa utama harus menggunakan 'would have + V3'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The structural integrity of the skyscraper depends on ___ the foundation was designed to withstand seismic activity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata keterangan tingkat (adverb of degree) 'how well' untuk menerangkan proses pendesainan pondasi dalam kalimat tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern urban planning requires that every new residential project ___ adequate green spaces and sustainable drainage systems.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'requires that'. Kata kerja setelah subjek harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The visual communication design student decided to use minimalist typography ___ convey a sense of modern elegance in the branding project.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'in order to' diikuti oleh bare infinitive (convey) digunakan untuk menunjukkan tujuan dari suatu tindakan kreatif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Political tolerance in democratic societies ___ as the willingness to allow the expression of diverse and opposing viewpoints.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Political tolerance' adalah tunggal (uncountable). Kalimat pasif dalam Simple Present Tense ('is defined') digunakan untuk menyatakan definisi umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The shift in social paradigms ___ significant changes in the way younger generations perceive career stability and work-life balance.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The shift' (tunggal), maka auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'has'. Present Perfect Tense digunakan untuk aksi yang berdampak hingga kini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Comparative literature scholars discovered that many classical Indonesian poems ___ by Persian and Arabic literary traditions during the 17th century.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'poems' adalah jamak. Karena menceritakan sejarah (abad ke-17), maka menggunakan Simple Past Passive ('were influenced').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Engineers are currently developing a new type of capacitor ___ energy more efficiently than traditional electrochemical batteries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative clause 'that can store' digunakan untuk memberikan informasi tentang benda (capacitor) dan kemampuannya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The software update released yesterday was so complex ___ it caused several compatibility issues with older operating systems.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menyatakan sebab dan akibat yang signifikan (sangat kompleks sehingga...).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Civil engineering projects often involve ___ environmental impact assessments before the actual construction phase begins.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'involve' biasanya diikuti oleh gerund (V-ing). 'Conducting' adalah bentuk yang tepat setelah involve.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ in the design of residential buildings, but it is also essential for creating functional public spaces.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Inversion setelah frasa negatif 'Not only'. Karena 'aesthetics' sebagai bidang ilmu dianggap tunggal, maka menggunakan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The integration of smart technology in city planning ___ to reduce traffic congestion and improve public safety.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The integration' adalah tunggal, sehingga dalam Simple Present Tense kata kerjanya harus menggunakan akhiran -s (aims).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Graphic designers must ensure that the color palette ___ with the client's brand identity across all digital platforms.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'ensure that'. Kata kerja setelah subjek harus dalam bentuk dasar (align) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The tolerance level of the electrical components ___ carefully by the quality control team during the manufacturing process.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The tolerance level' (tunggal). Kalimat pasif lampau 'was measured' digunakan untuk menyatakan aksi yang dilakukan tim QC.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sociology students are encouraged to conduct fieldwork ___ they can gain firsthand experience in observing community interactions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'so that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan maksud atau tujuan dari dilakukannya kerja lapangan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The political analyst indicated that the new legislation ___ the distribution of power between central and local governments.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Karena kalimat utama menggunakan past tense (indicated), maka untuk menyatakan masa depan dari sudut pandang masa lalu digunakan 'would + V1'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Literary analysis requires that the reader ___ the historical context in which the novel was originally written.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'requires that' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar (consider) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The efficiency of an electric motor ___ by the quality of its magnetic materials and the precision of its windings.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'efficiency' adalah tunggal. Kalimat pasif Simple Present 'is determined' (ditentukan oleh) tepat untuk menyatakan fakta teknik.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Information technology has evolved so rapidly over the last decade ___ many legacy systems are now considered obsolete.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adverb + that' (begitu cepat sehingga...) digunakan untuk menunjukkan konsekuensi dari evolusi teknologi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the lead architect ___ the project managers were satisfied with the initial site survey results.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan korelasi yang tepat untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The spatial layout of a city often reflects the socio-political values ___ by its planners and governing bodies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Reduced Adjective Clause dalam bentuk pasif. 'Held' merupakan kependekan dari 'which are held' (yang dipegang/dianut).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Digital illustration software allows artists ___ complex textures and lighting effects with a high degree of realism.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'allow' diikuti oleh 'object + to-infinitive'. Frasa 'to create' memenuhi aturan gramatikal ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Tolerance for ambiguity is a critical trait for designers who ___ with complex and poorly defined problems.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'must' diikuti oleh bare infinitive (deal) menunjukkan keharusan bagi desainer dalam menghadapi masalah.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern engineering ethics ___ that every professional takes responsibility for the safety and welfare of the general public.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'ethics' sebagai bidang ilmu atau prinsip kolektif dalam konteks ini dianggap jamak (many ethics), namun secara standar TOEFL 'ethics' berakhiran -s tunggal. Di sini 'demand' tanpa -s digunakan jika merujuk pada prinsip-prinsip jamak.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Social justice movements often ___ to address the systemic inequalities that persist in modern political systems.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'movements' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (strive).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The development of international relations ___ by the ability of nations to find common ground through diplomatic negotiations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'development' adalah tunggal. Kalimat pasif 'is facilitated' (difasilitasi oleh) tepat untuk menyatakan proses hubungan internasional.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the end of the semester, the students in the literature class ___ five major novels from the Romantic era.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Future Perfect Tense ('will have + V3') digunakan untuk menyatakan aksi yang akan sudah selesai dilakukan pada waktu tertentu di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The power supply circuit ___ carefully to prevent any electrical interference with the sensitive measurement equipment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'circuit' tunggal. Kalimat pasif lampau 'was shielded' (dilindungi/disekat) tepat untuk menjelaskan tindakan pencegahan gangguan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Software developers often use version control systems ___ they can track changes and collaborate more effectively on large projects.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'so that' menunjukkan maksud atau tujuan dari penggunaan sistem kontrol versi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The restoration of historical buildings requires that the architects ___ traditional materials and construction techniques.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'requires that' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar (employ) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Urban planning in coastal cities ___ the rising sea levels caused by global climate change in the coming decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'must' diikuti bare infinitive (address) menunjukkan keharusan bagi perencanaan kota dalam menghadapi isu lingkungan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Visual identity design for a company ___ of more than just a logo but also typography and color schemes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'design' tunggal, maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense harus berakhiran -s (consists).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The principle of religious tolerance suggests that every citizen ___ the rights of others to practice their faith freely.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'suggests that' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar (respect) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Technical drawings for the bridge ___ by the lead engineer before they were sent to the construction site.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Passive ('had been + V3') digunakan karena proses peninjauan selesai dilakukan sebelum gambar dikirim (past tense) di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The civil engineer <u>deciding</u> to use reinforced concrete for the new bridge foundation last week.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'last week' menunjukkan Simple Past Tense, sehingga kata kerja yang tepat adalah 'decided'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern architects <u>incorporating</u> sustainable design principles into their residential projects to reduce energy consumption.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat membutuhkan kata kerja utama (verb). 'Incorporate' adalah bentuk yang benar untuk subjek jamak 'architects' dalam Simple Present.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The software update <u>were</u> released to fix several critical bugs in the data processing module.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'update' adalah tunggal, sehingga to-be lampau yang tepat adalah 'was'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Political leaders <u>must to promote</u> tolerance and understanding among diverse social groups in the country.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal 'must', harus diikuti bare infinitive tanpa 'to'. Seharusnya 'must promote'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The electrical system <u>have</u> failed due to a lack of regular maintenance and aging components.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'system' adalah tunggal, sehingga auxiliary verb yang tepat untuk Present Perfect adalah 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Every <u>architectural</u> <u>designs</u> for the building <u>was</u> <u>initially</u> <u>criticized</u> by many local residents last year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'every' harus diikuti oleh kata benda tunggal. Seharusnya 'architectural design' bukan 'designs'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>political</u> <u>analysts</u> <u>expects</u> that the election <u>results</u> will <u>be announced</u> by the end of today.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'analysts' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense seharusnya 'expect' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Recent <u>sociological</u> <u>studies</u> <u>indicates</u> that <u>urban</u> voters <u>prefer</u> leaders who promote social justice and equity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'studies' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja 'indicate' tidak boleh menggunakan akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: All electrical <u>circuits</u> <u>must being</u> <u>properly</u> grounded to <u>ensure</u> <u>the safety</u> of the laboratory staff.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal 'must' dalam bentuk pasif, harus menggunakan 'be'. Seharusnya 'must be grounded' bukan 'must being'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The software <u>developers</u> <u>is</u> <u>working</u> hard to <u>complete</u> <u>the project</u> before the official deadline next week.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'developers' adalah jamak, sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Several classical <u>poems</u> <u>was</u> <u>recently</u> translated into <u>modern</u> <u>languages</u> by a group of literary scholars.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'poems' adalah jamak, sehingga to-be lampau yang tepat adalah 'were', bukan 'was'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>visual</u> <u>identity</u> of the brand <u>were</u> <u>carefully</u> <u>designed</u> to appeal to a younger demographic segment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama 'identity' adalah tunggal, sehingga to-be lampau yang tepat adalah 'was', bukan 'were'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Civil <u>engineers</u> often <u>faces</u> <u>technical</u> challenges <u>when</u> <u>designing</u> infrastructure for dense urban environments.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'engineers' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja seharusnya 'face' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Urban <u>planners</u> <u>must</u> <u>to consider</u> the <u>impact</u> of <u>climate</u> change when developing future metropolitan projects.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal 'must', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar tanpa 'to'. Seharusnya 'must consider'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>restoration</u> of the historical <u>building</u> <u>are</u> <u>expensive</u> because <u>of the</u> high cost of traditional materials.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'restoration' adalah tunggal, sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'is', bukan 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sociologists argue that the importance of education ___ far beyond the acquisition of technical skills to include the development of moral character.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'the importance' adalah tunggal (uncountable), sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense harus menggunakan akhiran -s (extends).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many students at the traditional pesantren ___ classical Arabic texts for several hours every day to deepen their understanding of religious laws.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Present Perfect Continuous Tense ('have been studying') untuk menunjukkan aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung terus-menerus hingga sekarang. Subjek 'Many students' adalah jamak.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The cyber security team discovered that the hackers ___ into the database several weeks before the breach was finally detected.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Tense ('had + V3') digunakan untuk menyatakan aksi yang telah selesai dilakukan sebelum aksi lain terjadi di masa lampau (was detected).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the victim had reported the initial harassment, the tragic case of sexual violence ___ by the local authorities earlier this year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect (had reported), sehingga klausa utama harus menggunakan 'might/would have + V3'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Digital forensics experts often spend months ___ encrypted files to find evidence of financial fraud or online gambling.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'spend + time + V-ing' digunakan untuk menunjukkan durasi melakukan sesuatu. 'Analyzing and recovering' adalah gerund yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The government requires that every online lending platform ___ transparent information regarding interest rates and paylater terms.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'requires that'. Kata kerja setelah subjek (platform) harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The forensic pathologist performed an autopsy ___ the exact time and cause of death in the homicide investigation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: To-infinitive ('to determine') digunakan untuk menunjukkan tujuan (purpose) dari dilakukannya otopsi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Statistics indicate that many individuals who fall into the trap of online gambling ___ severe financial distress and social isolation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'many individuals' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (experience).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The prevalence of digital theft has prompted banks ___ more sophisticated multi-factor authentication systems for their customers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'prompt' diikuti oleh 'object + to-infinitive'. Frasa 'to implement and enforce' memenuhi aturan gramatikal ini.
