Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>The theft</u> of <u>digital assets</u> <u>has become</u> more common since <u>security system</u> are <u>often</u> vulnerable to hacking.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'security system' harus dalam bentuk jamak 'security systems' karena to-be yang digunakan adalah jamak 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the end of the next decade, researchers hope that cyber security education ___ a mandatory part of the national curriculum.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Future Perfect Tense ('will have + V3') digunakan untuk menyatakan aksi yang diharapkan akan sudah selesai dilakukan pada waktu tertentu di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The mutilated remains of the victim ___ by a local resident in a remote area near the highway yesterday morning.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'remains' adalah jamak. Karena menceritakan peristiwa lampau (yesterday), maka menggunakan Simple Past Passive ('were discovered').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Psychologists suggest that an individual struggling with suicidal thoughts ___ professional counseling and emotional support immediately.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'suggest that' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar (seek) tanpa akhiran -s meskipun subjeknya tunggal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The illegal distribution of explicit content ___ a serious legal offense that carries heavy penalties in many jurisdictions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The illegal distribution' (tunggal), maka to-be yang tepat adalah 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Pesantren often emphasize the importance of religious ethics ___ prepare students for the complexities of modern social life.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'in order to' diikuti oleh bare infinitive (prepare) digunakan untuk menunjukkan tujuan dari suatu tindakan pendidikan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The forensic report revealed that the murder ___ with a sharp object approximately six hours before the body was found.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Passive ('had been + V3') digunakan karena aksi pembunuhan terjadi sebelum aksi penemuan tubuh (was found) di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many people use paylater services without fully understanding the long-term financial consequences, ___ high levels of debt.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Participle Phrase ('resulting in') digunakan untuk menunjukkan hasil atau konsekuensi logis dari klausa sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the victims ___ their families were prepared for the slow progress of the judicial proceedings in the cybercrime case.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan korelasi yang tepat untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Digital forensics requires that every piece of electronic evidence ___ handled according to strict legal protocols to remain valid in court.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood pasif setelah 'requires that' menggunakan 'be + V3' (be handled).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The prevalence of online gambling among teenagers was so high ___ the ministry had to block thousands of illegal websites last week.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menyatakan sebab dan akibat yang signifikan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Education serves as a primary tool for social mobility, ___ individuals to improve their socio-economic status over time.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Participle ('allowing') digunakan di sini sebagai penjelas fungsi atau hasil dari subjek kalimat (education).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The suspect confessed that he ___ the digital assets from his employer for several months before being caught.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Continuous Tense ('had been stealing') digunakan untuk menunjukkan durasi suatu aksi di masa lalu sebelum titik waktu lampau lainnya (being caught).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sexual violence against minors ___ a high degree of sensitivity and specialized training for the investigators involved.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Sexual violence' adalah tunggal (uncountable), sehingga kata kerja Simple Present harus berakhiran -s (necessitates).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Autopsy results ___ crucial information that can either confirm or refute the initial theories of the criminal investigators.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'results' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (provide).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Cyber security protocols ___ regularly updated to protect sensitive personal data from increasingly sophisticated phishing attacks.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal pasif 'must be' diikuti oleh past participle (updated) diperlukan untuk menyatakan keharusan atau prosedur standar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The tragic accident involving several vehicles ___ by a combination of heavy rain and poor visibility on the highway.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The tragic accident' adalah tunggal. Kalimat pasif lampau 'was caused' tepat untuk menceritakan penyebab kecelakaan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Conflicts in the region ___ significantly since the local government implemented the new peace and reconciliation program.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'conflicts' adalah jamak. Penanda waktu 'since' menunjukkan penggunaan Present Perfect Tense ('have decreased').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The theft of intellectual property through digital means ___ easier because of the relative anonymity provided by the internet.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The theft' (tunggal). Present Perfect 'has become' digunakan untuk merujuk pada perubahan kondisi yang terjadi hingga sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Traditional pesantren students are often encouraged to live simple lives ___ they can focus entirely on their spiritual and academic growth.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'so that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan maksud atau tujuan dari pola hidup sederhana yang dianjurkan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The homicide suspect ___ by the police for questioning earlier this morning before being formally charged with murder.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'earlier this morning' menunjukkan Simple Past. Bentuk pasif 'was detained' digunakan karena tersangka 'ditahan'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Digital forensics investigators ___ specialized tools to extract deleted messages and files from mobile devices during the investigation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'investigators' jamak, maka kata kerja 'utilize' tidak menggunakan -s. Adverb 'typically' diletakkan sebelum verb.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Many students</u> <u>at pesantren</u> <u>spends</u> many hours <u>studying</u> religious <u>texts</u> every single day to gain knowledge.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Many students' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense seharusnya 'spend', bukan 'spends'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The paylater system allows consumers to purchase goods immediately and pay for them later in ___ monthly installments.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan kata sifat (adjective) 'multiple' untuk menerangkan kata benda jamak 'installments' (cicilan).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Every student in the boarding school ___ to participate in the cleaning activities twice a week to maintain the pesantren environment.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'every' harus diikuti kata benda tunggal dan kata kerja tunggal. Bentuk pasif 'is expected' (diharapkan) adalah yang paling tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The mutilation case ___ so graphic that the authorities decided not to release all the details to the general public.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'case' tunggal, maka to-be yang tepat untuk menyatakan fakta lampau (decided) adalah 'was'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Digital forensic experts <u>is</u> essential for investigating crimes that involve online gambling and cyber security breaches.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'experts' adalah jamak, sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the system administrator detected the breach, the unauthorized user ___ sensitive data for several hours.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Soal ini menggunakan Past Perfect Continuous Tense ('had been + V-ing'). Tense ini digunakan untuk menunjukkan durasi aksi yang terjadi sebelum titik waktu tertentu di masa lampau (detected).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Homicide investigators <u>requires</u> a thorough autopsy to determine the exact cause and time of death.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'investigators' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak boleh menggunakan akhiran -s (require).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Cyber security</u> <u>requires that</u> <u>every employee</u> <u>follows</u> strict <u>protocols</u> regarding their personal passwords and data access.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah struktur Subjunctive 'requires that', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'follow', bukan 'follows'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sexual violence victims <u>should be provide</u> with legal protection and psychological support to help them recover.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal pasif membutuhkan 'should be + V3'. Seharusnya 'should be provided'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>importance</u> of education <u>extending</u> beyond the <u>acquisition</u> of technical skills to include <u>moral development</u> in <u>pesantren</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat membutuhkan kata kerja utama (verb). Seharusnya 'extends', bukan bentuk present participle 'extending' tanpa to-be.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Digital forensics</u> <u>experts</u> is <u>searching</u> for <u>evidence</u> related to the <u>online gambling</u> syndicate that was arrested last week.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'experts' adalah jamak, namun to-be yang digunakan adalah 'is'. Kesalahan terletak pada subjek jamak yang tidak cocok dengan verb tunggal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Paylater</u> services allow <u>consumers</u> to <u>purchase</u> goods now even if <u>their</u> income <u>are</u> not sufficient yet.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'income' adalah kata benda tunggal (uncountable), sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'is', bukan 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>police</u> <u>was</u> <u>collecting</u> <u>evidence</u> at the crime scene shortly after the tragic <u>homicide</u> occurred yesterday.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'police' selalu dianggap jamak dalam tata bahasa Inggris, sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'were', bukan 'was'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>mutilation</u> case <u>is</u> <u>investigated</u> by <u>forensic specialists</u> who <u>analyzing</u> the physical evidence collected from the scene.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat membutuhkan kata kerja utama atau relative clause yang lengkap. Seharusnya 'who analyze' atau 'who are analyzing'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>forensic specialist</u> <u>performed</u> an <u>autopsy</u> to <u>determines</u> the <u>exact</u> cause of death during the investigation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah partikel 'to' dalam to-infinitive, kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'to determine', bukan 'to determines'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Sexual violence</u> crimes <u>carry</u> extremely <u>high penalties</u> to <u>deterring</u> <u>potential</u> offenders from committing such heinous acts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah partikel 'to' untuk menyatakan tujuan, gunakan bare infinitive. Seharusnya 'to deter', bukan 'to deterring'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: High academic achievement usually requires not only great intelligence ___ a strong sense of ambition and persistent effort.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur korelasi paralel 'not only' harus dipasangkan dengan 'but also' untuk menghubungkan dua unsur yang setara.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the school year ends, the students who participate in extracurricular activities ___ significant leadership skills.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Future Perfect Tense ('will have + V3') karena terdapat keterangan waktu 'By the time' yang menunjukkan aksi akan sudah selesai di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The mass poisoning incident occurred shortly after dozens of students ___ the free nutritious meals provided by the government program.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Tense ('had + V3') digunakan untuk menyatakan aksi yang terjadi sebelum aksi lain (occurred) di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many people argue that the death penalty for corruptors ___ as a deterrent to prevent further state losses.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal pasif 'should be implemented' (seharusnya diterapkan) diperlukan untuk menyatakan saran atau keharusan dalam bentuk pasif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Illegal parking attendants often create traffic congestion, ___ it difficult for potential customers to visit the local stores.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Participle Phrase ('making') digunakan untuk menunjukkan konsekuensi atau hasil dari tindakan yang dijelaskan pada klausa sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The suspect confessed that he ___ the public funds for personal gain over a period of three years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Continuous Tense ('had been + V-ing') digunakan untuk menunjukkan aksi yang berlangsung terus-menerus sebelum titik waktu tertentu di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Gen Alpha children, who ___ since they were toddlers, possess a high degree of digital literacy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Perfect Continuous digunakan untuk menyatakan aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut hingga sekarang. Subjek 'children' adalah jamak.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Simple sports like walking or jogging ___ every day to maintain cardiovascular health and mental clarity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk modal pasif 'should be performed' (seharusnya dilakukan) tepat digunakan untuk menyatakan anjuran kesehatan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The plot of many modern soap operas ___ to be repetitive and unrealistic according to recent media critics.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The plot' adalah tunggal, sehingga membutuhkan to-be tunggal 'is'. Kalimat pasif digunakan untuk menyatakan opini umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Health experts recommend that every individual ___ at least five servings of fruits and vegetables daily.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata 'recommend that'. Kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (consume) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The presence of thuggery and premanisme in the marketplace ___ a significant threat to the security of small businesses.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The presence' (tunggal), maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense harus berakhiran -s (poses).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Ambition and spirit are internal drivers that ___ individuals to overcome various life obstacles and achieve success.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'that' merujuk pada 'internal drivers' (jamak), sehingga kata kerja 'motivate' tidak menggunakan akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the government ___ the new nutritional program more carefully, the mass poisoning incident could have been avoided.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect ('had + V3') karena klausa utama menggunakan 'could have been avoided'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The thieves were arrested after the police ___ evidence of their involvement in multiple robberies across the city.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks kalimat adalah masa lampau yang sudah selesai, sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense ('found').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Extracurricular activities provide students with opportunities ___ social skills that are not taught in the classroom.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: To-infinitive ('to develop') digunakan untuk menunjukkan tujuan atau fungsi dari peluang yang diberikan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Soap operas often feature characters who ___ in complex and highly emotional family conflicts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'characters' adalah jamak, maka membutuhkan to-be jamak 'are'. Bentuk pasif digunakan karena karakter tersebut 'terlibat'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The spirit of teamwork is essential for achieving any ambitious goal, ___ the difficulty of the task.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'regardless of' (terlepas dari) digunakan untuk menunjukkan bahwa faktor kesulitan tidak mengubah pentingnya kerja sama tim.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By next year, the city administration ___ a new regulation to eliminate illegal parking in the downtown area.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'By next year' menandakan penggunaan Future Perfect Tense ('will have + V3').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Gen Alpha is the first generation to be born entirely in the 21st century, ___ them a unique demographic group.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Participle Phrase ('making') digunakan untuk memberikan informasi tambahan sebagai hasil dari kondisi sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many corruption cases remain unresolved ___ the complexity of the financial transactions and the involvement of powerful individuals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'due to' diikuti oleh frasa kata benda ('the complexity') untuk menunjukkan alasan atau penyebab.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A nutritious breakfast is vital for children ___ it provides the necessary energy for their daily academic activities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'because' menghubungkan klausa utama dengan klausa alasan (subjek + predikat).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not until the forensic audit was completed ___ the true extent of the corruption within the organization.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Inversion setelah frasa negatif 'Not until'. Membutuhkan auxiliary 'did' karena menceritakan kejadian lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The ambition to become a world-class athlete ___ constant training and a very disciplined lifestyle.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'ambition' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense harus berakhiran -s (necessitates).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The mass poisoning was caused by contaminated ingredients that ___ properly stored in the school kitchen.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Passive ('had not been + V3') digunakan untuk menyatakan kondisi yang sudah terjadi sebelum insiden keracunan masa lampau tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the school principal ___ the teachers were aware of the hygiene problems in the food program.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan korelasi yang tepat untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Tukang parkir who operate illegally often ___ customers from visiting certain shopping districts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Tukang parkir' (jamak dalam konteks 'who operate') membutuhkan kata kerja 'discourage' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The death penalty for corruptors is a controversial topic, ___ many human rights activists oppose it on ethical grounds.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'for' di sini bermakna 'karena', memberikan alasan mengapa topik tersebut menjadi kontroversial.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Gen Alpha children ___ technology as an extension of their own identities rather than just a tool.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'children' jamak, maka kata kerja 'perceive' tidak menggunakan akhiran -s. Adverb 'often' diletakkan sebelum kata kerja.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Healthy food options ___ more available in school cafeterias since the new nutritional policy was introduced.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'options' jamak. Penanda waktu 'since' menunjukkan Present Perfect Tense ('have become').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The spirit of achievement ___ by teachers through encouraging feedback and supportive learning environments.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The spirit' tunggal. Kalimat pasif Simple Present 'is nurtured' (dipupuk/dibina) tepat untuk menyatakan fakta umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Corruptors often use complex laundering schemes ___ hide the origin of their illegal funds from the authorities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: To-infinitive ('to hide') digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan (purpose).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Simple sports like walking are effective for weight loss ___ they are performed consistently and at a brisk pace.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'if' digunakan untuk menunjukkan hubungan syarat antara konsistensi olahraga dan efektivitasnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The thieves ___ the stolen goods in an abandoned warehouse before the police raided the building.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Tense ('had hidden') digunakan karena aksi menyembunyikan terjadi sebelum aksi penggerebekan (raided) di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Ambition is a key factor in success, ___ it drives individuals to work harder toward their desired goals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'since' di sini bermakna 'karena' (because), memberikan penjelasan mengapa ambisi menjadi kunci kesuksesan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The illegal parking attendants were ___ by the local police during a routine security sweep last night.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif (were removed) diikuti oleh adverb 'successfully' untuk menerangkan proses pembersihan parkir liar tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Every ambitious student <u>need</u> constant support and encouragement from their teachers to achieve high goals.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata 'every' harus diikuti oleh kata benda tunggal dan kata kerja tunggal berakhiran -s (needs).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Illegal parking attendants <u>makes</u> many customers reluctant to visit certain traditional shopping districts in the city.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'attendants' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense seharusnya 'make' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The mass poisoning incident <u>were</u> caused by contaminated milk that had not been properly refrigerated.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama 'incident' adalah tunggal, sehingga to-be lampau yang tepat adalah 'was'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Corruptors who <u>has</u> stolen public funds should be punished with the most severe legal penalties available.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'who' merujuk pada 'corruptors' (jamak), sehingga auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Gen Alpha children <u>is</u> highly familiar with digital devices and online platforms since their early childhood.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'children' adalah jamak, sehingga to-be yang tepat dalam Simple Present Tense adalah 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>ambitious</u> student <u>have</u> <u>practiced</u> <u>his</u> <u>winning</u> speech for the upcoming national competition.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'student' adalah tunggal, sehingga seharusnya menggunakan auxiliary verb 'has', bukan 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Corruptors <u>who</u> <u>steals</u> <u>public</u> <u>funds</u> <u>should</u> face the most severe legal penalties.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'who' merujuk pada subjek jamak 'Corruptors', sehingga kata kerja seharusnya 'steal' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>corrupt</u> <u>officials</u> <u>was</u> <u>arrested</u> <u>by</u> the authorities for embezzling state money.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'officials' adalah jamak, sehingga to-be lampau yang tepat adalah 'were', bukan 'was'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Simple <u>exercises</u> <u>like</u> <u>walking</u> <u>is</u> <u>very</u> beneficial for maintaining long-term physical health.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'exercises' (jamak), sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Mass <u>poisoning</u> <u>cases</u> <u>happens</u> <u>when</u> <u>food</u> hygiene standards are not strictly followed.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'cases' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense seharusnya 'happen' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Illegal <u>parking</u> <u>attendants</u> <u>causes</u> <u>traffic</u> <u>congestion</u> near the busy traditional market area.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'attendants' jamak, maka kata kerja Simple Present yang tepat adalah 'cause' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>pesantren</u> <u>graduates</u> <u>has</u> <u>contributed</u> <u>to</u> the community through their religious knowledge.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'graduates' adalah jamak, sehingga auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'have', bukan 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Some <u>sinetron</u> <u>plots</u> <u>appears</u> <u>to</u> <u>be</u> unrealistic and repetitive for modern audiences.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'plots' jamak, sehingga kata kerja Simple Present seharusnya 'appear' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>thieves</u> <u>who</u> <u>was</u> <u>caught</u> <u>by</u> the villagers were handed to the police.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'who' merujuk pada subjek jamak 'thieves', maka to-be yang tepat adalah 'were', bukan 'was'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A <u>healthy</u> <u>meal</u> <u>should</u> <u>consists</u> <u>of</u> a balance of proteins and vitamins.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal verb 'should', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive). Seharusnya 'consist' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>ambitious</u> <u>goals</u> <u>requires</u> <u>constant</u> <u>effort</u> and a strong spirit to achieve.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'goals' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja Simple Present seharusnya 'require' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>school</u> <u>curriculum</u> <u>include</u> <u>many</u> <u>interesting</u> extracurricular activities for the students.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'curriculum' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja Simple Present seharusnya 'includes' dengan akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Gen <u>Alpha</u> <u>children</u> <u>is</u> <u>more</u> <u>familiar</u> with smartphones than previous generations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'children' adalah jamak, sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Massive <u>corruption</u> <u>practices</u> <u>has</u> <u>severely</u> <u>damaged</u> the national economy over the years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama 'practices' adalah jamak, sehingga auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'have', bukan 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the central bank finalized the new fiscal regulations, several major investment firms ___ significant portions of their portfolios to offshore accounts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Past Perfect Tense ('had + V3') karena menyatakan suatu aksi yang telah selesai dilakukan sebelum aksi lain terjadi di masa lampau (finalized). Penanda waktu 'By the time' memperjelas urutan kejadian tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In the realm of fine arts, modern curators ___ the traditional boundaries between sculpture and immersive digital installations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'modern curators' adalah jamak, sehingga membutuhkan auxiliary 'have'. Present Perfect Tense digunakan di sini untuk menunjukkan aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut atau memiliki dampak hingga sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The curriculum for applied science programs requires that every student ___ an independent research project before graduation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'requires that'. Dalam struktur ini, kata kerja setelah subjek (every student) harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Management theories regarding customer relations suggest that long-term loyalty ___ through personalized service and data-driven insights.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'long-term loyalty' adalah tunggal dan tidak dapat dihitung. Kalimat pasif dalam Simple Present Tense ('is built') digunakan untuk menyatakan fakta atau prinsip manajemen umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the accounting firm had identified the discrepancies in the audit earlier, the financial crisis ___ more effectively.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect (had identified), sehingga klausa utama harus menggunakan 'would have + V3' (been managed).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Technological Islamization in digital spaces ___ a significant shift in how religious education is disseminated across urban populations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Technological Islamization' adalah tunggal. Present Perfect Tense ('has induced') digunakan untuk merujuk pada fenomena yang baru terjadi dan dampaknya masih dirasakan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Applied arts practitioners often combine traditional craftsmanship ___ modern aesthetic principles to create functional design pieces.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'combine' berpasangan dengan preposisi 'with' untuk menunjukkan penggabungan dua unsur yang berbeda.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sociological studies on religious predators reveal that some individuals use their religious status ___ their manipulative behaviors.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: To-infinitive ('to conceal') digunakan di sini untuk menunjukkan tujuan (purpose) dari tindakan subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the end of the next decade, IT management systems ___ so advanced that they will predict infrastructure failures automatically.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'By the end of the next decade' menandakan penggunaan Future Perfect Tense untuk menyatakan aksi yang akan sudah selesai di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A comparative study of religion ___ that the concept of morality is shared among different schools of thought.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'A comparative study' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense harus menggunakan akhiran -s (indicates).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In the history of global economics, the gold standard ___ as the primary monetary system for several centuries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menceritakan fakta sejarah yang sudah selesai di masa lampau, sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense ('functioned').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The integration of renewable energy in applied science ___ to reduce dependency on fossil fuels significantly.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The integration' (tunggal), maka kata kerja Simple Present harus berakhiran -s (aims).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scholars of comparative mazhab suggest that religious interpretations ___ based on current social and political contexts.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Subjunctive Mood pasif setelah 'suggest that' menggunakan 'be + V3' (be adjusted).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Economic analysts found that the inflation rate ___ steadily during the first quarter of the year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Karena klausa utama menggunakan 'found' (past), maka klausa pendukung menggunakan Past Continuous ('was rising') untuk menunjukkan proses yang sedang terjadi saat observasi dilakukan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The threat of international terrorism ___ the development of more stringent global security protocols.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The threat' adalah tunggal, sehingga menggunakan auxiliary 'has'. Present Perfect Tense digunakan untuk menyatakan kebutuhan yang muncul dan masih berlaku.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Resource management strategies in business ___ on optimizing productivity while minimizing operational costs.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'strategies' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (focus).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ in traditional fine arts, but it also plays a crucial role in modern industrial design.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Inversion digunakan setelah frasa negatif 'Not only'. Karena 'symmetry' tunggal, maka menggunakan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Human resource specialists recommend that every new employee ___ a comprehensive orientation session.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'recommend that' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar (attend) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The molecular biology of pathogens ___ by researchers to develop more effective vaccines for applied science.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The molecular biology' adalah tunggal. Passive Continuous ('is being studied') digunakan untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The rise of cyberterrorism was so rapid ___ many governments struggled to update their defense systems in time.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menyatakan sebab-akibat yang signifikan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Accounting principles require that every financial statement ___ accurate information about the company's assets and liabilities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'require that' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar (contain) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The history of the ancient trade routes ___ that cultural exchange was as important as the trade of goods.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The history' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja Simple Present harus berakhiran -s (shows). 'Clearly' adalah adverb penjelas.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Applied science researchers ___ the impact of climate change on coastal agriculture since the early 1990s.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek jamak 'researchers' dan penanda waktu 'since' menunjukkan penggunaan Present Perfect Continuous ('have been analyzing').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Religious education in modern schools ___ both traditional values and critical thinking skills to foster tolerance.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'should' harus diikuti oleh bare infinitive (integrate) untuk menyatakan saran atau anjuran.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The financial success of a startup ___ on its ability to attract venture capital and build a sustainable model.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'success' tunggal, maka kata kerja 'depend' harus berakhiran -s (depends). 'Primarily' diletakkan setelah verb.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By next year, the IT management team ___ a new customer service portal powered by artificial intelligence.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'By next year' menandakan Future Perfect Tense ('will have + V3') untuk aksi yang akan selesai di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Comparative religion scholars found that many faith-based organizations ___ significant roles in promoting social justice.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Klausa ini menyatakan fakta umum (General Truth), sehingga Simple Present Tense ('play') tetap digunakan meskipun klausa utama lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The fine arts exhibition was ___ by a group of donors who wished to promote local creative talent.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat pasif (was funded) diikuti oleh adverb 'generously' untuk memberikan penekanan pada cara pendanaan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Applied science students must learn how ___ complex data sets to ensure the accuracy of their research findings.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'how + to-infinitive' digunakan untuk menunjukkan cara melakukan sesuatu.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the business manager ___ the financial accountants were prepared for the sudden shift in market trends.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan konjungsi korelasi yang tepat untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Religious predators often exploit the vulnerability of their victims ___ a false sense of spiritual security.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Gerund ('creating') diletakkan setelah preposisi 'by' untuk menunjukkan cara atau metode eksploitasi tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Applied arts projects often ___ the use of sustainable materials to reduce the environmental footprint of design.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'projects' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (prioritize).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The development of a new accounting software ___ to streamline the auditing process for medium-sized enterprises.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'development' adalah tunggal. Bentuk pasif Simple Present 'is intended' (dimaksudkan untuk) tepat digunakan di sini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Islamization of the political system in some regions ___ a subject of intense academic debate among historians.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Islamization' tunggal. Penanda 'long been' menunjukkan Present Perfect untuk status yang berlanjut hingga kini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Effective resource management requires that the team ___ both human and financial capital strategically.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'requires that' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar (allocate) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Academic journals frequently emphasize that students who achieve high academic performance ___ through consistent mentorship and rigorous extracurricular engagement.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Present Perfect Passive Tense ('have been + V3') untuk menunjukkan aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih relevan. Subjek 'students' adalah jamak, sehingga menggunakan 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The alarming escalation of tuition fees in private institutions ___ many underprivileged students to abandon their pursuit of higher education.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama adalah 'The alarming escalation' (tunggal), maka auxiliary verb yang tepat adalah 'has'. Present Perfect Tense digunakan untuk aksi yang terjadi di masa lalu dengan hasil yang dirasakan sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sociological evidence suggests that the pervasive usage of digital gadgets among children ___ their cognitive development and social interaction skills.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'can' harus diikuti oleh bare infinitive (impair). Adverb 'severely' diletakkan di antara modal dan kata kerja untuk memberikan penekanan pada tingkat kerusakan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In a saturated labor market, job seekers often find that obtaining a stable position ___ exceptional professional networking and specialized certifications.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek klausa ini adalah gerund phrase 'obtaining a stable position' yang dianggap tunggal, sehingga kata kerja harus menggunakan akhiran -s (necessitates).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Political analysts argue that many public officials ___ nonsense statements to distract the populace from critical economic failures.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'many public officials' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (deliver).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the new environmental law is enacted, the logging corporations ___ vast areas of the ancient rainforest.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Future Perfect Tense ('will have + V3') digunakan karena aksi eksploitasi akan sudah selesai dilakukan pada saat hukum tersebut diberlakukan di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The preservation of wildlife habitats requires that the government ___ strict regulations against land conversion and illegal poaching.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'requires that'. Kata kerja setelah subjek (government) harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many scholars believe that hobbies ___ as a crucial outlet for stress reduction in highly competitive academic environments.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'hobbies' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (serve).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The economic policies implemented last year ___ only to enrich the political elite rather than improving the welfare of the poor.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat menceritakan kebijakan yang sudah terjadi di masa lampau (last year), sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Tense ('aimed').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the administration had focused on social equity, the exploitation of natural resources ___ so rampant in the rural provinces.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect (had focused), sehingga klausa utama menggunakan 'would have been'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Technological advancements, although beneficial, ___ a significant threat to the psychological well-being of the younger generation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Technological advancements' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja utama dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (present).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Public distrust increases when politicians ___ misleading information regarding the actual state of the national economy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'politicians' adalah jamak, sehingga membutuhkan kata kerja bentuk dasar 'disseminate' dalam Simple Present Tense.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The pristine beauty of the national park ___ by recent industrial activities in the surrounding areas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The pristine beauty' adalah tunggal (uncountable). Kalimat pasif dalam Present Perfect ('has been marred') menunjukkan dampak yang sudah terjadi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The job hunting process ___ a high degree of resilience and adaptability among fresh university graduates today.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The job hunting process' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense harus berakhiran -s (demands).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the government officials ___ the greedy corporate leaders expected such a massive public protest against the land exploitation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan konjungsi korelasi yang tepat untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Poverty alleviation programs often fail ___ they are supported by transparent data and sustainable funding models.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'unless' (kecuali jika) digunakan untuk menunjukkan kondisi negatif yang jika tidak terpenuhi akan menyebabkan kegagalan program.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The majestic wildlife in the interior of Borneo ___ a vital component of the global ecological balance for centuries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'wildlife' dianggap tunggal. Penanda waktu 'for centuries' menunjukkan penggunaan Present Perfect Tense ('has been').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The rapid growth of social media has allowed individuals ___ their opinions regardless of the factual accuracy of the information.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'allow' diikuti oleh 'object + to-infinitive'. Frasa 'to express' memenuhi aturan gramatikal tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not until the auditing firm completed the investigation ___ the true extent of the financial exploitation within the company.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Inversion setelah frasa negatif 'Not until'. Karena menceritakan kejadian lampau, maka menggunakan auxiliary 'did'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Corporate social responsibility mandates that a company ___ more than just profit maximization to include environmental protection.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'mandates that' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar (prioritize) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: High-achieving students usually dedicate a significant amount of time ___ their specialized skills through deliberate practice.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'dedicate time' biasanya diikuti oleh 'to + gerund' atau 'to + noun'. Namun dalam konteks tujuan umum, 'to refine' (infinitive) sering digunakan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The exploitation of natural resources in developing nations ___ a subject of intense academic scrutiny for several decades.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The exploitation' tunggal. Penanda 'for several decades' menunjukkan Present Perfect Tense ('has been').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The greedy policies implemented by the ruling party ___ the national debt to an unsustainable level within three years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat menceritakan aksi yang sudah terjadi (Simple Past Tense). Subjek 'policies' jamak, tetapi V2 tetap sama ('increased').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many children who are addicted to digital screens ___ difficulty in regulating their emotions during social interactions.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'children' jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (experience).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Public transportation systems ___ to reduce traffic congestion and carbon emissions in urban areas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'systems' jamak, sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'are'. Bentuk pasif digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan pembuatan sistem tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The pristine environment of the remote island was ___ by the lack of human interference for many centuries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat pasif (was preserved) diikuti oleh adverb 'remarkably' untuk menerangkan tingkat keberhasilan pelestarian tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Fresh university graduates find it challenging ___ a job that matches their academic background and salary expectations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'find it + adjective + to-infinitive' adalah pola standar dalam tata bahasa Inggris (to secure).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The politician's rhetoric was so deceptive ___ most of the voters failed to see the actual consequences of the policy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menunjukkan sebab-akibat yang sangat kuat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scientific research into wildlife behavior ___ that many species possess a high degree of social intelligence.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'research' tunggal, menggunakan Present Perfect ('has revealed') untuk merujuk pada temuan yang masih berlaku.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Education policy experts suggest that the curriculum ___ more focus on critical thinking and digital ethics.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'suggest that' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar (incorporate) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The greedy leaders ___ only about their own financial gain instead of the welfare of the people.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat menceritakan aksi yang sudah terjadi di masa lampau (Simple Past Tense: 'cared').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many people live in extreme poverty ___ the abundance of natural resources in their own home countries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'despite' (meskipun) diikuti oleh frasa kata benda ('the abundance') untuk menunjukkan pertentangan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The danger of excessive gadget use ___ a serious concern for many pediatricians specializing in child development.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The danger' tunggal. Present Perfect ('has become') menunjukkan proses yang sudah terjadi dan hasilnya tetap ada.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A sustainable economy requires that every citizen ___ a fair opportunity to participate in the formal labor market.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood pasif setelah 'requires that' menggunakan 'be + V3' (be given).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The exploitation of labor in several factories ___ by human rights organizations after a thorough investigation last month.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'The exploitation' tunggal. Bentuk pasif lampau ('was exposed') digunakan karena ada keterangan waktu 'last month'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scholarly publications <u>had finalized</u> the report <u>before</u> the <u>researchers</u> <u>had presented</u> their <u>findings</u> at the conference.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dalam urutan waktu 'Past Perfect... before... Simple Past', bagian setelah 'before' harus menggunakan Simple Past. Seharusnya 'presented'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: High-achieving <u>students</u> <u>must</u> <u>to cultivate</u> a strong academic <u>spirit</u> during their <u>studies</u>.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal verb 'must', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar tanpa 'to'. Seharusnya 'cultivate'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Expensive <u>education</u> <u>requires</u> that the <u>government</u> <u>provides</u> subsidies for <u>underprivileged</u> students.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Subjunctive 'requires that' mengharuskan kata kerja bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'provide' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Job <u>seekers</u> <u>is</u> <u>finding</u> it <u>difficult</u> to <u>secure</u> a stable <u>position</u> today.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'seekers' adalah jamak, sehingga to-be yang tepat dalam Present Continuous Tense adalah 'are'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Environmental <u>policies</u> <u>can</u> <u>be</u> <u>improve</u> <u>to</u> protect <u>threatened</u> <u>wildlife</u> species.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif modal 'can be' membutuhkan past participle (V3). Seharusnya 'improved'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many <u>unscrupulous</u> <u>politicians</u> regularly <u>deliver</u> <u>nonsense</u> during election campaigns to gain public votes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks kalimat jurnal ini menyiratkan pernyataan yang tidak masuk akal (jamak). Seharusnya 'nonsensical' (adjective) atau 'nonsense' sebagai kata benda yang tidak dapat dihitung tetap benar, namun dalam pola soal ini poin 3 sering menguji kelas kata.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scholars report that <u>excessive</u> usage of <u>gadgets</u> <u>is</u> <u>harming</u> the <u>cognitive</u> growth of many young children.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Teks ini secara gramatikal benar. Namun dalam pola TOEFL, 'cognitive' (adjective) sering diuji apakah harus menjadi 'cognition' (noun). Di sini 'cognitive growth' sudah tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>greedy</u> leaders <u>aimed</u> to <u>enrich</u> <u>their</u> own <u>wealth</u> instead of improving the people's welfare.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Penggunaan 'wealth' (kekayaan) setelah 'enrich' (memperkaya) adalah pleonasme. Seharusnya 'themselves' atau langsung objek lain.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scientific <u>journals</u> <u>suggest</u> that <u>hobbies</u> <u>is</u> essential for <u>maintaining</u> mental health in competitive societies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'hobbies' adalah jamak, sehingga to-be yang tepat adalah 'are', bukan 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>exploitation</u> of <u>labor</u> <u>has</u> <u>became</u> a <u>critical</u> issue for many international human rights organizations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Perfect Tense membutuhkan 'has + past participle (V3)'. Seharusnya 'become', bukan 'became' (V2).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many <u>fresh</u> graduates <u>struggles</u> to <u>find</u> <u>stable</u> <u>employment</u> in the current saturated global labor market.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'graduates' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense seharusnya 'struggle' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Modern <u>education</u> <u>requires</u> that the <u>government</u> <u>allocates</u> more funds for <u>underprivileged</u> students and schools.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah struktur Subjunctive 'requires that', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar. Seharusnya 'allocate', bukan 'allocates'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>majestic</u> <u>wildlife</u> habitat <u>was</u> <u>destroy</u> by <u>unregulated</u> industrial expansion in the remote jungle areas.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat pasif lampau membutuhkan 'to-be + V3'. Seharusnya 'was destroyed', bukan 'was destroy'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Greedy <u>officials</u> <u>often</u> <u>enacts</u> <u>policies</u> that only <u>benefit</u> the political elite and large corporations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'officials' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense seharusnya 'enact' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Scientific <u>evidence</u> <u>proves</u> that <u>pristine</u> <u>nature</u> <u>provide</u> essential ecosystem services for the local communities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'nature' dianggap tunggal/uncountable, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense seharusnya 'provides' dengan akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Engineering journals state that by the time the new dam is fully operational next year, the construction firm ___ over two billion dollars in structural reinforcements.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menggunakan Future Perfect Tense ('will have + V3') karena terdapat keterangan waktu 'By the time ... next year' yang menunjukkan aksi akan sudah selesai di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The hospitality industry often requires that every international hotel chain ___ strict sustainability protocols to attract eco-conscious travelers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah penggunaan Subjunctive Mood setelah kata kerja 'requires that'. Kata kerja setelah subjek (hotel chain) harus dalam bentuk dasar (base form) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: In the global trade sector, many property rental platforms ___ significant growth since the digital transformation of the real estate market began.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'platforms' adalah jamak. Penanda waktu 'since' menunjukkan penggunaan Present Perfect Tense ('have + V3') untuk aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Marketing specialists have observed that the pervasive usage of social media ___ the way brands engage with their target audience through influencer partnerships.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'usage' adalah tunggal (uncountable). Present Perfect Tense digunakan di sini untuk menunjukkan perubahan yang telah terjadi dan dampaknya terasa sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Urban development reports indicate that heavy traffic congestion ___ if the municipal government had expanded the public transportation network earlier.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect (had expanded), sehingga klausa utama harus menggunakan 'would have + V3'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The recent trend of subscribing to digital applications ___ that consumers prioritize convenience and exclusive content over one-time ownership.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'trend' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense harus menggunakan akhiran -s (suggests).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Marine researchers found that several rare species in the deep sea ___ to the extreme pressure of the abyss for millions of years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Continuous Tense ('had been + V-ing') digunakan karena aksi adaptasi berlangsung selama durasi tertentu sebelum penemuan (found) di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The preservation of endemic flora requires that the local community ___ active measures against illegal logging and habitat destruction.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Subjunctive Mood setelah 'requires that' mengharuskan penggunaan kata kerja bentuk dasar (take) tanpa tambahan apa pun.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Zodiac signs and astrology ___ as a psychological tool for self-reflection by many individuals in modern urban societies.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Zodiac signs and astrology' dianggap jamak karena terdiri dari dua unsur. Kalimat pasif ('are used') digunakan untuk menyatakan fakta atau kebiasaan umum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Political historians argue that grass-root rebellions ___ the collapse of several authoritarian regimes throughout the 20th century.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konteks sejarah masa lampau (abad ke-20) memerlukan Simple Past Tense ('triggered'). 'Effectively' diletakkan sebelum verb sebagai adverb penjelas.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The surgical team suggested that the patient ___ a complex operation to repair the damaged heart valve immediately.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive Mood setelah 'suggested that' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar (undergo) tanpa mempedulikan subjeknya tunggal atau jamak.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Recent debates regarding military officials occupying civil positions ___ intense public scrutiny concerning the separation of powers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'debates' adalah jamak. Present Perfect Tense ('have sparked') menunjukkan aksi yang terjadi di masa lalu dengan konsekuensi yang masih berlanjut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Pancasila and the 1945 Constitution (UUD) ___ the fundamental legal framework for all government policies in Indonesia.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek jamak (Pancasila and UUD) membutuhkan kata kerja bentuk dasar 'provide' (Simple Present) untuk menyatakan fakta hukum yang tetap.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The rapid advancement of IT ___ it possible for companies to track global logistics with unprecedented precision.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'advancement' adalah tunggal. Present Perfect Tense ('has made') digunakan untuk menunjukkan perkembangan teknologi yang hasilnya dirasakan sekarang.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not only ___ in international trade, but it also influences the political stability of developing nations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur Inversion digunakan setelah frasa negatif 'Not only'. Karena 'growth' tunggal, maka menggunakan auxiliary 'is' diikuti subjek dan adjective.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The intricate biodiversity of the deepest ocean trenches ___ a mystery to scientists for many centuries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'biodiversity' adalah tunggal. Penanda 'for many centuries' menunjukkan Present Perfect Tense ('has remained').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the end of the next decade, most software applications ___ on a subscription-based revenue model.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'By the end of the next decade' mengindikasikan Future Perfect Tense untuk aksi yang akan selesai di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Marketing managers often spend substantial budgets ___ the consumer's emotional response to brand storytelling.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'spend + budget/time + V-ing' digunakan untuk menunjukkan aktivitas. 'Analyzing' adalah gerund yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The grass-root movements ___ for constitutional reform since the beginning of the political crisis last year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'movements' jamak. Penanda 'since' menunjukkan Present Perfect Continuous Tense ('have been advocating').

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Technicians must ensure that the electrical system ___ grounded to prevent potential fires in the industrial plant.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive Mood setelah 'ensure that'. Kata kerja bantu yang digunakan adalah 'be' (bentuk dasar).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A successful marketing campaign ___ consistency across multiple social media platforms to build brand equity.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'campaign' tunggal, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense harus berakhiran -s (requires).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The 1945 Constitution suggests that the state ___ responsibility for the welfare of the poor and abandoned children.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Sama dengan aturan 'suggests that', kalimat ini menggunakan Subjunctive Mood (take) dalam bentuk dasar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many rare fauna and flora species ___ to higher altitudes as global temperatures continue to rise.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'species' (jamak di sini) sedang melakukan aksi. Present Continuous ('are migrating') menunjukkan proses yang sedang berlangsung.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Deep-sea hydrothermal vents ___ specialized ecosystems that operate independently of solar energy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'vents' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (support).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The property rental market in metropolitan areas was ___ by the sudden shift toward remote work last year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat pasif lampau (was impacted) diikuti adverb 'significantly' untuk memberikan keterangan pada kata kerja pasif tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Astronomers believe that your zodiac sign ___ any scientific correlation with individual personality traits.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'sign' tunggal. Kalimat negatif dalam Simple Present Tense membutuhkan auxiliary 'does not' diikuti verb 1.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The rebellion was ___ by the government's failure to address the basic needs of the rural population.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif (was fueled) diikuti oleh adverb 'directly' untuk menunjukkan penyebab langsung dari pemberontakan tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Information technology managers must ensure that sensitive data ___ against unauthorized access at all times.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood pasif setelah 'ensure that' menggunakan 'be + V3' (be protected).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The trend of app subscriptions ___ so rapidly that most developers are abandoning traditional licensing models.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'trend' tunggal. Present Perfect Tense ('has grown') menunjukkan proses yang dampaknya terlihat pada kondisi saat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Hospitality experts suggest that every hotel ___ personalized guest experiences to maintain a high occupancy rate.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjunctive mood setelah 'suggest that' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar (provide) tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The structural failure of the civil engineering project ___ caused by poor soil quality and inadequate drainage.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif lampau (was caused) membutuhkan adverb 'reportedly' untuk menunjukkan sumber informasi atau dugaan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Pancasila serves as the ideological foundation ___ unites the diverse ethnic groups within the Indonesian archipelago.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative pronoun 'that' digunakan untuk merujuk pada benda atau konsep (ideological foundation) yang berfungsi sebagai subjek klausa.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the military officials ___ the civil administrators were prepared for the rapid social transformation in the region.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan konjungsi korelasi tetap untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the tourism industry ___ more resilient, it would have recovered more quickly from the global economic crisis.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect ('had been') karena klausa utama menggunakan 'would have recovered'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The deepest parts of the ocean ___ by scientists to discover new sources of biological and mineral resources.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'parts' jamak. Passive Continuous ('are being explored') menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The property rental market in metropolitan areas <u>have been</u> affected by the recent economic downturn last year.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'market' adalah tunggal, sehingga auxiliary verb yang tepat seharusnya adalah 'has', bukan 'have'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The surgical procedure <u>performing</u> by the specialist yesterday was successful despite the complexity of the case.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan bentuk Past Participle 'performed' (yang dilakukan) untuk menerangkan subjek 'procedure' secara pasif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Civil servants must ensuring that <u>every</u> administrative task is completed according to the new government regulations.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal verb 'must', kata kerja harus dalam bentuk dasar (bare infinitive). Seharusnya 'must ensure'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Pancasila <u>provides</u> the ideological basis for maintain social harmony among diverse religious groups in Indonesia.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah preposisi 'for', kata kerja harus diubah menjadi gerund. Seharusnya 'for maintaining'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The researchers <u>finding</u> that certain deep-sea creatures survive without sunlight through chemosynthesis processes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan kata kerja utama (verb). Karena menceritakan temuan penelitian di masa lampau, bentuk Simple Past 'found' adalah yang paling tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Marine <u>biologists</u> have <u>documented</u> that <u>rare</u> deep <u>sea</u> species <u>possesses</u> unique bioluminescent organs.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek dalam klausa ini adalah 'species' (jamak), sehingga kata kerja seharusnya 'possess' tanpa akhiran -es.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The <u>rebellion</u> was <u>led</u> by <u>local</u> leaders who <u>wants</u> to <u>overthrow</u> the authoritarian government.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Karena kalimat menggunakan 'was' (past), maka kata kerja dalam klausa relatif seharusnya 'wanted' (Simple Past).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: <u>Many</u> <u>international</u> hotels <u>now</u> <u>utilizes</u> advanced <u>technology</u> to enhance the guest experience.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'hotels' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense seharusnya 'utilize' tanpa -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Medical researchers have found that many individuals infected with HIV ___ any visible symptoms for several years after the initial exposure.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini menyatakan fakta medis umum (Simple Present Tense). Karena subjek 'many individuals' adalah jamak, maka kata kerja bantu negatif yang tepat adalah 'do not experience'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The risk of transmitting sexually transmitted infections (STIs) ___ significantly if barrier protection is not used consistently.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek kalimat adalah 'The risk' yang merupakan kata benda tunggal, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense harus menggunakan akhiran -s (increases).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Recent sociological studies suggest that teenagers who fall into the trap of drug abuse ___ social and psychological challenges.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek dalam klausa ini adalah 'teenagers' (jamak), sehingga membutuhkan kata kerja utama 'face' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Pornography addiction often alters the brain's reward system, ___ it difficult for individuals to form healthy emotional connections.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bagian ini menggunakan Present Participle (making) untuk menjelaskan konsekuensi atau hasil dari tindakan yang dijelaskan pada klausa utama sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The prevalence of sexual activity among school-aged children has prompted educators ___ more comprehensive sexual health programs.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kata kerja 'prompt' membutuhkan objek yang diikuti oleh to-infinitive (prompt someone to do something). Opsi 'To develop and implement' memenuhi aturan ini.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Child grooming, a predatory behavior used to build a relationship with a child, ___ as a severe violation of child protection laws.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Child grooming' adalah tunggal, sehingga membutuhkan 'is'. Kalimat pasif digunakan untuk menunjukkan status perbuatan tersebut di mata hukum.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the time the authorities identified the child trafficking syndicate, dozens of victims ___ to foreign countries.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Soal ini menguji Past Perfect Passive Tense. Bentuk 'had been sold' digunakan karena aksi penjualan terjadi sebelum aksi identifikasi (past tense) dilakukan di masa lampau.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Pedophiles often use digital platforms to target vulnerable children ___ to gain their trust through emotional manipulation.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'in order' diikuti oleh 'to-infinitive' (to gain) digunakan untuk menunjukkan tujuan dari suatu tindakan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Teenage parents face significant risks, including higher rates of poverty ___ medical complications during pregnancy and childbirth.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Konjungsi 'and' digunakan untuk menggabungkan dua atau lebih unsur yang setara (poverty dan medical complications).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: If the government ___ stricter monitoring of nightlife districts, the rate of drug-related crimes might have decreased.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Conditional Sentence Type 3. Karena klausa utama menggunakan 'might have decreased', maka klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect (had enforced).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The illegal trade of infants ___ a growing concern for international human rights organizations in recent years.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Keterangan waktu 'in recent years' menunjukkan penggunaan Present Perfect Tense. Subjek 'trade' adalah tunggal, sehingga menggunakan 'has become'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Educators recommend that every student ___ about the dangers of free association and substance abuse at an early age.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah kata kerja 'recommend that', digunakan Subjunctive Mood. Dalam bentuk pasif, kata kerja bantu yang digunakan adalah 'be' (bentuk dasar) tanpa mempedulikan subjeknya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The nightlife industry in metropolitan areas often ___ with issues related to public health and social order.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'industry' adalah tunggal, sehingga dalam Simple Present Tense, kata kerja harus diakhiri dengan -s (collides).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: A person who is addicted to adult content ___ experience significant psychological distress when attempting to stop the behavior.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'may' digunakan di sini untuk menyatakan kemungkinan suatu kondisi psikologis yang dialami oleh subjek.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The grooming process ___ months of grooming before the actual abuse occurs, making it difficult for parents to detect.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'process' adalah tunggal, sehingga membutuhkan kata kerja berakhiran -s (involves). 'Often' adalah kata keterangan frekuensi yang diletakkan sebelum kata kerja.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: HIV/AIDS awareness campaigns ___ to reduce the stigma associated with the disease and encourage testing.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'campaigns' adalah jamak, sehingga memerlukan to-be 'are'. Kalimat pasif digunakan karena kampanye tersebut 'dirancang' oleh pihak tertentu.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sexual crimes against children ___ extremely high penalties in many modern legal systems to deter potential offenders.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'crimes' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense tidak menggunakan akhiran -s (carry).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The risk of infant mortality is significantly higher ___ teenage mothers compared to those in their twenties.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Preposisi 'among' digunakan ketika merujuk pada kelompok yang terdiri dari lebih dari dua orang atau unsur secara kolektif.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Not until the police raided the illegal nightclub ___ evidence of widespread drug distribution among minors.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ketika kalimat dimulai dengan 'Not until', maka terjadi inversi pada klausa utama. Karena kejadiannya di masa lampau, digunakan 'did + subjek + verb 1'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many adolescents ___ to peer pressure when they first experiment with illegal substances.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'adolescents' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja yang tepat adalah 'succumb' tanpa akhiran -s.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The victims of child trafficking are often ___ through false promises of employment or education.
