Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat pasif membutuhkan 'to be + past participle (V3)'. 'Lured' adalah bentuk verb 3 yang tepat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: By the end of the year, the clinic ___ over five hundred individuals for STIs through its mobile testing unit.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Frasa 'By the end of the year' menandakan Future Perfect Tense (will have + V3) untuk menyatakan aksi yang akan sudah selesai di masa depan.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The psychological impact of grooming can be devastating, ___ long-term effects on the child's mental health.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Participle (causing) digunakan di sini untuk menunjukkan hasil atau dampak yang terjadi secara langsung dari kondisi sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Laws against child abuse require that any suspicious behavior ___ to the authorities immediately.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah kata 'require that', digunakan Subjunctive Mood. Dalam bentuk pasif, rumusnya adalah 'be + V3' (be reported).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Neither the school administration ___ the parents were aware of the sexual activity occurring in the student dormitory.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Pasangan konjungsi korelasi untuk 'neither' adalah 'nor'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The addict ___ struggling with the urge to consume adult content for several months before seeking help.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Past Perfect Continuous Tense (had been) digunakan untuk menunjukkan durasi suatu aksi yang berlangsung di masa lalu sebelum kejadian lain (seeking help) terjadi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Free association without proper parental guidance ___ to dangerous social behaviors among teenagers.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Modal 'can' harus diikuti oleh kata kerja bentuk dasar (bare infinitive). 'Can lead' adalah konstruksi yang benar.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Sexually transmitted infections are ___ through unprotected physical contact with an infected partner.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Bentuk pasif (are spread) membutuhkan adverb (commonly) untuk menerangkan cara atau frekuensi penyebaran tersebut.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The development of drug resistance in HIV patients ___ that they adhere strictly to their medication schedule.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'development' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja dalam Simple Present Tense harus menggunakan akhiran -s (requires).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Teenage pregnancy often results in the mother dropping out of school, ___ her future career opportunities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Present Participle (limiting) berfungsi sebagai penjelas hasil atau konsekuensi dari klausa sebelumnya.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The groomer's strategy was so sophisticated ___ the child did not realize they were being manipulated.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Struktur 'so + adjective + that' digunakan untuk menyatakan sebab dan akibat yang sangat kuat.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Child trafficking remains a global tragedy, ___ millions of children are exploited for labor and sexual purposes.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Relative adverb 'where' digunakan di sini untuk merujuk pada situasi atau kondisi tragis tersebut sebagai tempat terjadinya eksploitasi.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: ___ by the addictive nature of digital content, some children spend hours viewing inappropriate material online.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Ini adalah Reduced Adjective Clause dalam bentuk pasif. 'Influenced' merupakan kependekan dari 'Because they are influenced'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Drug abuse among teenagers ___ into adulthood if not addressed through early intervention programs.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'abuse' adalah tunggal, sehingga kata kerja harus menggunakan akhiran -s (persists).

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Many pedophiles operate under aliases to conceal their ___ during online interactions with potential victims.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Dibutuhkan frasa kata benda (adjective + noun). 'True identities' adalah pilihan yang paling tepat secara gramatikal.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Teenage mothers <u>has</u> higher risks of developing complications such as anemia and preeclampsia during their pregnancy.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Teenage mothers' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerja bantu yang tepat adalah 'have', bukan 'has'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: The trafficking of children <u>are</u> considered one of the most heinous crimes against humanity in the modern era.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek utama kalimat ini adalah 'The trafficking' (tunggal), maka kata kerja bantu yang tepat adalah 'is'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Pedophiles <u>targetting</u> vulnerable children through social media platforms by using emotional manipulation and false identities.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Kalimat ini membutuhkan kata kerja utama (verb), bukan bentuk gerund atau participle tanpa to-be. 'Target' adalah bentuk yang benar untuk subjek jamak.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: HIV infections can be <u>prevent</u> by using barrier protection and adhering to safe practices during physical contact.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Setelah modal 'can be', harus diikuti oleh past participle (V3) untuk membentuk kalimat pasif. Seharusnya 'be prevented'.

Structure and Written Expression.teks: Drug addicts <u>struggles</u> to overcome their dependency on illegal substances due to the chemical changes in their brain.
Structure and Written Expression.pembahasan: Subjek 'Drug addicts' adalah jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya tidak boleh menggunakan akhiran -s. Seharusnya 'struggle'.
